title: TrustFlow: Topic-Aware Vector Reputation Propagation for Multi-Agent Ecosystems
summary: We introduce TrustFlow, a reputation propagation algorithm that assigns each software agent a multi-dimensional reputation vector rather than a scalar score. Reputation is propagated through an interaction graph via topic-gated transfer operators that modulate each edge by its content embedding, with convergence to a unique fixed point guaranteed by the contraction mapping theorem. We develop a family of Lipschitz-1 transfer operators and composable information-theoretic gates that achieve up to 98% multi-label Precision@5 on dense graphs and 78% on sparse ones. On a benchmark of 50 agents across 8 domains, TrustFlow resists sybil attacks, reputation laundering, and vote rings with at most 4 percentage-point precision impact. Unlike PageRank and Topic-Sensitive PageRank, TrustFlow produces vector reputation that is directly queryable by dot product in the same embedding space as user queries.

AI.tldr: TrustFlow 将 PageRank 的标量声誉推广为嵌入空间中的多维向量声誉，通过"主题门控"算子在交互图上传播信任，并用收缩映射定理保证收敛；在 50 智能体基准上 P@5 最高达 98%（稠密图）/78%（稀疏图），对女巫攻击、声誉洗白、投票环等攻击的精度影响不超过 4 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自治软件智能体（agent）大规模涌现后，用户或其他智能体需要从数百万个 agent 的市场中挑选合适执行者，而现有的星标评分、人工策展、调用计数等机制在规模上易被游戏、与领域无关、无法传播传递性信任。PageRank 与 Topic-Sensitive PageRank（TSPR）虽然能刻画链接结构的重要性，但均为标量输出且共享同一转移矩阵，无法区分"A 在医疗语境下调用 B"与"A 在编程语境下调用 B"。作者指出 agent 声誉具有网页排序所没有的五点结构性特征：(1) 多领域专长（标量无法表达）；(2) 内容与能力解耦（agent 可能无静态内容，信任须来自交互历史）；(3) 经济信号（付费委派本身是信任凭据）；(4) 对抗性审核（女巫、洗白、投票环）；(5) 方向性发现（用户用自然语言查询，应能以与查询同一向量空间做点积检索）。
AI.method: 核心迭代为 R_new[j] = α Σ_i w(i→j) f(R[i], e_ij) + (1−α)T[j] + C[j]，其中 f 为主题门控传输算子，e_ij 为交互内容单位嵌入，w 为行归一化边权（含支付委派乘子 μ=3），T 为嵌入空间中的传送先验，C 为外生权威注入（可独立调节强度）。(1) 传输算子族：投影 σ(R·e)e、平方门控 R⊙e²、Hadamard ReLU max(0,R⊙e)、标量门控 σ(R̂·e)R（clamp 至 [0,1]）、混合算子（逐边选择或凸组合），均满足 Lipschitz-1（平方门控由 ‖e²‖∞≤1 得出，投影为非扩张算子）。(2) 可组合信息论门控：KL 散度门 exp(−λ·D_KL(p_int‖p_rep))，连续形式用余弦代理 exp(−λ sin²θ)；另定义熵门、幅值比门、置信度门，可乘性组合。(3) 盲边（无内容可嵌入）按 0.3× 折扣，并用 avg(caller, callee) 作为代理嵌入。(4) 离散特化：按软分配得到每个领域独立的行随机矩阵 M_d（与 TSPR 共享 M 的本质区别）。(5) 负信任边：R_new[:,d] = α(M_pos^T R − β M_neg^T R) + (1−α)T + C，收敛条件 α(1+β)<1（α=0.85, β=0.15 时为 0.9775），验证标志权重为未验证的 6×。(6) 检索：直接点积 score(j,q)=R[j]·q，或三阶段管道（BM25/SPLADEv2/稠密描述/稠密声誉四路召回 → RRF(k=60) 融合 → 标量幅值 log(1+m) 重排）。(7) 预处理：对 E5/Sentence-BERT/CLIP 各向异性嵌入做均值中心化以消除窄锥效应。
AI.result: 定理 1：任一 Lipschitz-1 算子与 α∈(0,1) 下迭代为收缩映射（因子 α），从任意初值线性收敛至唯一不动点；推论给出稳态界 ‖R*‖≤‖T‖+‖C‖/(1−α)。定理 2：含负边时当 α(1+β)<1 收敛（后处理 R≥0 夹紧为非扩张，保持收敛）。实验（50 agent/8 领域，multilingual-e5-small，E=384；70 条标注边含 14 条支付委派 3× 权重边 + 612 条盲边 0.3× 折扣；10 条查询）：连续形式在合并图上 P@5 78% 优于离散（离散无盲边机制），标注图上离散 74% 具竞争力；算子对比：投影合并图最高 78%，平方门控 72% 且在盲边上保持 cos=1.0（投影仅 0.004）、无归一化下收敛快 3×（4 vs 12 次），标量门控在稠密图达 88% 严格/98% 多标签 P@5，混合 76%；KL 门控 λ=1.0 最佳（自对齐 0.730→0.908，P@5 68%→76%），λ=5.0 过严；攻击实验：跨域女巫 78%（0pp，结构性抵抗）、同域女巫 74%（−4pp，最难但可标记）、声誉洗白 78%（0pp）、投票环 80%（+2pp，受 α^5≈0.44 衰减约束）、标记防御 78%（恶意 agent 声誉降 60–66%）；图密度是主导因素：70→156 边使严格 P@5 68%→78%、多标签 78%→86%，加盲边达 88%；检索方面均值中心化后幅值混合仅 −2pp，未中心化则崩塌 58pp；可扩展性 O(mE)，10 万 agent 约 5 s/批、80MB，百万级用连通分量分解与增量热启动。
AI.conclusion: TrustFlow 以主题门控的向量声誉传播统一了网页排序与 agent 声誉建模：连续嵌入空间声誉在含盲边图上优于离散领域分箱（且能同时对齐多个领域质心，缓解跨域专长被稀释的问题），离散形式在纯标注图上仍有竞争力。核心发现为：没有任何单一传输算子全面占优——投影凭 rank-1 相长干涉在合并图最优，平方门控唯一在无内容边上完美保留方向信息并收敛最快，标量门控在稠密图最强，内容自适应的混合策略是实用折中；嵌入均值中心化是防止最高 58pp 精度崩塌的关键预处理；所有测试攻击的影响均 ≤4pp，跨域女巫与声誉洗白被结构性抵抗，同域女巫与投票环受收缩映射约束并可由标记系统中和；交互数据量（图密度）是 P@5 的首要驱动因素，因而部署应优先生成带标签的可检视交互边（内容可检视调用、支付委派链、结构化反馈），而非过度调优算法。作者亦坦承局限：仅 50 agent 的小规模实验、盲边代理易被对抗性误导、缺少时间衰减机制（未来可引入 e^{−λτ} 权重衰减）、标记系统依赖报告准确性与时效性。

title: Planning Autonomous Vehicle Maneuvering in Work Zones Through Game-Theoretic Trajectory Generation
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Work zone navigation remains one of the most challenging manoeuvres for autonomous vehicles (AVs), where constrained geometries and unpredictable traffic patterns create a high-risk environment. Despite extensive research on AV trajectory planning, few studies address the decision-making required to navigate work zones safely. This paper proposes a novel game-theoretic framework for trajectory generation and control to enhance the safety of lane changes in a work zone environment. By modelling the lane change manoeuvre as a non-cooperative game between vehicles, we use a game-theoretic planner to generate trajectories that balance safety, progress, and traffic stability. The simulation results show that the proposed game-theoretic model reduces the frequency of conflicts by 35 percent and decreases the probability of high risk safety events compared to traditional vehicle behaviour planning models in safety-critical highway work-zone scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于博弈论的新型轨迹生成与控制框架，用于提升自动驾驶车辆在高速公路施工区域进行车道变换的安全性。该方法将车道变换建模为车辆间的非合作博弈，通过博弈论规划器生成兼顾安全性、通行效率和交通稳定性的轨迹。仿真结果表明，与传统车辆行为规划模型相比，该博弈论模型将冲突频率降低了35%，并降低了高风险安全事件的概率。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆在施工区域导航仍是最具挑战性的操作之一，受限的几何空间和不可预测的交通模式构成了高风险环境。尽管已有大量关于自动驾驶轨迹规划的研究，但针对施工区域安全导航的决策问题研究较少。
AI.method: 将车道变换 maneuver建模为车辆间的非合作博弈，使用博弈论规划器生成轨迹，平衡安全性、通行进度和交通稳定性三个目标。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，提出的博弈论模型将冲突频率降低了35%，并降低了关键高速公路施工场景中高风险安全事件的概率。
AI.conclusion: 基于博弈论的轨迹生成与控制框架能够有效提升自动驾驶车辆在施工区域车道变换的安全性，为解决该高风险环境中的决策问题提供了新思路。

title: Helix: A Dual-Helix Co-Evolutionary Multi-Agent System for Prompt Optimization and Question Reformulation
summary: Automated prompt optimization (APO) aims to improve large language model performance by refining prompt instructions. However, existing methods are largely constrained by fixed prompt templates, limited search spaces, or single-sided optimization that treats user questions as immutable inputs. In practice, question formulation and prompt design are inherently interdependent: clearer question structures facilitate focused reasoning and task understanding, while effective prompts reveal better ways to organize and restate queries. Ignoring this coupling fundamentally limits the effectiveness and adaptability of current APO approaches. We propose a unified multi-agent system (Helix) that jointly optimizes question reformulation and prompt instructions through a structured three-stage co-evolutionary framework. Helix integrates (1) planner-guided decomposition that breaks optimization into coupled question-prompt objectives, (2) dual-track co-evolution where specialized agents iteratively refine and critique each other to produce complementary improvements, and (3) strategy-driven question generation that instantiates high-quality reformulations for robust inference. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmarks against 6 strong baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of Helix, achieving up to 3.95% performance improvements across tasks with favorable optimization efficiency.

AI.tldr: Helix是一个统一的多智能体系统，通过三阶段协同进化框架同时优化问题改写和提示指令，解决了传统APO方法忽视问题-提示耦合关系的根本局限。
AI.motivation: 现有自动提示优化(APO)方法存在三大局限：1) 受限于固定提示模板；2) 搜索空间有限；3) 单边优化将用户问题视为不可变输入。实际上问题表述与提示设计相互依赖：更清晰的问题结构有助于聚焦推理和任务理解，而有效的提示能揭示更好的查询组织方式。忽视这种耦合关系从根本上限制了APO的有效性和适应性。
AI.method: 提出统一多智能体系统Helix，通过三阶段协同进化框架联合优化问题改写和提示指令：1) 规划器引导分解，将优化分解为耦合的问题-提示目标；2) 双轨协同进化，专业智能体迭代改进并相互批判，产生互补改进；3) 策略驱动问题生成，为鲁棒推理实例化高质量改写。
AI.result: 在12个基准测试上对比6个强基线方法，Helix实现最高3.95%的性能提升，且优化效率良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了问题表述与提示设计的协同优化能够显著提升大语言模型性能，为APO领域提供了一种新的系统化方法。

title: GT-Space: Enhancing Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception with Ground Truth Feature Space
summary: In autonomous driving, multi-agent collaborative perception enhances sensing capabilities by enabling agents to share perceptual data. A key challenge lies in handling {\em heterogeneous} features from agents equipped with different sensing modalities or model architectures, which complicates data fusion. Existing approaches often require retraining encoders or designing interpreter modules for pairwise feature alignment, but these solutions are not scalable in practice. To address this, we propose {\em GT-Space}, a flexible and scalable collaborative perception framework for heterogeneous agents. GT-Space constructs a common feature space from ground-truth labels, providing a unified reference for feature alignment. With this shared space, agents only need a single adapter module to project their features, eliminating the need for pairwise interactions with other agents. Furthermore, we design a fusion network trained with contrastive losses across diverse modality combinations. Extensive experiments on simulation datasets (OPV2V and V2XSet) and a real-world dataset (RCooper) demonstrate that GT-Space consistently outperforms baselines in detection accuracy while delivering robust performance. Our code will be released at https://github.com/KingScar/GT-Space.

AI.tldr: GT-Space 面向异构智能体的多车协同感知框架：利用真值标签构建一个“公共特征空间（common feature space）”，各智能体只需训练一个轻量投影器（projector）即可将自身模态特征对齐到该空间，再经模态无关的融合网络（Transformer）完成融合，从而免去编码器重训或成对解释器模块，实现可扩展、即插即用的异构协同感知。
AI.motivation: 中间融合的协同感知中，异构智能体（不同传感器模态或不同编码器架构）的特征在语义与粒度上不一致，难以直接融合。现有两类适配策略均不可扩展：(1) 编码器重训（如 HEAL）——需为每个协作方维护专用编码器，开放环境下成本极高，且可能损害智能体自身的单体感知性能；(2) 特征解释器（interpreter，如 PnPDA、STAMP）——Ego 需为每个异构方配备独立解释器，成对交互导致扩展性差，且解释过程会丢失点云空间信息。此外，这类方法的协同性能受限于 Ego 自身模型容量，弱模型拖累整体效果。
AI.method:
1) 公共特征空间构建：由 3D 框标注 B_i=(x,y,z,l,w,h,r,c) 经 FC+LayerNorm 编码得 β_i，再与网格单元的正弦位置编码 PE(x_c,y_c) 拼接并过 MLP 得到单元特征 U_c；多目标覆盖同一网格时求和，形成真值 BEV 特征图 F_GT。该“GT 编码器”单独训练，用检测头+IoU 损失 L_GT 保证其可被解码回框。
2) 异构特征对齐：每个智能体配一个模态专属 MLP 投影器 Φ_a，最小化 L_η=‖F_GT−η(F_a)‖₂ 将本地 BEV 特征映射到公共空间；编码器与检测头全程冻结。
3) 相关特征增强与融合：融合网络为含多头自注意力的 Transformer 块；对任意模态对 (m,m') 计算带温度 τ 的余弦相似度并做 InfoNCE 式交叉熵，对同一目标拉近、不同目标推远（对象级对比学习）。
4) 组合式对比损失 L_E=Σ_{m,m'} L_{m,m'}，在所有模态组合上联合训练（如 PointPillar/SECOND/EfficientNet 的三种配对），使网络在推理时可接受任意模态组合。
5) 总目标 L=Σ_a L_Φa + L_E + L_B；训练时使用单智能体观测以避免空间错位噪声。新智能体加入时冻结全部参数，仅训练其投影器（损失 L=L_Φi+L_B）。
实验：OPV2V、V2XSet（仿真）与 RCooper（真实路侧）；四类异构智能体（A1 SECOND-LiDAR、A2 PointPillar-LiDAR、A3 EfficientNet-相机、A4 ResNet50-相机）；对比 Non-collab、Late fusion、HM-ViT、PnPDA、HEAL、Hetecooper、STAMP；指标 AP@50/AP@70。
AI.result: OPV2V：GT-Space 在 A1 与 A2/A3/A4 协作时 AP@50 达 0.891/0.848/0.844，AP@70 达 0.810/0.766/0.762，全面超过 HEAL、STAMP、Hetecooper、HM-ViT、PnPDA 等基线（如 A1+A2 协作：HEAL 0.887/0.801，STAMP 0.876/0.806）。V2XSet：AP@50 0.874/0.826/0.830，AP@70 0.802/0.741/0.738，同样最优。四智能体联合场景下对相机智能体的增益尤为显著（A3：0.867 vs HEAL 0.842；A4：0.859 vs HEAL 0.843），显示其补偿弱智能体的能力。真实数据集 RCooper（AP@50）：A1 0.477、A3 0.349、A4 0.351，均为最优；跟踪任务 AMOTA 0.236、AMOTP 0.367 亦领先。消融：去掉投影器损失最大（OPV2V mAP@50 0.892→0.791），去掉组合对比损失次之（→0.845），用 PointPillar 特征空间替代 GT 空间为 0.868。鲁棒性：弱智能体、定位误差（高斯位姿噪声）、通信延迟（100–500ms）、跨数据集分布偏移（OPV2V 训练→V2XSet 测试，A1 0.858）下均保持 SOTA；新增智能体实验 0.891→0.892→0.897，优于 PnPDA/STAMP 且训练参数量与 GPU 时远低于 HEAL；延迟分解显示融合仅约 1.48ms，与基线相当；温度 τ=0.1 最优；尺度均衡进一步提升 RCooper 表现。
AI.conclusion: GT-Space 通过以真值标签显式构造公共特征空间，为异构智能体提供了共享且精确的对齐参考：每个智能体仅需一个轻量投影器即可接入，摆脱成对解释器与编码器重训，融合网络用组合对比损失训练以支持任意模态组合并强化目标相关表征，在仿真与真实数据上取得 SOTA 精度、即插即用扩展性与对弱智能体/定位误差/延迟/分布偏移的鲁棒性，且几乎不增加推理开销。局限在于依赖真值标注与理想通信/位姿条件，作者计划未来引入弱监督学习以提升真实场景适用性。

title: Goedel-Code-Prover: Hierarchical Proof Search for Open State-of-the-Art Code Verification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate plausible code but offer limited guarantees of correctness. Formally verifying that implementations satisfy specifications requires constructing machine-checkable proofs, a task that remains beyond current automation. We propose a hierarchical proof search framework for automated code verification in Lean~4 that decomposes complex verification goals into structurally simpler subgoals before attempting tactic-level proving. Central to our approach is a principled decomposition score that combines constructive justification with structural effectiveness. Crucially, this score serves as both the training reward and the inference-time ranking criterion, ensuring strict alignment between optimization and deployment. We train Goedel-Code-Prover-8B, a single unified policy for both decomposition and completion, via supervised initialization followed by hybrid reinforcement learning, where a continuous decomposition reward drives planning exploration while supervised replay stabilizes proof generation. On three Lean-based code verification benchmarks comprising 427 tasks, our 8B-parameter model achieves a 62.0\% prove success rate, a 2.6$\times$ improvement over the strongest baseline, surpassing neural provers up to 84$\times$ larger. We further observe consistent inference-time scaling: success rates improve monotonically with search iterations and sampling budget, with our trained model achieving greater efficiency than frontier off-the-shelf models of comparable scale.

AI.tldr: 提出了Goedel-Code-Prover-8B，一个用于Lean 4中自动代码验证的分层证明搜索框架，通过分解评分机制结合构建性论证与结构有效性，在427个任务的三个基准上达到62.0%的证明成功率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型可以生成看似合理的代码，但对正确性的保证有限。形式化验证代码需要构建机器可检查的证明，这一任务目前仍超出自动化的能力范围。
AI.method: 提出分层证明搜索框架，将复杂验证目标分解为结构更简单的子目标，然后进行策略级证明。核心是结合构建性论证与结构有效性的分解评分，该评分同时作为训练奖励和推理时排序标准。通过监督初始化后接混合强化学习训练Goedel-Code-Prover-8B，其中连续分解奖励驱动规划探索，监督回放稳定证明生成。
AI.result: 在包含427个任务的三个Lean代码验证基准上，8B参数模型实现62.0%的证明成功率，比最强基线提升2.6倍，超越高达84倍规模的神经证明器。推理时扩展性一致：随着搜索迭代和采样预算增加，成功率单调提升，训练模型比同规模的现成前沿模型效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分解和完成统一为单一策略，并使用分解评分作为训练奖励和推理排序标准，实现了训练与部署的严格对齐，在代码验证任务上显著优于现有方法。

title: Computer-Orchestrated Design of Algorithms: From Join Specification to Implementation
summary:
Equipping query processing systems with provable theoretical guarantees has been a central focus at the intersection of database theory and systems in recent years. However, the divergence between theoretical abstractions and system assumptions creates a gap between an algorithm's high-level logical specification and its low-level physical implementation. Ensuring the correctness of this logical-to-physical translation is crucial for realizing theoretical optimality as practical performance gains. Existing database testing frameworks struggle to address this need because necessary algorithm-specific inputs such as join trees are absent from standard test case generation, and integrating complex algorithms into these frameworks imposes prohibitive engineering overhead. Fallback solutions, such as using macro-benchmark queries, are inherently too noisy for isolating intricate defects during this translation.
  In this experience paper, we present a retrospective analysis of $\mathsf{CODA}$, a computer-orchestrated testing framework utilized during the physical co-design of TreeTracker Join ($\mathsf{TTJ}$), a theoretically optimal yet practical join algorithm recently published in ACM TODS. By synthesizing minimal reproducible examples, $\mathsf{CODA}$ successfully isolates subtle translation defects, such as state mismanagement and mapping conflicts between join trees and bushy plans. We demonstrate that this logical-to-physical translation process is a bidirectional feedback loop: early structural testing not only hardened $\mathsf{TTJ}$'s physical implementation but also exposed a boundary condition that directly refined the formal precondition of $\mathsf{TTJ}$ itself. Finally, we detail how confronting these translation challenges drove the architectural evolution of $\mathsf{CODA}$ into a robust, structure-aware test generation pipeline for join-tree-dependent algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文是关于CODA测试框架的经验论文，用于在TreeTracker Join (TTJ)算法的物理协同设计中隔离逻辑到物理转换的缺陷。CODA通过合成最小可重现示例，成功识别了状态管理错误和连接树与灌木计划之间的映射冲突等细微转换缺陷，并揭示了测试与形式化前置条件 refinement 之间的双向反馈循环。
AI.motivation: 解决数据库理论保证与系统实现之间的差距问题。理论算法与其低级别物理实现之间的逻辑-物理转换正确性难以保证，现有数据库测试框架缺乏对算法特定输入（如连接树）的支持，无法有效隔离转换过程中的细微缺陷。
AI.method: 采用回顾性分析方法，详细分析CODA框架在TTJ算法物理协同设计过程中的应用。CODA是一个计算机编排的测试框架，能够合成最小可重现示例，进行结构感知的测试生成。
AI.result: 成功隔离了细微的转换缺陷，包括状态 mismanagement 和连接树与灌木计划之间的映射冲突。发现逻辑到物理转换过程是一个双向反馈循环：早期结构测试不仅强化了TTJ的物理实现，还暴露了一个边界条件，直接完善了TTJ的形式化前置条件。
AI.conclusion: CODA演变为一个强大的结构感知测试生成管道，专门用于连接树依赖算法。论文表明，转换挑战的 confrontation 推动了CODA架构的演进，证明了测试与算法形式化规范之间的双向反馈价值。

title: The Bilateral Efficiency of Ethernet: Recalibrating Metcalfe and Boggs After Fifty Years
comment: 10 pages, ACM sigconf format. 50th anniversary of Metcalfe and Boggs (1976)
summary:
In July 1976, Metcalfe and Boggs published their foundational paper on Ethernet in Communications of the ACM. Their efficiency model -- E = (P/C)/(P/C + W*T) -- measures the fraction of Ether time carrying good forward packets under contention. For fifty years this model has defined how the networking community thinks about Ethernet performance. We argue that the model, while correct for its intended purpose, measures only the forward channel and is silent on the question that matters for modern distributed systems: bilateral transaction efficiency -- the fraction of link time that produces committed agreements between sender and receiver.
  We show that Metcalfe and Boggs themselves understood this distinction intuitively. Their EFTP "end-dally" protocol (Section 7.2.2 of the original paper) is a three-phase bilateral handshake that attempts to achieve mutual knowledge of transfer completion -- precisely the property that their efficiency model cannot capture. We connect this observation to the Open Atomic Ethernet's bilateral transaction primitive, to the back-to-back Shannon channel formulation with Perfect Information Feedback, and to the Two-State Vector Formalism (TSVF) from physics, which provides the theoretical framework for understanding why both boundary conditions -- sender and receiver -- must be specified for a transaction to have definite value.
  The correction to Table 1 of Metcalfe and Boggs is not a different set of numbers. It is a different question.

AI.tldr: 在 Metcalfe & Boggs 1976 年以太网论文发表五十周年之际，Paul Borrill（Open Æthernet Project）指出其经典效率公式 E=(P/C)/(P/C+W·T) 只测量单向转发通道的效率，未回答"链路时间中有多少比例产生了收发双方互相确认的已提交事务"这一问题。作者提出"双边交易效率"（bilateral efficiency, E_B），主张以太网的历史其实是在双边/单边机制间的"五十年双边锯齿"（Aloha 链路层肯定确认 → 1973 年被 Metcalfe 移除的以太网 ACK → EFTP end-dally 文件层双边握手 → TCP 上层双边），并以 Open Æthernet（链路的"完美信息反馈"PIF、双向 Shannon 通道、2-bit SACK 四级见证链、三角形可逆回滚）作为在链层恢复双边承诺的工程实现。核心结论：对 Table 1 的修正不是换一组数字，而是换一个问题——从"转发效率"改为"已提交事务效率"。
AI.motivation: 经典以太网效率模型只度量"链路时间中承载有效转发分组的比例"，对接收端处理、双方是否达成一致、end-dally 开销、重传代价与语义正确性一概沉默；它对 1976 年的"共享同轴是否能在争用下承载有用流量"是恰当的，但这一适用范围限制后来被误当作完整答案。现代交换机全双工链路上 E≈1 平凡成立，该模型甚至不适用于当代以太网（Metcalfe 1973 论文的 SF-10 有效容量公式同样仅限共享介质）。而在 800 Gb/s 及以上的机架内互联、10^5-GPU 集群的协调受限负载下，真正的问题是"链路时间中产生已提交双边协议的比例"。作者同时主张"越高层的补偿成本已不再廉价"：AI 训练协调开销约 150–400 亿美元/年、云存储同步 50–90 亿美元/年、HFT 托管溢价 15–30 亿美元/年、2024 年 Delta–CrowdStrike 事件单家航司损失约 5 亿美元、检查点补偿占 AI 训练时间 12%–43%；且随速率提升每秒误码率不降反升、相关链路抖动每分钟级频发。同时作者接受 Robert Garner 的品牌与分层反对意见，故将架构命名为 Open Æthernet（拒绝"以太"这一已被 IEEE 802 托管并以"无链路层 ACK"为定义承诺的品牌）。
AI.method: 1) 历史考证与概念重构：依据 Garner 的原始文献考证，说明 Metcalfe 1973 年有意识地移除了 ARPANET IMP 的 1-bit Ack 与 Aloha 的肯定确认，形成"双边锯齿"叙事；并从原文 Section 7.2.2 提炼 EFTP end-dally 的三阶段 END/ENDREPLY 回显 + 10 秒 dally，作为"相互知识（mutual knowledge）"的原始双边事务原型，并引用 Metcalfe 2026 年 3 月的个人通信"end-dally 的本意是提速，像 NAK 那样"来支撑"反向信息提升效率"的原则。2) 形式化：定义 E_B = 已提交事务数 / 总链路秒；用 E_B^Æ = (N_c/N_a)·P_e/(P_e+ΔT_commit) 给出工程形式；提出两个不矛盾的时间界——单次承诺的硬下界 T ≥ 2τ（一次往返传播）与流水线化后双边确认的边际代价 ΔT_commit ≈ 0（因 SACK 走空闲回程路径并发返回）。3) 机制建模：以 Abramson 的"完美信息反馈"（PIF）把链路建模为前向/后向两条并行 Shannon 通道，用 2-bit SACK 四级知识阶梯（00 检测/01 捕获/10 识别/11 提交）构成逐级见证链，使"提交"成为双方共同持有的属性而非发送方事后猜测；引入 Lynch 交替位协议作为理论支撑。4) 故障模型与范围限定：明确限定在 ≤1 m（芯粒边界可至亚厘米）的机架内链路与蜂窝网格拓扑（用矩阵树定理的生成树重数提供冗余路径）；区分三类机制——FCS 检测损坏（移除的是叠加其上的 RS-FEC/链路重试，而非 FCS 本身）、SACK 见证链建立承诺（损坏的 SACK 在操作上等价于缺失 SACK，即双边"未提交"，故 8 bit 无需 ECC；虚假承诺需同时逃过 FCS 并一致伪造全部四级见证，概率比单链路误码率低若干数量级）、RLFD 检测链路失效（双边 PIF + 一跳三角）。"可逆"被严格定义为切片引擎提交状态的对称回滚（由接收方 NAK 或见证失败触发，经一跳第三方"vicar"仲裁，援引 Two Generals 论证与 Jim Gray 的事务回滚思想），Æthernet 不重传、不回退时间。5) 交叉验证：引用 Wang 等 2026 年 IEEE TCAD 多芯粒工作——由封装良率工程问题独立得出同样的原子化握手式交换而非超时-预留式恢复，且在过饱和区间取得 2.36 倍吞吐；并引用 bisynchronous FIFO、IEEE P896 背板、多芯粒 NoC、节点间链路四十年同机演化轨迹（均不依赖共享时基或超时恢复），以及 Lynch 1968 与 2025 的论述。作者亦按 Garner 与 Helland 的意见撤回了两个论点：将 CSMA/CD 碰撞检测称作"原始双边基元"（实为 hack 叠 hack）与基于物理学的 Two-State Vector Formalism 类比（认为对工程读者代价大于收益）。
AI.result: 给出双边效率的形式化定义与两个互不冲突的时间界（T ≥ 2τ 为每笔承诺的硬地板，ΔT_commit ≈ 0 为流水线化后的边际代价），并说明经典公式对二者皆无项，因为它根本没有为反向信息设变量。在现代交换式链路上 E ≈ 1 而 E_B 可能任意差（RDMA 的"completion"仅在物理投递层面报告成功，应用层未必有语义一致）。Open Æthernet 以双向 Shannon 通道 + PIF 的 4 级 SACK 见证链在链层重建互知，且对上层完全透明——应用仍照常调用 send()/recv()，唯一改变是链路暴露的完成语义（"该事务在 NIC 间于 N 微秒内双边提交"）。故障模型将损坏检测、承诺建立、链路失效三种职责严格分离，"可逆"被限定为提交状态回滚而非时间或重传的反转。Table 1 被重写为"两种效率范式对照"：度量对象（转发吞吐 vs 已提交双边事务）、通道（单向 vs 双向）、成功判据（无碰撞转发 vs 双方互相确信）、时间结构（时隙 T vs 下界 2τ 且边际成本≈0）、反向信息（对指标不可见 vs 一等公民 PIF/SACK）、失败处理（中止重传 vs 可逆回滚/三角）。Abstract 中提及的 TSVF 类比在正文 v0.4 中已被撤回，构成摘要与正文的一处不一致；附录（OAE 故障模型、状态表、虚假承诺上界、"超时作为触发 vs 作为真相"）未包含在本次可见文本中，故相关证明无法核验。另需注意 E_B 的两处定义量纲不一致（事务/链路秒 vs 后续的无量纲式 (3)），以及该文为单作者立场论文，缺少实测数据与同行评审验证。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张 Ethernet 的经典效率模型在其原定用途上正确，但只覆盖前向通道；五十年被追问的是"线缆高效搬运分组的效率"，而从未追问"链路高效产生已提交协议（committed agreements）的效率"。Open Æthernet 在链层、限 ≤1 m 的机架内范围内恢复 Aloha 拥有而被以太网放弃的双边承诺，其原语是双边事务，机制是带完美信息反馈的双向 Shannon 通道，恢复模型是带可逆回滚的三角形。作者强调这不否定"关注点分离"原则：高层补偿不会归零，只会降为更小的残差，其作用是改变高层所站立的基底（如虚拟内存之于物理 RAM），如同高可靠物理链路上"极少发生的故障"已因规模与速率变化而不再廉价。致谢部分承认本文在 Robert Garner 逐点评审下被大幅修正，并保留与其在分层价值判断上的真实分歧。

title: Speculating Experts Accelerates Inference for Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have gained popularity as a means of scaling the capacity of large language models (LLMs) while maintaining sparse activations and reduced per-token compute. However, in memory-constrained inference settings, expert weights must be offloaded to CPU, creating a performance bottleneck from CPU-GPU transfers during decoding. We propose an expert prefetching scheme that leverages currently computed internal model representations to speculate future experts, enabling memory transfers to overlap with computation. Across multiple MoE architectures, we demonstrate that future experts can be reliably predicted by these internal representations. We also demonstrate that executing speculated experts generally maintains downstream task accuracy, thus preserving more effective compute-memory overlap by eliminating the need to re-fetch true router-selected experts. Integrated into an optimized inference engine, our approach achieves up to 14\% reduction in time per output token (TPOT) over on-demand loading of experts from CPU memory. For MoEs where speculative execution alone yields suboptimal accuracy, we further examine lightweight estimators that improve expert prediction hit rates, thereby reducing performance degradation. Our code is released in open-source at https://github.com/axonn-ai/yalis/tree/offload_prefetch.

AI.tldr: 针对MoE模型推理时内存受限导致CPU-GPU传输瓶颈的问题，提出利用模型内部表示预测未来专家的预取方案，实现计算与内存传输重叠，最高可降低14%的输出延迟。
AI.motivation: 解决MoE（混合专家）模型在内存受限推理场景下的性能瓶颈问题。由于专家权重需要卸载到CPU，解码过程中CPU-GPU数据传输成为主要性能限制因素。
AI.method: 提出一种专家预取方案，利用当前计算的内部模型表示来预测未来专家，使内存传输与计算重叠执行。对于预测准确率不足的情况，引入轻量级估计器来提高专家预测命中率。
AI.result: 在多种MoE架构上验证了内部表示可以可靠预测未来专家；执行预测专家基本保持下游任务准确率；集成到优化推理引擎中实现最高14%的每输出token时间（TPOT） reduction.
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过消除重新获取真实路由选择专家的需求，实现了更有效的计算-内存重叠，为MoE模型的高效推理提供了新思路。

title: When both Grounding and not Grounding are Bad -- A Partially Grounded Encoding of Planning into SAT (Extended Version)
summary: Classical planning problems are typically defined using lifted first-order representations, which offer compactness and generality. While most planners ground these representations to simplify reasoning, this can cause an exponential blowup in size. Recent approaches instead operate directly on the lifted level to avoid full grounding. We explore a middle ground between fully lifted and fully grounded planning by introducing three SAT encodings that keep actions lifted while partially grounding predicates. Unlike previous SAT encodings, which scale quadratically with plan length, our approach scales linearly, enabling better performance on longer plans. Empirically, our best encoding outperforms the state of the art in length-optimal planning on hard-to-ground domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种介于完全提升（fully lifted）和完全具体化（fully grounded）规划之间的新方法，通过三种SAT编码在保持动作提升的同时部分具体化谓词，实现线性扩展性，解决了传统SAT编码随计划长度二次方增长的问题。
AI.motivation: 经典规划问题通常使用提升的一阶表示，这种表示紧凑且通用。大多数规划器通过具体化这些表示来简化推理，但这会导致规模指数级膨胀。虽然最近的方法直接在提升层面操作以避免完全具体化，但本文探索一种介于完全提升和完全具体化之间的中间方案。
AI.method: 引入三种SAT编码，这些编码保持动作提升，同时部分具体化谓词。与之前的SAT编码（随计划长度呈二次方增长）不同，本文的方法呈线性增长，使在更长计划上具有更好的性能。
AI.result: 经验结果表明，本文最好的编码在难以具体化的域上优于当前最优的长度最优规划方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在保持动作提升的同时部分具体化谓词，本文成功实现了线性扩展性的SAT编码，为经典规划问题提供了一种有效的中间立场解决方案，在难以具体化的域上展现了优越的性能。

title: GoAgent: Group-of-Agents Communication Topology Generation for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in solving complex tasks, yet their effectiveness depends heavily on the underlying communication topology that coordinates agent interactions. Within these systems, successful problem-solving often necessitates task-specific group structures to divide and conquer subtasks. However, most existing approaches generate communication topologies in a node-centric manner, leaving group structures to emerge implicitly from local connectivity decisions rather than modeling them explicitly, often leading to suboptimal coordination and unnecessary communication overhead. To address this limitation, we propose GoAgent (Group-of-Agents), a communication topology generation method that explicitly treats collaborative groups as the atomic units of MAS construction. Specifically, GoAgent first enumerates task-relevant candidate groups through an LLM and then autoregressively selects and connects these groups as atomic units to construct the final communication graph, jointly capturing intra-group cohesion and inter-group coordination. To mitigate communication redundancy and noise propagation inherent in expanding topologies, we further introduce a conditional information bottleneck (CIB) objective that compresses inter-group communication, preserving task-relevant signals while filtering out redundant historical noise. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of GoAgent with 93.84% average accuracy while reducing token consumption by about 17%.

AI.tldr: GoAgent提出了一种基于"智能体组"的通信拓扑生成方法，将协作组作为MAS构建的原子单元，通过LLM枚举候选组并自回归选择连接组来构建通信图，同时引入条件信息瓶颈(CIB)压缩组间通信以减少冗余和噪声传播。实验在6个基准上达到93.84%平均准确率，同时减少约17%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based多智能体系统虽然能解决复杂任务，但通信拓扑生成以节点为中心，群体结构隐式涌现，导致协调 suboptimal且通信开销不必要。成功的问题解决往往需要任务特定的分治群体结构，但现有方法未能显式建模群体结构。
AI.method: 1) 首先通过LLM枚举任务相关的候选群体；2) 自回归地选择并连接这些群体作为原子单元构建最终通信图，同时考虑组内凝聚力和组间协调；3) 引入条件信息瓶颈(CIB)目标压缩组间通信，保留任务相关信号并过滤冗余历史噪声。
AI.result: 在6个基准数据集上达到最先进的性能，93.84%平均准确率，同时减少约17%的token消耗。
AI.conclusion: GoAgent通过显式建模"组"作为协作原子单元，能够更好地捕捉任务特定的分治结构，CIB机制有效降低了通信冗余和噪声传播，为LLM-based MAS的通信拓扑设计提供了新范式。

title: DePro: Understanding the Role of LLMs in Debugging Competitive Programming Code
comment: This paper is accepted in FSE 2026 IVR track!
summary: Debugging consumes a substantial portion of the software development lifecycle, yet the effectiveness of Large Language Models(LLMs) in this task is not well understood. Competitive programming offers a rich benchmark for such evaluation, given its diverse problem domains and strict efficiency requirements. We present an empirical study of LLM-based debugging on competitive programming problems and introduce DePro, a test-case driven approach that assists programmers by correcting existing code rather than generating new solutions. DePro combines brute-force reference generation, stress testing, and iterative LLM-guided refinement to identify and resolve errors efficiently.Experiments on 13 faulty user submissions from Codeforces demonstrate that DePro consistently produces correct solutions, reducing debugging attempts by up to 64% and debugging time by an average of 7.6 minutes per problem compared to human programmers and zero-shot LLM debugging.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了大型语言模型(LLM)在竞赛编程中的调试能力，并提出DePro方法——一种通过测试用例驱动来修复现有代码而非生成新解决方案的调试辅助工具。该方法结合暴力参考生成、压力测试和迭代式LLM引导 refinement，在13个Codeforces问题提交上实验表明可减少最多64%的调试尝试次数和平均7.6分钟的调试时间。
AI.motivation: 调试占据软件开发生命周期的大量时间，但LLM在此任务中的有效性尚未被充分理解。竞赛编程提供了丰富的基准测试环境，因其问题领域多样且有严格的效率要求。
AI.method: 提出DePro方法：1)暴力参考生成(brute-force reference generation)建立基准；2)压力测试(stress testing)识别错误；3)迭代式LLM引导 refinement识别并解决错误。核心思路是修复现有代码而非从头生成解决方案。
AI.result: 在13个来自Codeforces的有缺陷的用户提交上实验表明：DePro持续产生正确解决方案；相比人类程序员和零样本LLM调试，可减少最多64%的调试尝试次数；平均每个问题减少7.6分钟调试时间。
AI.conclusion: DePro作为一种测试用例驱动的LLM调试方法，在竞赛编程场景中表现出色，能有效减少调试工作量并提高效率。未来可探索其在更广泛软件工程场景中的应用。

title: Process Faster, Pay Less: Functional Isolation for Stream Processing
comment: Accepted to the 42nd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2026). 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Concurrent workloads often extract insights from high-throughput, real-time data streams. Existing stream processing engines isolate each query's resources, ensuring robust performance but incurring high infrastructure costs. In contrast, sharing work reduces the amount of necessary resources but introduces inter-query interference, leading to performance degradation for some queries. We introduce FunShare, a stream-processing system that improves resource efficiency without compromising performance by dynamically grouping queries based on their performance characteristics. FunShare strategically relaxes query interdependencies and minimizes redundant computation while preserving individual query performance. It achieves this by using an adaptive optimization framework that monitors execution metrics, accurately estimates computation overlaps, and reconfigures execution plans on the fly in response to changes in the underlying data streams. Our evaluation demonstrates that FunShare minimizes resource consumption compared to isolated execution while maintaining or improving throughput for all queries.

AI.tldr: FunShare是一个流处理系统，通过根据查询性能特征动态分组来提高资源效率，同时不牺牲性能。该系统战略性地放松查询间依赖性并最小化冗余计算。
AI.motivation: 当前流处理引擎为每个查询分配隔离资源，确保性能但带来高基础设施成本；而资源共享虽减少资源需求，但引入查询间干扰，导致部分查询性能下降。
AI.method: FunShare采用自适应优化框架，监控执行指标、准确估算计算重叠，并根据底层数据流变化动态重新配置执行计划。
AI.result: 与隔离执行相比，FunShare最大程度减少资源消耗，同时为所有查询保持或提升吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: FunShare成功通过动态查询分组在资源效率和查询性能之间取得平衡，为高吞吐量实时数据流处理提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: SWARM+: Scalable and Resilient Multi-Agent Consensus for Fully-Decentralized Data-Aware Workload Management
summary: Distributed scientific workflows increasingly span heterogeneous compute clusters, edge resources, and geo-distributed data repositories. In these environments, a centralized orchestrator is an architectural bottleneck -- introducing a single point of failure, limiting scalability, and constraining adaptability to changing resource availability or failures. Decentralized multi-agent coordination offers a compelling alternative: autonomous agents representing distributed resources collaboratively negotiate workload assignment (e.g., job selection) through peer-to-peer consensus, making decisions based on local compute capacity, data locality, and network conditions. However, scaling such systems for production workloads requires addressing challenges in coordination, resilience, and data-aware optimization. This work presents SWARM+, which builds on our prior work that demonstrated the feasibility of multi-agent decentralized consensus for distributed job selection. SWARM+ addresses three main problems: scalability of consensus for large numbers of agents, resilience of workload management under agent failure, and efficiency of job scheduling for highly distributed resources and data-intensive workloads. For each problem, we propose novel algorithms and evaluate them in the distributed FABRIC testbed. The results show that SWARM+ (a) scales to 1000 distributed agents with nearly equal workload distribution across the hierarchy levels and reduced coordination overhead due to hierarchical consensus, (b) is resilient to agent failures, maintaining >99% job completion rate under single agent failure, and demonstrating graceful system degradation, with at most 7.5% impact under 50% agent failures, and (c) achieves 97-98% improvement over baseline SWARM for both selection time and scheduling latency metrics.

AI.tldr: SWARM+是一个去中心化的多智能体协调系统，用于分布式科学工作流的调度。它通过点对点共识机制实现工作负载分配，解决了集中式编排器的单点故障、可扩展性和适应性限制问题。在FABRIC测试平台上评估结果表明，该系统可扩展至1000个分布式智能体，在智能体故障下保持>99%作业完成率，选择时间和调度延迟相比基线SWARM改善97-98%。
AI.motivation: 当前分布式科学工作流越来越多地跨越异构计算集群、边缘资源和地理分布的数据存储库。集中式编排器存在单点故障、可扩展性受限、对资源可用性变化适应性差等问题，需要去中心化的多智能体协调作为替代方案。
AI.method: 提出三层解决方案：1）分层共识算法解决大规模智能体协调问题；2）容错机制确保智能体故障下的工作负载管理韧性；3）数据感知优化算法提高分布式资源和数据密集型工作负载的调度效率。评估在分布式FABRIC测试平台进行。
AI.result: 1) 可扩展性：可扩展至1000个分布式智能体，分层结构实现均衡工作负载分布，降低协调开销；2) 韧性：单智能体故障下保持>99%作业完成率，50%智能体故障时系统优雅降级，影响仅7.5%；3) 效率：选择时间和调度延迟相比基线SWARM改善97-98%。
AI.conclusion: SWARM+成功解决了去中心化工作流调度的三个核心挑战——可扩展性、韧性和效率，为大规模分布式科学工作流管理提供了可行的去中心化方案。

title: A Visualization for Comparative Analysis of Regression Models
summary: As regression is a widely studied problem, many methods have been proposed to solve it, each of them often requiring setting different hyper-parameters. Therefore, selecting the proper method for a given application may be very difficult and relies on comparing their performances. Performance is usually measured using various metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), or R-squared (R${}^2$). These metrics provide a numerical summary of predictive accuracy by quantifying the difference between predicted and actual values. However, while these metrics are widely used in the literature for summarizing model performance and useful to distinguish between models performing poorly and well, they often aggregate too much information. This article addresses these limitations by introducing a novel visualization approach that highlights key aspects of regression model performance. The proposed method builds upon three main contributions: (1) considering the residuals in a 2D space, which allows for simultaneous evaluation of errors from two models, (2) leveraging the Mahalanobis distance to account for correlations and differences in scale within the data, and (3) employing a colormap to visualize the percentile-based distribution of errors, making it easier to identify dense regions and outliers. By graphically representing the distribution of errors and their correlations, this approach provides a more detailed and comprehensive view of model performance, enabling users to uncover patterns that traditional aggregate metrics may obscure. The proposed visualization method facilitates a deeper understanding of regression model performance differences and error distributions, enhancing the evaluation and comparison process.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的回归模型性能可视化方法，通过在二维空间中考虑残差、利用马氏距离考虑数据相关性和尺度差异、以及使用色图可视化基于百分位的误差分布，解决了传统聚合指标（如MAE、RMSE、R²）信息过度聚合的问题。
AI.motivation: 回归分析中选择合适的方法很困难，需要比较模型性能。传统指标（MAE、RMSE、R²）虽然广泛使用，但聚合了过多信息，难以揭示模型性能的具体差异和误差分布模式。
AI.method: 提出三种方法：(1)在二维空间中考虑残差，实现两个模型误差的同步评估；(2)利用马氏距离考虑数据中的相关性和尺度差异；(3)使用色图可视化基于百分位的误差分布，便于识别密集区域和异常值。
AI.result: 通过图形化表示误差分布及其相关性，提供了更详细全面的模型性能视图，使用户能够发现传统聚合指标掩盖的模式。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的可视化方法有助于更深入理解回归模型性能差异和误差分布，增强了评估和比较过程。

title: Hyperagents
summary: Self-improving AI systems aim to reduce reliance on human engineering by learning to improve their own learning and problem-solving processes. Existing approaches to self-improvement rely on fixed, handcrafted meta-level mechanisms, fundamentally limiting how fast such systems can improve. The Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) demonstrates open-ended self-improvement in coding by repeatedly generating and evaluating self-modified variants. Because both evaluation and self-modification are coding tasks, gains in coding ability can translate into gains in self-improvement ability. However, this alignment does not generally hold beyond coding domains. We introduce \textbf{hyperagents}, self-referential agents that integrate a task agent (which solves the target task) and a meta agent (which modifies itself and the task agent) into a single editable program. Crucially, the meta-level modification procedure is itself editable, enabling metacognitive self-modification, improving not only the task-solving behavior, but also the mechanism that generates future improvements. We instantiate this framework by extending DGM to create DGM-Hyperagents (DGM-H), eliminating the assumption of domain-specific alignment between task performance and self-modification skill to potentially support self-accelerating progress on any computable task. Across diverse domains, the DGM-H improves performance over time and outperforms baselines without self-improvement or open-ended exploration, as well as prior self-improving systems. Furthermore, the DGM-H improves the process by which it generates new agents (e.g., persistent memory, performance tracking), and these meta-level improvements transfer across domains and accumulate across runs. DGM-Hyperagents offer a glimpse of open-ended AI systems that do not merely search for better solutions, but continually improve their search for how to improve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"超智能体"（hyperagents）：将任务智能体与元智能体融合为单一可自编辑程序，且元级的自我修改流程本身也可被编辑，从而实现"元认知式"自我改进。基于达尔文·哥德尔机（DGM）扩展出 DGM-Hyperagents（DGM-H），在消除"任务能力提升必然带来自我改进能力提升"这一领域特定对齐假设的前提下，于多个领域上随时间持续提升性能，优于无自我改进、无开放式探索的基线及已有自我改进系统，并能使元级机制（如持久记忆、性能追踪）跨领域迁移、跨运行累积。
AI.motivation: 现有自我改进系统（如 Darwin Gödel Machine, DGM）依赖固定的、人工设计好的元级机制（如何生成变体、如何评估、如何选择），因此改进速度受限于这些手工设计的天花板。DGM 在编码任务中实现了开放式自我改进，其关键在于"评估"与"自我修改"都是编码任务，因而编码能力的提升可迁移为自我改进能力的提升——但这一对齐关系依赖特定领域，无法推广到一般任务。作者的核心动机是：要让自我改进真正具备领域普适性与自加速特性，必须把"生成改进的机制"本身纳入可编辑范围，即允许元认知层面的自我修改（metacognitive self-modification），从而同时改进任务求解行为与未来的改进机制。
AI.method: 1) 框架定义：hyperagent 是一个自指的可编辑程序，内部整合 task agent（求解目标任务）与 meta agent（修改自身及 task agent），且**元级修改流程本身也是可编辑对象**，形成"改进改进方式"的双层闭环。2) 实例化：以 DGM 为基础扩展为 DGM-H，保留其开放式循环（生成自修改变体 → 评估 → 选择归档、精英保留等选择机制），但把元级修改代码纳入可变异空间，从而不再依赖"编码能力 ↔ 自我改进能力"的对齐假设，可应用于任何可计算（可验证）任务。3) 评测：在多个不同领域任务上比较 DGM-H 与无自我改进基线、无开放式探索基线以及既有自我改进系统，追踪性能随时间演化。4) 分析元级涌现：检验 DGM-H 是否自发演化出持久记忆、性能追踪等元级机制，并测试这些机制是否跨领域迁移、跨运行累积（即把元级改进作为可继承的"种子"继续进化）。
AI.result: DGM-H 在多个领域上表现随时间持续提升，并优于两类基线（不具备自我改进的、以及不具备开放式探索的）以及此前的自我改进系统，说明在移除领域特定对齐假设后，开放式自我改进仍能成立。更重要的观察是元级层面的自我改进：DGM-H 会自发改进"生成新智能体的流程"，例如演化出持久记忆机制与性能追踪机制；这些元级改进可跨领域迁移（在 A 领域学到的机制直接惠及 B 领域），并可跨独立运行累积（将先前运行的元级改进作为初始状态继续进化，形成类似"继承"的轨迹）。这些证据支持了超智能体产生自加速进展的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把自我改进从"改进任务求解器"提升到"改进改进机制本身"，提出 hyperagents 概念并给出 DGM-H 实现，展示了在可计算任务上开放式、自加速 AI 系统的可行路径——系统不只是搜索更好的解，而是持续改进其"搜索如何改进"的方式。作者同时提示，这类开放式自修改系统仍需解决安全性与可控性（如自我修改过程的行为约束与评估可靠性）等挑战；但整体上，论文为通向真正开放式、领域无关的自我改进 AI 提供了可操作的框架与初步实证。

title: A Subgoal-driven Framework for Improving Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have emerged as powerful autonomous controllers for digital environments, including mobile interfaces, operating systems, and web browsers. Web navigation, for example, requires handling dynamic content and long sequences of actions, making it particularly challenging. Existing LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon planning in two main ways. During online execution, they often lose track as new information arrives, lacking a clear and adaptive path toward the final goal. This issue is further exacerbated during reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning, where sparse and delayed rewards make it difficult for agents to identify which actions lead to success, preventing them from maintaining coherent reasoning over extended tasks. To address these challenges, we propose two contributions. First, we introduce an agent framework that leverages proprietary models for online planning through subgoal decomposition. Second, we present MiRA (Milestoning your Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Agent), an RL training framework that uses dense, milestone-based reward signals. The real-time planning mechanism improves proprietary models such as Gemini by approximately a 10% absolute increase in success rate (SR) on the WebArena-Lite benchmark. Meanwhile, applying MiRA to the open Gemma3-12B model increases its success rate from 6.4% to 43.0%. This performance surpasses proprietary systems such as GPT-4-Turbo (17.6%) and GPT-4o (13.9%), as well as the previous open-model state of the art, WebRL (38.4%). Overall, our findings demonstrate that combining explicit inference-time planning with milestone-based rewards significantly improves an agent's long-horizon capabilities, paving the way for more robust and general-purpose autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiRA框架，通过里程碑式奖励信号解决LLM智能体在长程任务中的规划与强化学习微调难题，在WebArena-Lite基准上将Gemma3-12B的成功率从6.4%提升至43.0%，超越GPT-4-Turbo和GPT-4o等专有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在长程规划中存在两大痛点：(1)在线执行时难以追踪目标，缺乏清晰的适应性路径；(2)强化学习微调中稀疏延迟的奖励导致智能体难以识别导致成功的动作，无法在扩展任务中保持连贯推理。
AI.method: 提出两个核心贡献：(1)利用专有模型通过子目标分解进行在线规划的智能体框架；(2)MiRA（Milestoning your Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Agent）——使用密集的里程碑式奖励信号的RL训练框架。
AI.result: 在线规划机制使Gemini在WebArena-Lite上的成功率提升约10个绝对百分点；MiRA应用于开源Gemma3-12B使其成功率从6.4%提升至43.0%，超越GPT-4-Turbo（17.6%）、GPT-4o（13.9%）及先前开源SOTA模型WebRL（38.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理时规划与里程碑式奖励的结合显著提升了智能体的长程能力，为构建更稳健的通用自主系统奠定了基础。

title: Coordinating Stakeholders in the Consideration of Performance Indicators and Respective Interface Requirements for Automated Vehicles
summary: This paper presents a process for coordinating stakeholders in their consideration of performance indicators and respective interface requirements for automated vehicles. These performance indicators are obtained and processed based on the system's self-perception and enable the realization of self-aware and self-adaptive vehicles. This is necessary to allow SAE Level 4 vehicles to handle external disturbances as well as internal degradations and failures at runtime. Without such a systematic process for stakeholder coordination, architectural decisions on realizing self-perception become untraceable and effective communication between stakeholders may be compromised. Our process-oriented approach includes necessary ingredients, steps, and artifacts that explicitly address stakeholder communication, traceability, and knowledge transfer through clear documentation. Our approach is based on the experience gained from applying the process in the autotech.agil project, from which we further present lessons learned, identified gaps, and steps for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种协调利益相关者考虑自动驾驶车辆性能指标和相应接口需求的过程，旨在实现自感知、自适应车辆，使SAE 4级车辆能够在运行时处理外部干扰以及内部退化和故障。
AI.motivation: SAE 4级车辆需要处理外部干扰和内部故障，但缺乏系统的利益相关者协调过程会导致架构决策不可追踪，利益相关者之间沟通效率低下。
AI.method: 采用过程导向方法，包含必要的要素、步骤和工件，通过清晰文档明确解决利益相关者沟通、可追溯性和知识转移问题，基于autotech.agil项目经验。
AI.result: 在autotech.agil项目中应用该过程，获得了经验教训，识别了差距，并为未来工作提供了步骤。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为自动驾驶车辆开发中的利益相关者协调提供了系统化框架，但需进一步验证和完善。

title: Acyclic Graph Pattern Counting under Local Differential Privacy
summary: Graph pattern counting serves as a cornerstone of network analysis with extensive real-world applications. Its integration with local differential privacy (LDP) has gained growing attention for protecting sensitive graph information in decentralized settings. However, existing LDP frameworks are largely ad hoc, offering solutions only for specific patterns such as triangles and stars. A general mechanism for counting arbitrary graph patterns, even for the subclass of acyclic patterns, has remained an open problem. To fill this gap, we present the first general solution for counting arbitrary acyclic patterns under LDP. We identify and tackle two fundamental challenges: generalizing pattern construction from distributed data and eliminating node duplication during the construction. To address the first challenge, we propose an LDP-tailored recursive subpattern counting framework that incrementally builds patterns across multiple communication rounds. For the second challenge, we apply a random marking technique that restricts each node to a unique position in the pattern during computation. Our mechanism achieves strong utility guarantees: for any acyclic graph pattern with $k$ edges, we achieve an additive error of $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{N}d(G)^k)$, where $N$ is the number of nodes and $d(G)$ is the maximum degree of the input graph $G$. Experiments on real-world graph datasets across multiple types of acyclic patterns demonstrate that our mechanisms achieve up to $46$-$2600\times$ improvement in utility and $300$-$650\times$ reduction in communication cost compared to the baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在边级本地差分隐私（edge-LDP）下给出任意无环图模式计数（k-line walk / k-line path / 任意 k 边无环模式 / k-star）的通用机制。核心思想是"LDP 适配的递归子模式计数框架"+"随机标记（random marking）"：将模式分解为子树并跨多轮增量构建，同时用标记把每个节点限制在模式中的唯一位置以消除节点重复。误差从已有 RR 枚举法的 O(N^k) 降至 Õ(√N·d(G)^k)，通信量从 O(N²) 降至 O(M+N)，实验显示效用提升最高 46–2600×、通信降低 300–650×。
AI.motivation: 图模式计数是网络分析的核心原语（社区发现、欺诈检测、motif 分析、扩散/链接预测），但直接发布结果会泄露节点/边信息。中心化 DP 需要信任数据策展者，存在泄露风险；LDP 让每个节点先本地加噪再上报，更适合去中心化场景（如跨社交平台分布式图）。然而现有 LDP 图模式计数方案高度特化，只覆盖星、蝴蝶、三角等局部模式，缺乏通用框架；即便是无环模式（无私有场景下的基本原语，关系数据库中 Yannakakis 的经典问题）在 LDP 下仍是开放问题。已有通用做法是让每个节点用 Randomized Response (RR) 上报邻居列表、中心重建噪声图再枚举（Suppakitpaisarn et al. 2025），误差高达 O(N^k)，远大于真实计数上限 Nd(G)^k，且通信 O(N²)、分析端计算 O(N^{k+1})。作者提出的核心问题是：能否在 edge-LDP 下对任意无环模式达到 Õ(√N·poly(d(G))) 的误差？（LDP 相比中心 DP 典型地额外付出 O(√N) 因子）作者识别出两大挑战：挑战1——如何把模式构建从分布式数据中泛化出来（现有方案依赖模式特定结构）；挑战2——如何消除构建过程中的节点重复（无环模式要求实例内节点互不相同，重复即成环，而一般无环模式可能跨距很远，单个节点无法本地检测重复）。
AI.method: 三步递进的技术栈：(1) LDP 适配的递归子模式计数框架——以 k-line walk 计数为基石：初始化 X_i^(0)=1（第0条游走），第 ℓ 轮每个节点聚合邻居上一轮的计数 X_i^(ℓ)=Σ_{j∈N(i)} X_j^(ℓ-1) + Lap(2k‖X^(ℓ-1)‖_∞/ε)，噪声尺度取全局上轮最大值（而非本地最大值）以避免泄露局部结构信息；隐私预算按轮分配 ε/k，用基本组合定理保证 ε-edge-LDP（单条边只影响两个节点，可并行组合）。效率优化：轮数 k→k-1（最后一条边由倒数第二个节点乘以自身加噪度数 d(v_i)+Lap(2k/ε) 补齐）、把上轮最大值计算从节点移到分析器（节点计算 O(N)→O(d(G))）、节点间通信从全广播 O(N²) 降到仅与邻居通信的 O(M)（假设相邻节点有直连通道）。(2) 随机标记（受 color-coding 启发）——每节点从 {0,...,k} 均匀采样标记 r_i，公开（与数据无关不损失隐私），节点只在自己被标记的那一轮参与计算，其余轮保持沉默，从而主动预防节点在模式中重复出现；采样到一条路径/模式的概率为 (k+1)^{-(k+1)}，分析器按 (k+1)^{k+1}（或除以模式自同构数 σ 以去除重复计数）重新缩放。关键：因标记使每轮每条边最多影响一个节点的计算，隐私预算无需按轮/节点分摊（并行组合），且因标记公开导致采样放大（privacy amplification）不适用。(3) 推广到任意无环模式——将无环模式表述为树（指定根、叶子、父子关系），用 DFS 得到"子节点在父节点之后"的顶点顺序 u_0..u_k，叶子下标集合为 L；按该顺序递归计数子树：节点在轮 ℓ 只收集标记为 c 的邻居给出的 T(c) 子树计数 Y_i^(c)，再取乘积 X_i^(ℓ)=∏_{c∈C(ℓ)} Y_i^(c)（经典 Yannakakis 递归子树计数）。树的构建只依赖模式不依赖图，可由分析器预处理好并广播结构；轮数 k+2-|L|。(4) k-star 特殊设计：重复问题可由星中心本地解决，无需随机标记，采用单轮机制 M_{k⋆}：每节点加噪度数 d̃(v_i)=d(v_i)+Lap(2/ε)，计算下降阶乘 d̃(d̃-1)⋯(d̃-k+1) 上报求和（无需估计最大度，故通信更省）。(5) 误差优化：以 n_rep 次重复（每轮 ε/n_rep）取平均，在采样误差（与 ε 无关）与 DP 噪声之间取平衡以最小化总误差。
AI.result: 理论保证：k-line walk 计数在 k-1 轮内给出无偏估计，误差 Õ(√N·d(G)^{k-1})，通信 O(M+N)，分析端计算 O(N)，节点计算 O(d(G))；k-line path 计数 k 轮，误差 Õ(√N·d(G)^k)（相对 walk 仅多 Õ(d(G)) 因子，且该差距实际远小于理论）；任意 k 边无环模式计数至多 k+2-|L| 轮，误差同样为 Õ(√N·d(G)^k)，与路径计数同阶，且保持无偏；k-star 单轮机制达到 SOTA 的 Õ(√N·d(G)^{k-1})。与 SOTA 对比：walk 计数相对 Betzer et al. 2024 把误差从 O(Nd(G)^k)（含 ad hoc 参数）降为 Õ(√N d(G)^{k-1})，通信从 O(N²) 降为 O(M+N)；path/无环模式相对 Suppakitpaisarn et al. 2025 把误差从 O(N^k) 降为 Õ(√N d(G)^k)，通信从 O(N²) 降为 O(M+N)，分析端计算从 O(N^{k+1}) 降为 O(N)。隐私方面证明了 ε-edge-LDP（walk 用基本组合、path/无环模式用并行组合，并说明采样放大不成立的原因）。实验（SNAP 六个真实图：AstroPh、Enron、Epinions1/2、Slashdot、Twitter；ε=1；每组重复 10 次取中 8 次均值）：walk 计数相对误差全部 <8%（基线 WalkClip 因截断偏差达 ~99%，RR_enum 达数百至数万%），误差最高改善 110×、通信降低 300×；path 计数最高改善 2600×、通信降低 600×；无环模式最高改善 46×、通信降低 650×；star 计数相对误差 <0.5%、最高改善 710×、通信降低 3×。误差分解显示采样误差通常主导但优势远小于 d(G)；n_rep 优化在 Epinions2 上对四个查询分别带来 2.8×、1.8×、4.6×、2.0× 的总误差改进；不同树结构（同模式不同 T/T′）误差差异仅常数因子、通信基本不变，验证了理论对树结构的独立性。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了 edge-LDP 下任意无环图模式计数的首个通用方案，答案是肯定的：存在误差 Õ(√N·poly(d(G))) 的机制，具体为 Õ(√N·d(G)^k)。方法论要点是：把"细粒度发布"改为"本地聚合后发布"（walk→path→一般无环模式的递归子模式计数），并用公开随机标记主动预防节点重复而非事后检测；两个核心技巧（递归子模式计数 + 随机标记）可与 LDP 噪声标定、并行组合和效率优化（轮数削减、max 计算上移、边级通信）良好结合。相比最强基线（RR 枚举法）实现数量级的效用提升与两个数量级的通信下降，且机制无超参、仅需 ε 与查询模式。未来工作：扩展到含环模式（需破环并附加端点约束，例如把三角计数归约为"两端点相连的 2-line 路径"，但如何在保护隐私下同时追踪路径两端点是主要难点），以及推广到 node-LDP（更强地保护单个节点及其全部关联边）。

title: Maximizing mutual information between user-contexts and responses improve LLM personalization with no additional data
summary: While post-training has successfully improved large language models (LLMs) across a variety of domains, these gains heavily rely on human-labeled data or external verifiers. Existing data has already been exploited, and new high-quality data is expensive to collect. More fundamentally, true intelligence goes far beyond tasks that are easily verifiable. Therefore, we need self-improvement frameworks that allow models to improve without external oversight. We propose *Mutual Information Preference Optimization (MIPO)*, a contrastive data augmentation method that constructs preference pairs by generating a positive response conditioning on the correct prompt, and a negative response by conditioning on a random, unrelated prompt. We show that using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to learn from this paired data maximizes pointwise conditional mutual information (MI) (under the base LLM) between prompts and model responses. Empirical results with various-sized Llama- and Qwen-Instruct models show that when used to maximize MI between user context and response, MIPO provides an effective personalization technique, achieving 3-40% improvements on personalization tasks using real-user datasets compared to strong baselines. Surprisingly, MIPO can also be applied to improve performance on math and multiple-choice problems, yielding 1-18% **without any additional data or human supervision**. These results suggest a promising direction for self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出MIPO（互信息偏好优化），一种基于对比数据增强的自我改进框架，通过构建偏好对（正样本基于正确提示，负样本基于随机无关提示）并使用DPO学习，从而最大化提示与响应之间的条件互信息，实现无需外部监督的模型自我提升。
AI.motivation: 后训练虽然提升了LLM能力，但依赖人工标注数据或外部验证器。现有数据已被充分利用，新高质量数据收集成本高。更重要的是，真正的智能远超可验证任务范围，因此需要无外部监督的自我改进框架。
AI.method: 提出对比数据增强方法MIPO，构建偏好对：正样本为基于正确提示生成的有效响应，负样本为基于随机无关提示生成的响应。使用DPO从这些配对数据中学习，在基础LLM下最大化提示与响应之间的逐点条件互信息（MI）。
AI.result: 在多种规模的Llama和Qwen-Instruct模型上实验表明：1）用于最大化用户上下文与响应间的MI时，MIPO成为有效的个性化技术，在真实用户数据集上相比强基线提升3-40%；2）令人惊讶的是，MIPO还能提升数学和选择题性能，无需任何额外数据或人工监督即可获得1-18%的提升。
AI.conclusion: MIPO提供了一种有前景的自我改进方向，证明了通过最大化条件互信息，模型可以在无外部监督的情况下实现性能提升，为构建更自主的AI系统提供了新思路。

title: Teaching an Agent to Sketch One Part at a Time
summary: We develop a method for producing vector sketches one part at a time. To do this, we train a multi-modal language model-based agent using a novel multi-turn process-reward reinforcement learning following supervised fine-tuning. Our approach is enabled by a new dataset we call ControlSketch-Part, containing rich part-level annotations for sketches, obtained using a novel, generic automatic annotation pipeline that segments vector sketches into semantic parts and assigns paths to parts with a structured multi-stage labeling process. Our results indicate that incorporating structured part-level data and providing agent with the visual feedback through the process enables interpretable, controllable, and locally editable text-to-vector sketch generation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多模态语言模型智能体的分部分生成矢量草图方法，通过监督微调后的多轮过程奖励强化学习进行训练，并利用包含丰富部分级注释的新数据集ControlSketch-Part实现可控、可解释和局部可编辑的文本到矢量草图生成。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到矢量草图生成方法缺乏可解释性、可控性和局部编辑能力，需要一种能够分部分生成的更具结构化的方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出新型自动标注流水线，将矢量草图分割为语义部分并为各部分分配路径，实现结构化多阶段标注；2) 构建包含丰富部分级注释的ControlSketch-Part数据集；3) 采用监督微调后接多轮过程奖励强化学习的方式训练多模态语言模型智能体，使其能够接收视觉反馈并进行分部分生成。
AI.result: 该方法实现了可解释、可控且支持局部编辑的文本到矢量草图生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的部分级数据结合过程视觉反馈能够有效提升文本到矢量草图生成的可控性和可解释性，为草图生成任务提供了新的研究方向。

title: MeanFlow Meets Control: Scaling Sampled-Data Control for Swarms
summary: Steering large-scale swarms in only a few control updates is challenging because real systems operate in sampled-data form: control inputs are updated intermittently and applied over finite intervals. In this regime, the natural object is not an instantaneous velocity field, but a finite-window control quantity that captures the system response over each sampling interval. Inspired by MeanFlow, we introduce a control-space learning framework for swarm steering under linear time-invariant dynamics. The learned object is the coefficient that parameterizes the finite-horizon minimum-energy control over each interval. We show that this coefficient admits both an integral representation and a local differential identity along bridge trajectories, which leads to a simple stop-gradient training objective. At implementation time, the learned coefficient is used directly in sampled-data updates, so the prescribed dynamics and actuation map are respected by construction. The resulting framework provides a scalable approach to few-step swarm steering that is consistent with the sampled-data structure of real control systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对线性时不变动力学系统的群体引导控制空间学习框架，通过学习有限时域最小能量控制的系数来实现少步数群体引导。该方法基于积分表示和桥梁轨迹的局部微分恒等式，使用stop-gradient训练目标，直接应用于采样数据更新，保持系统动态和执行映射的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现实系统以采样数据形式运行，控制输入间歇性更新并在有限区间内应用。现有方法使用瞬时速度场，但在采样数据机制下，自然的控制对象是有限窗口控制量而非瞬时速度场。因此需要一种与真实控制系统采样数据结构一致的少步数群体引导方法。
AI.method: 1. 将学习对象参数化为每个采样间隔上有限时域最小能量控制的系数；2. 证明该系数具有积分表示形式；3. 证明该系数沿桥梁轨迹具有局部微分恒等式性质；4. 基于上述性质推导简单的stop-gradient训练目标；5. 在实现时直接将学习到的系数用于采样数据更新。
AI.result: 学习到的系数可直接用于采样数据更新，框架与真实控制系统的采样数据结构保持一致，提供了可扩展的少步数群体引导方法。该方法在构建时就保证了规定的动力学和执行映射得到满足。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为少步数群体引导提供了一种可扩展的方法，其核心优势在于与采样数据结构的内在一致性，确保了动态约束和执行映射的满足。

title: Skilled AI Agents for Embedded and IoT Systems Development
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems have shown promise for automated software development, but applying them to hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) embedded and Internet-of-Things (IoT) systems remains challenging due to the tight coupling between software logic and physical hardware behavior. Code that compiles successfully may still fail when deployed on real devices because of timing constraints, peripheral initialization requirements, or hardware-specific behaviors. To address this challenge, we introduce a skills-based agentic framework for HIL embedded development together with IoT-SkillsBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate AI agents in real embedded programming environments. IoT-SkillsBench spans three representative embedded platforms, 23 peripherals, and 42 tasks across three difficulty levels, where each task is evaluated under three agent configurations (no-skills, LLM-generated skills, and human-expert skills) and validated through real hardware execution. Across 378 hardware validated experiments, we show that concise human-expert skills with structured expert knowledge enable near-perfect success rates across platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于技能的智能体框架，用于硬件在环(HIL)嵌入式和物联网(IoT)系统的开发，并发布了IoT-SkillsBench基准测试集。该基准涵盖3个嵌入式平台、23个外设、42个任务，通过378次硬件验证实验评估了三种智能体配置（无技能、LLM生成技能、人类专家技能）的效果，证明人类专家技能可实现接近完美的成功率。
AI.motivation: 将LLM和智能体系统应用于HIL嵌入式和IoT系统存在挑战，因为软件逻辑与物理硬件行为紧密耦合。成功编译的代码在真实设备上可能因时序约束、外设初始化要求或硬件特定行为而失败，现有方法缺乏针对真实嵌入式编程环境的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出技能驱动的智能体框架，并在IoT-SkillsBench基准上进行系统评估。基准包含3个代表性嵌入式平台、23个外设、42个任务（3个难度级别），每任务在三种智能体配置下评估：无技能、LLM生成技能、人类专家技能，并通过真实硬件执行验证。
AI.result: 378次硬件验证实验表明，简明扼要的人类专家技能结合结构化专业知识可在不同平台上实现接近完美的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 人类专家提供的结构化技能能够有效解决LLM在嵌入式硬件开发中的挑战，显著提升智能体在真实硬件环境中的成功率，为自动化嵌入式开发提供了可行的技术路线。

title: Low-Latency Stateful Stream Processing through Timely and Accurate Prefetching
comment: Accepted to the 42nd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2026). 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Mission-critical applications often run "forever" and process large data volumes in real time while demanding low latency. To handle the large state of these applications, modern streaming engines rely on key-value stores and store state on local storage or remotely, but accessing such state inflates latency. As today's engines tightly couple the data path with state I/O, a tuple triggers state access only when it reaches a stateful operator, placing I/O on the critical path and stalling the CPU. However, the keys used to access the state are frequently known earlier in the query plan. Building on this insight, we propose Keyed Prefetching, which decouples the data path from state access by extracting future access keys at upstream operators and proactively staging the corresponding state in memory before tuples arrive. This overlaps I/O with ongoing computation and hides the latency of large-state accesses. We pair Keyed Prefetching with Timestamp-Aware Caching, a cache-eviction policy that jointly manages previously accessed and prefetched entries to use memory efficiently. Together, these techniques reduce latency for long-running, real-time queries without sacrificing throughput.

AI.tldr: 针对流处理引擎中状态访问导致延迟高的问题，提出键值预取(Keyed Prefetching)技术，通过在上游算子提前提取未来访问的键并主动将状态加载到内存中，将I/O与计算重叠，从而隐藏大状态访问的延迟。配合时间戳感知缓存(Timestamp-Aware Caching)策略管理缓存，实现低延迟且不影响吞吐量的实时查询。
AI.motivation: 关键任务应用需要处理大量实时数据并要求低延迟，但现代流处理引擎中状态访问位于关键路径上，导致CPU停滞。研究者观察到用于访问状态的键在查询计划中通常更早就已知，因此可以通过提前预取来隐藏状态I/O延迟。
AI.method: 提出两种技术：1) 键值预取(Keyed Prefetching)：解耦数据路径与状态访问，在上游算子提取未来访问键，在元组到达前主动将对应状态加载到内存中，实现I/O与计算的重叠；2) 时间戳感知缓存(Timestamp-Aware Caching)：联合管理已访问和预取的缓存条目，根据时间戳进行高效淘汰的缓存策略。
AI.result: 这些技术将I/O从关键路径中移除，使CPU可以持续运行而不因状态访问而停滞。
AI.conclusion: 键值预取和时间戳感知缓存相结合，可以在不牺牲吞吐量的前提下，为长时间运行的实时查询显著降低延迟。

title: BrainSCL: Subtype-Guided Contrastive Learning for Brain Disorder Diagnosis
summary: Mental disorder populations exhibit pronounced heterogeneity -- that is, the significant differences between samples -- poses a significant challenge to the definition of positive pairs in contrastive learning. To address this, we propose a subtype-guided contrastive learning framework that models patient heterogeneity as latent subtypes and incorporates them as structural priors to guide discriminative representation learning. Specifically, we construct multi-view representations by combining patients' clinical text with graph structure adaptively learned from BOLD signals, to uncover latent subtypes via unsupervised spectral clustering. A dual-level attention mechanism is proposed to construct prototypes for capturing stable subtype-specific connectivity patterns. We further propose a subtype-guided contrastive learning strategy that pulls samples toward their subtype prototype graph, reinforcing intra-subtype consistency for providing effective supervisory signals to improve model performance. We evaluate our method on Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), Bipolar Disorder (BD), and Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD). Experimental results confirm the effectiveness of subtype prototype graphs in guiding contrastive learning and demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art approaches. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BrainSCL-06D7.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种子型引导的对比学习框架，用于处理精神疾病人群的异质性问题。该方法结合临床文本和从BOLD信号自适应学习的图结构构建多视图表示，通过无监督谱聚类发现潜在子型，并利用双层注意力机制构建原型捕获稳定的子型特异性连接模式，最终通过子型引导的对比学习策略提高模型性能。
AI.motivation: 精神障碍人群存在显著的异质性，即样本之间的显著差异，这给对比学习中正样本对的定义带来了重大挑战。传统的对比学习方法难以有效处理这种患者间的异质性问题。
AI.method: 1. 多视图表示构建：结合患者的临床文本与从BOLD信号自适应学习的图结构；2. 无监督谱聚类：发现潜在子型；3. 双层注意力机制：构建原型以捕获稳定的子型特异性连接模式；4. 子型引导的对比学习：将样本拉向其子型原型图，增强子型内一致性
AI.result: 在抑郁症(MDD)、双相情感障碍(BD)和自闭症谱系障碍(ASD)三个数据集上验证了该方法的有效性，子型原型图能够有效引导对比学习，且该方法优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将患者异质性建模为潜在子型并作为结构先验融入对比学习，该方法能够有效处理精神疾病诊断中的异质性问题，为脑功能连接分析提供了新的思路。

title: Learning to Disprove: Formal Counterexample Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Mathematical reasoning demands two critical, complementary skills: constructing rigorous proofs for true statements and discovering counterexamples that disprove false ones. However, current AI efforts in mathematics focus almost exclusively on proof construction, often neglecting the equally important task of finding counterexamples. In this paper, we address this gap by fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to reason about and generate counterexamples. We formalize this task as formal counterexample generation, which requires LLMs not only to propose candidate counterexamples but also to produce formal proofs that can be automatically verified in the Lean 4 theorem prover. To enable effective learning, we introduce a symbolic mutation strategy that synthesizes diverse training data by systematically extracting theorems and discarding selected hypotheses, thereby producing diverse counterexample instances. Together with curated datasets, this strategy enables a multi-reward expert iteration framework that substantially enhances both the effectiveness and efficiency of training LLMs for counterexample generation and theorem proving. Experiments on three newly collected benchmarks validate the advantages of our approach, showing that the mutation strategy and training framework yield significant performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型(LLM)的微调方法,用于数学推理中的反例生成任务。研究将反例生成形式化为需要LLM同时生成候选反例并提供可在Lean 4定理证明器中自动验证的形式化证明。通过引入符号突变策略合成多样化训练数据,并结合多奖励专家迭代框架,显著提升了LLM在反例生成和定理证明方面的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在数学领域的工作几乎只关注证明构造,忽视了反例发现这一同等重要的任务。数学推理需要两种关键且互补的能力:为真命题构造严格证明,以及发现能够证伪假命题的反例。这种不平衡导致AI数学推理能力存在明显缺陷。
AI.method:
1. 将任务形式化为"形式化反例生成",要求LLM生成候选反例并提供可Lean 4验证的形式化证明
2. 引入符号突变策略:系统性地提取定理并丢弃某些假设,从而合成多样化的反例训练数据
3. 构建多奖励专家迭代框架,结合精选数据集,提升训练效果和效率
AI.result: 在三个新收集的基准测试上的实验表明,该方法和训练框架带来了显著的性能提升,验证了符号突变策略和迭代框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了AI数学推理中反例生成领域的空白,通过形式化定义任务、符号突变数据合成和多奖励迭代训练,为提升LLM的数学反例生成能力提供了有效方案,对增强AI数学推理的全面性具有重要意义。

title: GazePrinter: Visualizing Expert Gaze to Guide Novices in a New Codebase
comment: 43 pages, 11 figures, 23 tables, submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
summary:
Program comprehension is an essential activity in software engineering. Not only does it often challenge professionals, but it can also hinder novices from advancing their programming skills. Gaze, an emerging modality in developer tools, has so far primarily been utilized to improve our understanding of programmers' visual attention and as a means to reason about programmers' cognitive processes. There has been limited exploration of integrating gaze-based assistance into development environments to support programmers, despite the tight links between attention and gaze. We also know that joint attention is important in collaboration, further suggesting that there is value in exploring collective gaze.
  In this paper, we investigate the effect of visualizing gaze patterns gathered from experts to novice programmers to assist them with program comprehension in a new codebase. To this end, we present GazePrinter, designed to provide gaze-orienting visual cues informed by experts to aid novices with program comprehension. We present the results of a mixed-methods study conducted with 40 novices to study the effects of using GazePrinter for program comprehension tasks. The study included a survey, a controlled experiment, and interviews. We found that visualization of expert gaze can have a significant effect on novice programmers' behavior in terms of which path they take through the code base; with GazePrinter, novices took a path closer to the path taken by experts. We also found indications of reduced time and cognitive load among novices using GazePrinter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GazePrinter工具，通过可视化专家的程序注视模式来辅助新手程序员理解代码。对40名新手进行混合方法研究（含调查、实验和访谈），结果表明专家注视可视化能显著影响新手在代码库中的浏览路径，使其更接近专家路径，并显示出减少时间和认知负荷的迹象。
AI.motivation: 程序理解是软件工程中的关键活动，对专业人士和新手均构成挑战。尽管注视与注意力密切相关，但 gaze 技术主要用于理解程序员视觉注意力及认知过程，尚缺乏将基于注视的辅助集成到开发环境中的探索。此外，协作中的联合注视表明研究集体注视具有价值。
AI.method: 设计并开发了GazePrinter工具，提供基于专家注视的视线导向视觉提示以辅助程序理解。进行了混合方法研究，包含问卷、 controlled 实验和访谈，共有40名新手程序员参与。
AI.result: 专家注视可视化对新手程序员的行为有显著影响，具体体现在代码库的浏览路径选择上；使用GazePrinter的新手所选择的路径更接近专家路径。同时观察到新手编程时间减少和认知负荷降低的迹象。
AI.conclusion: 专家注视的可视化能够有效帮助新手程序员理解新代码库中的程序，为利用 gaze 技术辅助编程学习提供了有价值的探索方向。

title: ReViSQL: Achieving Human-Level Text-to-SQL
summary:
Translating natural language to SQL (Text-to-SQL) is a critical challenge in both database research and data analytics applications. Recent efforts have focused on enhancing SQL reasoning by developing large language models and AI agents that decompose Text-to-SQL tasks into manually designed, step-by-step pipelines. However, despite these extensive architectural engineering efforts, a significant gap remains: even state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI agents have not yet achieved the human-level accuracy on the BIRD benchmark. In this paper, we show that closing this gap does not require further architectural complexity, but rather clean training data to improve SQL reasoning of the underlying models.
  We introduce ReViSQL, a streamlined framework that achieves human-level accuracy on BIRD for the first time. Instead of complex AI agents, ReViSQL leverages reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on BIRD-Verified, a dataset we curated comprising 2.5k verified Text-to-SQL instances based on the BIRD Train set. To construct BIRD-Verified, we design a data correction and verification workflow involving SQL experts. We identified and corrected data errors in 61.1% of a subset of BIRD Train. By training on BIRD-Verified, we show that improving data quality alone boosts the single-generation accuracy by 8.2-13.9% under the same RLVR algorithm. To further enhance performance, ReViSQL performs inference-time scaling via execution-based reconciliation and majority voting. Empirically, we demonstrate the superiority of our framework with two model scales: ReViSQL-235B-A22B and ReViSQL-30B-A3B. On an expert-verified BIRD Mini-Dev set, ReViSQL-235B-A22B achieves 93.2% execution accuracy, exceeding the proxy human-level accuracy (92.96%) and outperforming the prior open-source SOTA method by 9.8%. Our lightweight ReViSQL-30B-A3B matches the prior SOTA at a 7.5$\times$ lower per-query cost.

AI.tldr: ReViSQL 证明：达到人类水平（92.96%）的 Text-to-SQL 不需要复杂的多阶段 AI Agent 流水线，而只需"干净的训练数据 + 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）"。作者构建了 BIRD-Platinum（2.5k 条经 SQL 专家多轮校验修正的 BIRD Train 实例，61.1% 实例含标注错误并被修正），并提出 ReViSQL-BIRD 奖励塑形方法（结合 VeriEQL 语义等价验证的 outcome reward + 针对外部知识使用的过程奖励）。最终 ReViSQL-BIRD-K2.6 在专家校验版 BIRD Mini-Dev 上首次达到人类水平：Arcwise-Plat-Full 贪心解码 93.8%、Arcwise-Plat-SQL 16 候选自一致性 93.0%，超过最强开源流水线 10–22%，且单查询成本更低。
AI.motivation: Text-to-SQL 是数据库研究与数据分析的核心问题。当前 SOTA 方法普遍依赖手工设计的多阶段 LLM 流水线（任务分解、schema linking、动态提示、迭代修订、候选选择器），但在 BIRD 榜单上仍比人类专家低 10% 以上，说明流水线工程已触及能力天花板。作者进一步指出被忽视的核心瓶颈：现有训练数据（BIRD Train、Spider2）普遍存在大量标注错误（审计发现超 50% 实例含错误），这些错误会给 RLVR 提供错误奖励信号，使模型学到错误逻辑（如缺失 DISTINCT、未处理 NULL、并列值处理错误等），从而限制 RLVR 上限。此外，标准基于执行结果的奖励在 Text-to-SQL 上本身存在系统性缺陷：语义不等价的 SQL 可能在样例库上产生相同结果（实测假阳性率高达 32.8%），且 outcome-only 奖励对"是否使用了外部知识（evidence）"毫无信号，导致模型系统性忽略外部知识、依赖预训练先验。因此动机是：把投入从"系统架构设计"转向"高质量数据治理 + 领域定制奖励塑形"。
AI.method: （1）BIRD-Platinum 数据构建：采用"LLM + 人类专家"混合五阶段流水线——Stage 1 用 o3 LLM 审查器（每实例最多 30 次 SQL 执行）标记错误并给出修正建议；Stage 2 专家在**未看到 LLM 报告前**先独立按检查清单排查，再融合 LLM 报告出修正草案；Stage 3 第二名专家独立复核，出现分歧交第三专家修订；Stage 4 冲突仲裁（三人共识）；Stage 5 自动测试（修正后结果非空、且与原查询结果不同）。配套 15 条检查清单（问题可答性/唯一解释/去重/非空/过滤条件有效性；外部知识相关性与一致性；SQL 的输出列、并列、去重、NULL、join、过滤、聚合分区、字符串泛化等）。错误分类学：问题与外部知识错误（不可答、空结果、evidence 与问题矛盾）、gold SQL 错误（10 类）、schema 错误、评分方法错误（补充 subset-based、list-based 标注）。共修正 52.1% 的 SQL、26.2% 的问题、18.2% 的外部知识，丢弃 1.5% 不可答实例。（2）ReViSQL 配方：GRPO 类 RLVR + CISPO 损失，LoRA rank 32，group size 16，batch 64，lr 5e-5，最多 5 轮 SQL 工具交互，每次最多 3072 token；多轮 rollout 中模型可调用 execute_sql_query 探索数据库。（3）ReViSQL-BIRD 奖励塑形：R = ρ(τ,a,β) − Σλ_k·1[violation_k]。其中 ρ 为验证感知 outcome reward：结果判对且 VeriEQL 判定等价/不支持则 1，VeriEQL 反驳等价则降权为 1−β（β=0.2）；过程奖励通过系统提示强制模型先输出"Requirement of external knowledge i"翻译块、再在提交 <solution> 前输出"Verification of external knowledge i"审计块，字符串级规则检测违规并扣 λ_k=0.1（最多 0.2，首轮直接作答时最多 0.1）。（4）评测与推理扩展：贪心解码 + 按执行结果分组的自一致性投票（温度 1、top-p 1，4–128 候选）；Spider2-Snow 上用 SQLGlot 做 SQLite→Snowflake 方言转换 + ReFoRCE 式 schema 裁剪以适配上下文窗口。
AI.result: （1）数据质量是主导因素：用 BIRD-Platinum 而非 BIRD Train 训练，在 Arcwise-Plat-SQL/-Full 上提升 13.9–17.1%，Spider2-SQLite/Snow 上提升 11.8%/14.0%（Qwen3-235B-A22B 基座）。反过来，用含错 BIRD Train 训练会使基座模型准确率下降 5.0–7.0%。消融显示：验证数据贡献 +5.0~7.2%，奖励塑形再贡献 +2.8~3.8%，并消除了验证数据遗留错误的 24.6–38.0%。（2）ReViSQL-BIRD-K2.6 在 Arcwise-Plat-Full 贪心解码达 93.8%（95% CI [91.3, 95.6]），在 Arcwise-Plat-SQL 用 16 候选自一致性达 93.0%（CI [90.4, 94.9]），人类水平 92.96% 落在置信区间内（单侧精确二项检验 p>0.05）；所有先前系统均显著低于人类（最接近的 OpenSearch 88.2%，p≈1.4e-5）。相比 OpenSearch（GPT-5.2）在 Plat-SQL/-Full 上高 8.4%/5.6%，且单查询成本低 37%。（3）ReViSQL-235B（贪心）在 Arcwise-Plat-SQL/-Full/Spider2-SQLite 上分别为 87.34%/88.75%/37.04%，优于或持平最强开源流水线（OpenSearch 82.93/88.15/34.07）且成本低 7–8×；Spider2-Snow 上自一致性 128 候选达 55.58%，超过 DeepSeek-671B 的 ReFoRCE/AutoLink 与 Qwen3-Coder-480B 的 Spider-Agent 0.7–24.5%。（4）过程奖励将"忽略外部知识"类失败从 24.2% 降到 4.3%。（5）失败分析：64 个残差失败中 69% 源于问题歧义（输出规范 20、聚合/过滤范围 15、实体映射 9），31% 为模型缺陷（schema/值接地 12、忽略外部知识 3、join/输出/聚合 5）。（6）方法诊断：结果奖励假阳性率 32.8%（28.8–38.4%，训练全程不下降）；LLM 审查器精度 90.6% 但召回仅 24.5%；首轮修正 16.2% 未通过复核，最多需 4 轮。
AI.conclusion: Text-to-SQL 的范式正在从"系统流水线设计"转向"高质量数据治理 + 领域定制 RLVR"。仅靠经过专家校验的数据（错误修复 61%）与针对领域失败模式塑形的奖励，即可让单个 LLM（Kimi-K2.6）首次在专家校验的 BIRD 变体上达到人类水平，且无需 schema linking、动态提示、迭代修订、候选选择等任何推理期额外模块；LLM 审查器虽高精度但低召回，说明人工专家复核不可替代；残差错误以问题歧义而非 SQL 生成缺陷为主，说明推理期自一致性扩展主要补偿输入歧义而非提升 SQL 推理能力；同时结果型奖励的语义等价性缺口需由 VeriEQL 等验证器与过程奖励补足。局限与展望：数据修正依赖多轮人工专家（成本高、覆盖仅 2.5k），VeriEQL 仅支持 SQLite 且会超时/不支持部分 SQL，故采用降权而非归零；后续可扩展至更大规模自动校验与更多方言/基准。

title: TTQ: Activation-Aware Test-Time Quantization to Accelerate LLM Inference On The Fly
summary: To tackle the huge computational demand of large foundation models, activation-aware compression techniques without retraining have been introduced. However, since these methods highly rely on calibration data, domain shift issues may arise for unseen downstream tasks. We propose a test-time quantization (TTQ) framework which compresses large models on the fly at inference time to resolve this issue. With an efficient online calibration, instant activation-aware quantization can adapt every prompt regardless of the downstream tasks, yet achieving inference speedup. Several experiments demonstrate that TTQ can improve the quantization performance over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对大型基础模型的巨大计算需求，提出一种无需重训练的训练时量化(TTQ)框架。该方法通过高效的在线校准，实现与下游任务无关的即时激活感知量化，在推理时动态压缩模型。
AI.motivation: 大型基础模型计算需求巨大，现有的激活感知压缩技术虽然无需重训练，但高度依赖校准数据，在面对未见过的下游任务时会出现领域偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出训练时量化(TTQ)框架，在推理时动态压缩大型模型。该方法具有高效的在线校准机制，实现即时激活感知量化，可针对任意提示词进行自适应，无需考虑下游任务领域。
AI.result: 实验表明，TTQ在量化性能上优于当前最先进的基线方法，并能实现推理加速。
AI.conclusion: TTQ框架能够有效解决领域偏移问题，在保持推理效率的同时提升量化效果，为大型模型的实时压缩提供了新的解决方案。

title: ItinBench: Benchmarking Planning Across Multiple Cognitive Dimensions with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) with advanced cognitive capabilities are emerging as agents for various reasoning and planning tasks. Traditional evaluations often focus on specific reasoning or planning questions within controlled environments. Recent studies have explored travel planning as a medium to integrate various verbal reasoning tasks into real-world contexts. However, reasoning tasks extend beyond verbal reasoning alone, and a comprehensive evaluation of LLMs requires a testbed that incorporates tasks from multiple cognitive domains. To address this gap, we introduce ItinBench, a benchmark that features one task of spatial reasoning, i.e., route optimization, into trip itinerary planning while keeping the traditional verbal reasoning tasks. ItinBench evaluates various LLMs across diverse tasks simultaneously, including Llama 3.1 8B, Mistral Large, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and GPT family. Our findings reveal that LLMs struggle to maintain high and consistent performance when concurrently handling multiple cognitive dimensions. By incorporating tasks from distinct human-level cognitive domains, ItinBench provides new insights into building more comprehensive reasoning testbeds that better reflect real-world challenges. The code and dataset: https://ethanwtl.github.io/IBweb/

AI.tldr: ItinBench 是一个以费城（及圣巴巴拉子集）真实 Yelp 数据为基础的单城旅行行程规划基准，将传统语言/逻辑/数学（言语推理）任务与空间推理子任务（POI 路线优化）整合进同一套评测体系，并对 Llama 3.1 8B、Mistral Large、Gemini 1.5 Pro、GPT-4o、o1 等模型进行评测与人类偏好对照。核心发现：LLM 在需要同时处理言语与空间两类认知维度时难以保持高水平与稳定性（可验证行程通过率最高仅 18%，额外无效路程约 15%–38%），且所谓"空间推理"的提升主要来自文本化的空间聚类线索，实质是语义捷径而非类人的空间认知。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 规划/推理基准多在受控环境中考察单一（主要是言语）推理域，评测设定固定、真值确定；近期的旅行规划基准（TravelPlanner、UnSatChristmas、ITINERA 等）虽引入真实数据与用户评论，但仍局限于语言、逻辑、数学等言语推理范畴。然而人类级认知还包含空间推理这一核心维度，它在导航、路线组织等规划任务中起关键作用，且其非符号属性与言语推理能力重叠度低。因此需要一个能同时评测多认知维度、且贴近真实场景的测试平台，用以回答两个问题：(1) 当空间推理嵌入复杂言语推理任务时，LLM 在空间子任务上的表现是否与言语子任务相当？(2) 同时处理言语与空间推理时是否存在性能权衡（trade-off）？
AI.method: 1) 数据管线：基于 Yelp Dataset（教育用途子集）与 Yelp Fusion API 构建费城基础数据（500 家餐厅、105 家酒店、322 个景点，含名称/地址/经纬度/星级/价格/菜系等），并对 49,972 条餐厅评论、4,804 条酒店评论、10,146 条景点评论用 LLM 按类别抽取属性评分（如餐厅口味/新鲜度/服务/环境/性价比；酒店质量/位置/服务/安全；景点家庭/历史/活动/自然/美食/购物），供后续偏好筛选；查询构造：从六大类偏好（天数、预算、景点倾向、餐厅偏好+菜系、酒店偏好）中按概率权重采样，每条查询含 6–10 项偏好，共生成 500 条类人查询。2) 生成管线与四类任务（温度 1，单次运行，API 推理）：Task1 全量数据+不要求路线优化（纯言语推理）；Task2 全量数据+要求路线优化；Task3 按偏好预过滤数据+路线优化（并以 k-means 给出文本化空间聚类信息，簇数=候选数/5）；Task4 工具使用+路线优化（ReAct 风格，提供 AccommodationSearch/AttractionSearch/RestaurantSearch/BusinessClusterSearch/Planner 五类工具）。3) 评测：言语维度用 Out-of-Pool、Missing Information、Micro、Macro（阈值 75%）与 Validated Rate；空间维度用 ARG、Day-wise Distance Gap、Total-DG（基于改造的多日多酒店 TSP 位掩码动态规划算法）与 Extra Cluster Jump。4) 基线：贪心（过滤+最小距离启发式）、A*（最小生成树启发式）、MIP（MTZ 割）。5) 补充人类评测：12 名志愿者（10 博士生+2 资深旅行者）、240 个数据点，比较同一查询下不同模型计划与同一模型不同任务设置下计划的偏好；另构建圣巴巴拉子集做跨城市稳健性检验。
AI.result: （1）言语推理：即便提供全部数据，可验证计划率（VR）最高仅 18%（o1），Out-of-Pool 最高 51%、Missing Information 最高 52%；给出预过滤数据后 VR 升至最高 66.7%（Mistral-large，Task3），说明 LLM 在多约束、多步骤场景下难以自主识别并应用规则。（2）空间推理：仅在提示中要求"优化路线"而不给空间线索时，Total-DG 无明显改善（约 25%）；一旦提供文本化聚类信息，Total-DG 降至约 15%、ECJ 从 >100% 降至约 50%，表明模型依赖语义文本操作而非真实几何空间计算；案例研究（GPT-4o 工具模式）显示其能在一级聚类层面正确配对，但无法判断簇 13 与簇 8/17 的远近关系，导致 Total-DG 25.6%、ECJ 100%。（3）双域权衡：o1 在显式要求路线优化时 Total-DG 约 7%–9%（最佳），但其言语 VR 相比领先模型下降约 20 个百分点；其他模型亦呈不同程度权衡。（4）工具使用：GPT-4o 与 Mistral Large 交付率 100%，Llama 3.1 8B 84.7%，Gemini 1.5 Pro 72%；参数准确率约 58%–63%；GPT-4o 错误集中于池外选择与餐厅/酒店相关偏好（这些偏好在查询中分布弥散）。（5）算法基线（A*、MIP）几乎满分，说明 LLM 的规划与推理能力仍有很大差距，且依赖人工先验的任务专用代码。（6）人类评测偏好率（GPT-4o 35.8%、Mistral 30.8%、Gemini 19.2%、Llama 14.2%；任务层面 Filtered 33.2%、ToolUse 30.5% > AllDataRoute 19.8% > AllDataNoRoute 20.5%）与 VR/Total-DG 自动指标趋势一致；圣巴巴拉子集结果趋势与主结果一致。
AI.conclusion: ItinBench 首次在真实旅行规划场景中把空间推理与言语推理纳入同一评测框架，并通过算法化（TSP）路线距离度量提供了可复现的跨模型、跨任务比较证据，弥补了既有旅行规划基准只覆盖言语推理的空白。结论性判断是：LLM 在多认知维度并发时难以保持高而稳定的规划表现，言语与空间能力之间存在明显权衡；更关键的是，模型在"空间推理"上的增益主要源自被文本化的空间关系线索与训练知识，属于语义捷径而非类人的空间认知，提示当前基准与模型可能是在"优化命题捷径"而非培育真实空间认知。未来工作应减少评测对语义捷径的依赖，探索直接操作地图、图结构、坐标等结构化空间表示的模型，并将基准扩展到多城市与可变约束场景，同时呼吁设计覆盖更完整空间规划能力（不限于旅行场景）的基准。

title: Revealing Domain-Spatiality Patterns for Configuration Tuning: Domain Knowledge Meets Fitness Landscapes
comment: Accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
summary: Configuration tuning for better performance is crucial in quality assurance. Yet, there has long been a mystery on tuners' effectiveness, due to the black-box nature of configurable systems. Prior efforts predominantly adopt static domain analysis (e.g., static taint analysis), which often lacks generalizability, or dynamic data analysis (e.g., benchmarking performance analysis), limiting explainability. In this work, we embrace Fitness Landscape Analysis (FLA) as a bridge between domain knowledge and difficulty of the tuning. We propose Domland, a two-pronged methodology that synergizes the spatial information obtained from FLA and domain-driven analysis to systematically capture the hidden characteristics of configuration tuning cases, explaining how and why a tuner might succeed or fail. This helps to better interpret and contextualize the behavior of tuners and inform tuner design. To evaluate Domland, we conduct a case study of nine software systems and 93 workloads, from which we reveal several key findings: (1) configuration landscapes are inherently system-specific, with no single domain factor (e.g., system area, programming language, or resource intensity) consistently shaping their structure; (2) the core options (e.g., pic-struct of x264), which control the main functional flows, exert a stronger influence on landscape ruggedness (i.e. the difficulty of tuning) compared to resource options (e.g., cpu-independent of x264); (3) Workload effects on landscape structure are not uniformly tied to type or scale. Both contribute to landscape variations, but their impact is system-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Domland方法，结合Fitness Landscape Analysis (FLA)和领域驱动分析来解释配置调优的成功或失败原因。通过对9个软件系统和93个工作负载的案例研究，发现配置景观具有系统特异性，核心选项对景观ruggedness的影响大于资源选项，且工作负载影响具有系统依赖性。
AI.motivation: 配置调优对质量保证至关重要，但由于可配置系统的黑盒性质，调优器的有效性一直难以解释。先前的方法要么缺乏通用性（静态分析），要么解释性有限（动态数据分析）。
AI.method: 提出Domland方法，协同利用FLA获取的空间信息和领域驱动分析，系统性地捕捉配置调优案例的隐藏特征，从而解释调优器成功或失败的原因。
AI.result: (1) 配置景观具有内在的系统特异性，没有单一的领域因素（如系统区域、编程语言或资源强度）一致地塑造其结构； (2) 核心选项（如x264的pic-struct）比资源选项（如x264的cpu-independent）对景观ruggedness（调优难度）有更强的影力； (3) 工作负载对景观结构的影响与类型或规模不均匀相关，两者都贡献于景观变化，但影响因系统而异。
AI.conclusion: FLA可以作为连接领域知识和调优难度之间的桥梁，帮助更好地解释和 contextualize 调优器的行为，并为调优器设计提供信息。

title: A Super Fast K-means for Indexing Vector Embeddings
summary: We present SuperKMeans: a k-means variant designed for clustering collections of high-dimensional vector embeddings. SuperKMeans' clustering is up to 7x faster than FAISS and Scikit-Learn on modern CPUs and up to 4x faster than cuVS on GPUs (Figure 1), while maintaining the quality of the resulting centroids for vector similarity search tasks. SuperKMeans acceleration comes from reducing data-access and compute overhead by reliably and efficiently pruning dimensions that are not needed to assign a vector to a centroid. Furthermore, we present Early Termination by Recall, a novel mechanism that early-terminates k-means when the quality of the centroids for retrieval tasks stops improving across iterations. In practice, this further reduces runtimes without compromising retrieval quality. We open-source our implementation at https://github.com/cwida/SuperKMeans

AI.tldr: SuperKMeans是一种针对高维向量嵌入聚类设计的k-means变体，通过高效剪枝不需要的维度来加速聚类过程，比FAISS、Scikit-Learn快7倍，比cuVS(GPU)快4倍，同时引入"Recall早停机制"进一步优化性能。
AI.motivation: k-means算法在处理高维向量嵌入聚类时计算开销大、效率低，现有方法（如FAISS、cuVS）在速度和效率上无法满足大规模向量相似性搜索任务的需求。
AI.method: 通过可靠高效地剪枝不需要用于将向量分配到质心的维度来减少数据访问和计算开销；提出"按召回率早停"(Early Termination by Recall)机制，当质心在检索任务中的质量停止改善时提前终止迭代。
AI.result: 在现代CPU上比FAISS和Scikit-Learn快7倍，在GPU上比cuVS快4倍，同时保持向量相似性搜索任务的质心质量。早停机制进一步缩短运行时间而不影响检索质量。
AI.conclusion: SuperKMeans通过维度剪枝和早停机制实现了显著的性能提升，为大规模向量嵌入聚类提供了高效且高质量的解决方案，相关实现已开源。

title: CLaRE-ty Amid Chaos: Quantifying Representational Entanglement to Predict Ripple Effects in LLM Editing
summary: The static knowledge representations of large language models (LLMs) inevitably become outdated or incorrect over time. While model-editing techniques offer a promising solution by modifying a model's factual associations, they often produce unpredictable ripple effects, which are unintended behavioral changes that propagate even to the hidden space. In this work, we introduce CLaRE, a lightweight representation-level technique to identify where these ripple effects may occur. Unlike prior gradient-based methods, CLaRE quantifies entanglement between facts using forward activations from a single intermediate layer, avoiding costly backward passes. To enable systematic study, we prepare and analyse a corpus of 11,427 facts drawn from three existing datasets. Using CLaRE, we compute large-scale entanglement graphs of this corpus for multiple models, capturing how local edits propagate through representational space. These graphs enable stronger preservation sets for model editing, audit trails, efficient red-teaming, and scalable post-edit evaluation. In comparison to baselines, CLaRE achieves an average of 62.2% improvement in Spearman correlation with ripple effects while being $2.74\times$ faster, and using $2.85\times$ less peak GPU memory. Besides, CLaRE requires only a fraction of the storage needed by the baselines to compute and preserve fact representations. Our entanglement graphs and corpus are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLaRE-488E.

AI.tldr: CLaRE是一种轻量级的表示层方法，用于识别大型语言模型中模型编辑产生的"涟漪效应"（ripple effects）。该方法通过单个中间层的前向激活来量化事实之间的纠缠程度，避免了代价高昂的反向传播。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的静态知识表示会随时间变得过时或不准确。虽然模型编辑技术可以修改模型的事实关联，但往往会产生不可预测的涟漪效应——即意外的行为变化会传播到隐藏空间。
AI.method: CLaRE利用单个中间层的前向激活来量化事实之间的纠缠程度，避免了梯度方法中代价高昂的反向传播。研究团队构建了包含11,427个事实的语料库（来自三个现有数据集），并为多个模型计算了大规模纠缠图，捕捉局部编辑如何通过表示空间传播。
AI.result: 与基线方法相比，CLaRE在Spearman相关性上平均提升62.2%，同时速度快2.74倍，峰值GPU内存减少2.85倍，且只需基线方法所需存储的一小部分即可计算和保存事实表示。
AI.conclusion: CLaRE能够实现更强的编辑 Preservation sets、审计追踪、高效的红队测试和可扩展的编辑后评估，为模型编辑领域提供了新的研究方向。

title: PA2D-MORL: Pareto Ascent Directional Decomposition based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) provides an effective solution for decision-making problems involving conflicting objectives. However, achieving high-quality approximations to the Pareto policy set remains challenging, especially in complex tasks with continuous or high-dimensional state-action space.
