In this paper, we propose the Pareto Ascent Directional Decomposition based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (PA2D-MORL) method, which constructs an efficient scheme for multi-objective problem decomposition and policy improvement, leading to a superior approximation of Pareto policy set. The proposed method leverages Pareto ascent direction to select the scalarization weights and computes the multi-objective policy gradient, which determines the policy optimization direction and ensures joint improvement on all objectives. Meanwhile, multiple policies are selectively optimized under an evolutionary framework to approximate the Pareto frontier from different directions. Additionally, a Pareto adaptive fine-tuning approach is applied to enhance the density and spread of the Pareto frontier approximation. Experiments on various multi-objective robot control tasks show that the proposed method clearly outperforms the current state-of-the-art algorithm in terms of both quality and stability of the outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PA2D-MORL方法，利用Pareto ascent direction分解多目标问题并指导策略优化，在进化框架下选择性优化多个策略以逼近Pareto前沿，并通过自适应微调增强Pareto前沿的稠密性和分布性，在多目标机器人控制任务上优于现有最优算法。
AI.motivation: 多目标强化学习在处理冲突目标时面临挑战，特别是在连续或高维状态-动作空间的复杂任务中，难以获得高质量的Pareto策略集近似。
AI.method: 1) 利用Pareto ascent direction选择标量化权重；2) 计算多目标策略梯度确定策略优化方向；3) 在进化框架下选择性优化多个策略；4) 采用Pareto自适应微调方法增强前沿稠密性和分布性。
AI.result: 在多种多目标机器人控制任务上的实验表明，该方法在结果质量和稳定性方面均显著优于当前最先进算法。
AI.conclusion: PA2D-MORL方法能够有效分解多目标问题并指导策略优化，实现Pareto策略集的高质量逼近，为复杂多目标决策问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Teaching Practically Relevant Research Problem Formulation in Software Engineering with Lean Research Inception
summary: [Background] Well-formulated Software Engineering (SE) research problems are essential for bridging the gap between industry-academia. Lean Research Inception (LRI) aims to support this activity. [Goal] Apply LRI to support SE students in formulating practice-aligned research problems. [Method] We conducted a case study with 60 students and 7 faculty advisors of a Brazilian university. [Results] Students reported benefits in reasoning (60%), clarity and definition (61.7%), contextualization (60%), and communication (50%). Advisors also observed clearer and more structured problems (57.1%) with a high recommendation rate (85.7%). [Conclusion] LRI can be a promising approach to support practice-aligned research problem formulation in SE education.

AI.tldr: 本研究将Lean Research Inception (LRI)方法应用于软件工程教育，帮助学生制定与实践相结合的研究问题。通过在巴西某大学对60名学生和7名导师的案例研究，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 软件工程(SE)研究中，良好表述的研究问题对于弥合产业与学术界的差距至关重要，但学生往往缺乏有效的方法来制定实践导向的研究问题。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，在巴西某大学对60名软件工程学生和7名教师导师进行实验，应用Lean Research Inception (LRI)方法支持学生制定研究问题。
AI.result: 学生方面：推理能力提升60%、清晰度和定义改善61.7%、情境化能力提高60%、沟通能力提升50%。导师方面：观察到更清晰(57.1%)和更结构化的问题，推荐率高达85.7%。
AI.conclusion: LRI可能成为软件工程教育中支持学生制定实践导向研究问题的有效方法，具有较好的应用前景。

title: A Dynamic Bayesian and Machine Learning Framework for Quantitative Evaluation and Prediction of Operator Situation Awareness in Nuclear Power Plants
summary: Operator situation awareness is a pivotal yet elusive determinant of human reliability in complex nuclear control environments. Existing assessment methods, such as SAGAT and SART, remain static, retrospective, and detached from the evolving cognitive dynamics that drive operational risk. To overcome these limitations, this study introduces the dynamic Bayesian machine learning framework for situation awareness (DBML SA), a unified approach that fuses probabilistic reasoning and data driven intelligence to achieve quantitative, interpretable, and predictive situation awareness modeling. Leveraging 212 operational event reports (2007 to 2021), the framework reconstructs the causal temporal structure of 11 performance shaping factors across multiple cognitive layers. The Bayesian component enables time evolving inference of situation awareness reliability under uncertainty, while the neural component establishes a nonlinear predictive mapping from PSFs to SART scores, achieving a mean absolute percentage error of 13.8 % with statistical consistency to subjective evaluations (p > 0.05). Results highlight training quality and stress dynamics as primary drivers of situation awareness degradation. Overall, DBML SA transcends traditional questionnaire-based assessments by enabling real-time cognitive monitoring, sensitivity analysis, and early-warning prediction, paving the way toward intelligent human machine reliability management in next-generation digital main control rooms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DBML SA框架，结合贝叶斯推理与机器学习实现核电站操作员态势感知的定量、可解释和预测性建模。基于212份运行事件报告，该方法重建了11个性能 shaping factors的因果时间结构，在预测任务中达到13.8%的平均绝对百分比误差，且与主观评估具有统计一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有态势感知评估方法（如SAGAT和SART）存在静态性、回顾性缺陷，无法捕捉复杂核控制环境中动态演变的认知过程，因而需要一种能够实时推理、可预测的动态建模方法。
AI.method: DBML SA框架包含两个核心组件：（1）贝叶斯组件——对11个性能 shaping factors在多个认知层面进行因果时间结构重建，实现不确定性下的时变态势感知可靠性推断；（2）神经组件——建立从PSFs到SART分数的非线性预测映射。
AI.result: 框架达到13.8%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），与主观评估具有统计一致性（p > 0.05）。研究结果表明培训质量和压力动态是态势感知降级的主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: DBML SA框架超越了传统问卷评估方法，实现了实时认知监控、敏感性分析和早期预警预测，为下一代数字化主控室中的人机可靠性智能管理奠定了基础。

title: PowerLens: Taming LLM Agents for Safe and Personalized Mobile Power Management
summary: Battery life remains a critical challenge for mobile devices, yet existing power management mechanisms rely on static rules or coarse-grained heuristics that ignore user activities and personal preferences. We present PowerLens, a system that tames the reasoning power of Large Language Models (LLMs) for safe and personalized mobile power management on Android devices. The key idea is that LLMs' commonsense reasoning can bridge the semantic gap between user activities and system parameters, enabling zero-shot, context-aware policy generation that adapts to individual preferences through implicit feedback. PowerLens employs a multi-agent architecture that recognizes user context from UI semantics and generates holistic power policies across 18 device parameters. A PDL-based constraint framework verifies every action before execution, while a two-tier memory system learns individualized preferences from implicit user overrides through confidence-based distillation, requiring no explicit configuration and converging within 3--5 days. Extensive experiments on a rooted Android device show that PowerLens achieves 81.7% action accuracy and 38.8% energy saving over stock Android, outperforming rule-based and LLM-based baselines, with high user satisfaction, fast preference convergence, and strong safety guarantees, with the system itself consuming only 0.5% of daily battery capacity.

AI.tldr: PowerLens是一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的Android设备个性化电源管理系统，通过多智能体架构实现上下文感知的零样本策略生成，在保证安全的前提下实现38.8%的能耗节省。
AI.motivation: 移动设备电池续航是关键挑战，现有电源管理机制依赖静态规则或粗粒度启发式方法，忽视了用户活动和个性化偏好。
AI.method: 提出PowerLens系统，采用多智能体架构从UI语义识别用户上下文，生成覆盖18个设备参数的电源策略。使用PDL(策略描述语言)约束框架验证每条执行前的操作，通过两层记忆系统从隐式用户反馈中学习个性化偏好，采用置信度蒸馏实现无需显式配置的偏好收敛。
AI.result: 在rooted Android设备上实验表明：动作准确率达81.7%，相比原生Android节省38.8%能耗，优于基于规则和LLM的基线方法；偏好收敛仅需3-5天；系统自身仅消耗0.5%的日均电量。
AI.conclusion: PowerLens通过LLM的常识推理弥合了用户活动与系统参数间的语义鸿沟，实现了零样本上下文感知策略生成，具有高用户满意度、快速偏好收敛和强安全性保证。

title: Orchestrating Human-AI Software Delivery: A Retrospective Longitudinal Field Study of Three Software Modernization Programs
summary: Evidence on AI in software engineering still leans heavily toward individual task completion, while evidence on team-level delivery remains scarce. We report a retrospective longitudinal field study of Chiron, an industrial platform that coordinates humans and AI agents across four delivery stages: analysis, planning, implementation, and validation. The study covers three real software modernization programs -- a COBOL banking migration (~30k LOC), a large accounting modernization (~400k LOC), and a .NET/Angular mortgage modernization (~30k LOC) -- observed across five delivery configurations: a traditional baseline and four successive platform versions (V1--V4). The benchmark separates observed outcomes (stage durations, task volumes, validation-stage issues, first-release coverage) from modeled outcomes (person-days and senior-equivalent effort under explicit staffing scenarios). Under baseline staffing assumptions, portfolio totals move from 36.0 to 9.3 summed project-weeks; modeled raw effort falls from 1080.0 to 232.5 person-days; modeled senior-equivalent effort falls from 1080.0 to 139.5 SEE-days; validation-stage issue load falls from 8.03 to 2.09 issues per 100 tasks; and first-release coverage rises from 77.0% to 90.5%. V3 and V4 add acceptance-criteria validation, repository-native review, and hybrid human-agent execution, simultaneously improving speed, coverage, and issue load. The evidence supports a central thesis: the largest gains appear when AI is embedded in an orchestrated workflow rather than deployed as an isolated coding assistant.

AI.tldr: 本文对工业级人机协同交付平台 Chiron 开展回顾性纵向现场研究，覆盖三个真实软件现代化项目（COBOL 银行迁移约3万行、ACAS 会计平台约40万行、.NET/Angular 按揭系统约3万行）与五种交付配置（传统基线 + 平台 V1–V4）。核心结论：AI 的最大收益出现在被嵌入"编排式"端到端交付工作流时，而非作为孤立的编码助手。与传统基线相比，V4 组合计工期由 36.0 周降至 9.3 周（3.87倍加速），建模人天由 1080 降至 232.5，资深等效人天（SEE-days）由 1080 降至 139.5，验证阶段问题负载由每百任务 8.03 降至 2.09，首版需求覆盖率由 77.0% 升至 90.5%。研究为观察性、回顾性、单一组织范围，结论应作描述性而非因果性解读。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 赋能软件工程的实证证据高度集中于个体任务级代码生成与仓库级缺陷修复（如 SWE-bench、SWE-agent），而团队级/项目级交付绩效的证据相对稀缺。软件生产率本身是多维度的，无法用单一代理指标概括；一个现代软件项目需要经历技术理解、计划、分解、实现、验证、评审与发布协调。因此本文关注的管理与科学问题是：当 AI 智能体被嵌入混合人机团队使用的端到端交付工作流时会发生什么？已有文献也提示：项目级协调成本可能不与个体生产率增益同步变动，仓库级智能体研究强调脚手架、接口、上下文管理与验证闭环的重要性，长流程智能体系统中分解与局部纠错随工作流长度增加而愈发关键。作者的贡献定位是描述性、系统级的，而非因果归因。
AI.method:
设计：回顾性纵向现场研究（retrospective longitudinal field study），观察单元为"项目–版本"单元 (p,v)，共 3 个项目 × 5 种配置 = 15 个单元；版本为同一平台家族的连续演进配置而非独立重复实验，故不采用显著性检验，仅报告描述性效应量与敏感性分析。
数据来源：工程记录与从业者回忆的事后重构（缺乏单元级 provenance 矩阵），因此按最保守口径解读为工业现场研究而非统一遥测的仪器化基准。
测量阶段：分析、计划、实现、验证四阶段（部署阶段因跨版本不一致而排除），τ_{p,v,s} 为阶段时长（周），T_{p,v} 为其求和。
观测指标：总时长 T、任务数 N、进入下游验证的问题数 I、首次发布覆盖率 C∈[0,1]。因智能体配置产生更细粒度的待办列表，原始问题数不可直接跨版本比较，故采用工作负载归一化逃逸指标 L = 100×I/N（每百任务验证阶段问题负载，解释为"缺陷逃逸到验证阶段"而非内在缺陷密度）。组合覆盖率按任务量加权：C̄_v = Σ C_{p,v}N_{p,v} / Σ N_{p,v}。
建模指标（非直接劳动工时日志）：原始人天 E^raw = 5·h_v·T，其中 h_传统=6（1架构+2后端+1前端+2QA），h_V1–V4=5（1资深架构+2初级AI操作员+2初级QA）；资深等效人天 E^SEE = 5·σ_v·T，σ_传统=6、σ_智能体=3（初级计为0.5资深等效）。
稳健性策略三项：(1) 展示项目级轨迹而非仅组合总量；(2) 除与传统基线对比外，还与 V1（个人化、无编排的智能体使用）对比，以解耦人员构成；(3) 敏感性分析：初级-资深权重 w∈{0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0}（智能体团队记为 1+4w SEE），以及留一项目（leave-one-project-out）组合聚合。V4 独有预验证问题计数，用于估算评审阶段缺陷遏制率。
AI.result:
组合层面（Table 3）：传统基线 36.0 周 / 1080 人天 / 1080 SEE 天 / 8.03 问题每百任务 / 77.0% 覆盖；V1 28.6 周 / 715 / 429 / 8.63 / 52.6%；V2 26.4 周 / 660 / 396 / 8.17 / 57.6%；V3 13.8 周 / 345 / 207 / 4.19 / 83.4%；V4 9.3 周 / 232.5 / 139.5 / 2.09 / 90.5%。相对基线，V4 工期降 74.2%（3.87倍加速），原始人天降 78.5%，SEE 天降 87.1%，问题负载降 74.0%，覆盖率 +13.4pp。
轨迹呈"两段式"：V1/V2 仅在分析、计划阶段压缩速度，问题负载与覆盖率反而劣于基线（"速度优先"系统）；V3/V4 引入验收标准校验、仓库原生评审、混合人机执行后，速度、质量、覆盖率同步改善。V1→V4 对比（两者人员配置相同，故增益非由人员构成驱动）：加速 3.08倍，时间/原始人天/SEE 天均降 67.5%，问题负载降 75.8%，覆盖率 +37.9pp。
阶段级行为（Fig.4，V4/传统比值）：压缩最一致出现在分析与计划（Bank 分析 2.0→0.2 周、计划 2.0→0.2；ACAS 分析 5.0→0.8、计划 3.0→0.6；Mortgage 分析 1.5→0.2、计划 1.0→0.2），即减少的是"达到工程就绪"的时间而非仅"产出代码"的时间；实现与验证也缩短但更不均匀，因其更贴近代码库、测试框架与缺陷面。
评审阶段遏制（V4 独有）：预验证问题 Bank 40/20、ACAS 188/90、Mortgage 23/12，遏制率分别为 50.0%、52.1%、47.8%，组合加权约 51.4%，说明 V4 同时改善"产出质量"与"缺陷发现位置"（把发现从晚期验证前移至更廉价的评审）。
敏感性：初级权重 w 从 0.25 到 1.0，V4 SEE 天为 93.0→232.5，相对基线降幅 91.4%→78.5%，即便初级按 1.0 资深计算仍降 78.5%，结论不唯一依赖 w=0.5。留一项目：时长比 0.243–0.275、问题负载比 0.255–0.291、覆盖率变化 +7.8 至 +14.3pp，结果稳健。
每项目趋势一致：Bank 问题负载 8.75→2.50、覆盖 80%→90%；ACAS 8.00→2.00、覆盖 75%→90%；Mortgage 7.33→2.18、覆盖 90%→95%。
AI.conclusion: 在单一组织内、跨三个现代化项目、更编排化的人机交付配置与显著更短的交付时间、更低的验证阶段问题逃逸负载、更高的首版覆盖率以及更低的建模人力负担相关联，且效应量大、方向在三个项目上一致。最大收益出现在智能体被嵌入结合任务分解、验收标准校验、仓库原生评审与混合人机执行的端到端编排工作流之后，而非仅作为孤立编码助手（V1 已含局部智能体使用但并非最优配置）。论文给出对AI评测领域的三条方法论建议：区分观测指标与建模指标、按阶段分层报告下游质量（评审/验证/发布后）、谨慎选择分母（任务粒度会随干预变化，"每任务归一化"有用但不完美）。局限与有效性威胁：回顾性重构且缺少 provenance 表、单一组织与单一平台家族、版本为连续演进而非消融实验、任务粒度漂移、观测到的问题不等于总缺陷、覆盖率仅为发布就绪度指标而不含发布后收敛与全生命周期成本、建模人天依赖人员假设。作者均为开发 Chiron 的 Taller Technologies 高管，存在利益冲突，已通过披露、避免因果语言与敏感性分析缓解，但无独立外部审计；结论应视为工业现场报告。若能在更强仪器化与更广项目覆盖下复现，将支持AI在软件工程评测范式上从孤立代码生成事件转向编排式交付系统的设计与测量。

title: PRIME-CVD: A Parametrically Rendered Informatics Medical Environment for Education in Cardiovascular Risk Modelling
summary: In recent years, progress in medical informatics and machine learning has been accelerated by the availability of openly accessible benchmark datasets. However, patient-level electronic medical record (EMR) data are rarely available for teaching or methodological development due to privacy, governance, and re-identification risks. This has limited reproducibility, transparency, and hands-on training in cardiovascular risk modelling. Here we introduce PRIME-CVD, a parametrically rendered informatics medical environment designed explicitly for medical education. PRIME-CVD comprises two openly accessible synthetic data assets representing a cohort of 50,000 adults undergoing primary prevention for cardiovascular disease. The datasets are generated entirely from a user-specified causal directed acyclic graph parameterised using publicly available Australian population statistics and published epidemiologic effect estimates, rather than from patient-level EMR data or trained generative models. Data Asset 1 provides a clean, analysis-ready cohort suitable for exploratory analysis, stratification, and survival modelling, while Data Asset 2 restructures the same cohort into a relational, EMR-style database with realistic structural and lexical heterogeneity. Together, these assets enable instruction in data cleaning, harmonisation, causal reasoning, and policy-relevant risk modelling without exposing sensitive information. Because all individuals and events are generated de novo, PRIME-CVD preserves realistic subgroup imbalance and risk gradients while ensuring negligible disclosure risk. PRIME-CVD is released under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence to support reproducible research and scalable medical education.

AI.tldr: PRIME-CVD是一个用于医学教育的合成心血管疾病数据集，包含50,000名成年人数据，分为两个版本：清洁的分析就绪队列和关系型EMR风格数据库。该数据集解决了医学教育中真实患者数据稀缺的难题。
AI.motivation: 由于隐私、治理和重识别风险，患者水平的电子病历数据很少公开可用，这限制了心血管风险建模的可重复性、透明度和实践培训。
AI.method: 数据完全从用户指定的因果有向无环图生成，使用公开的澳大利亚人群统计数据和已发表的流行病学效应估计进行参数化，而非来自患者水平的EMR数据或训练生成模型。
AI.result: 生成了两个合成数据资产：数据资产1提供清洁、分析就绪的队列，适用于探索性分析、分层和生存建模；数据资产2将同一队列重构为关系型EMR风格数据库，具有现实的结构和词汇异质性。两个数据集都保留了真实的亚组不平衡和风险梯度，同时确保可忽略的披露风险。
AI.conclusion: PRIME-CVD以知识共享署名4.0许可证发布，支持心血管风险建模的可重复研究和可扩展医学教育，无需暴露敏感信息。

title: HyEvo: Self-Evolving Hybrid Agentic Workflows for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Although agentic workflows have demonstrated strong potential for solving complex tasks, existing automated generation methods remain inefficient and underperform, as they rely on predefined operator libraries and homogeneous LLM-only workflows in which all task-level computation is performed through probabilistic inference. To address these limitations, we propose HyEvo, an automated workflow-generation framework that leverages heterogeneous atomic synthesis. HyEvo integrates probabilistic LLM nodes for semantic reasoning with deterministic code nodes for rule-based execution, offloading predictable operations from LLM inference and reducing inference cost and execution latency. To efficiently navigate the hybrid search space, HyEvo employs an LLM-driven multi-island evolutionary strategy with a reflect-then-generate mechanism, iteratively refining both workflow topology and node logic via execution feedback. Comprehensive experiments show that HyEvo consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse reasoning and coding benchmarks, while reducing inference cost and execution latency by up to 19$\times$ and 16$\times$, respectively, compared to the state-of-the-art open-source baseline.

AI.tldr: HyEvo是一个自动化工作流生成框架，通过异构原子合成方法，将概率性LLM节点与确定性代码节点结合，解决现有智能体工作流生成方法效率低下的问题。该框架采用LLM驱动的多岛屿进化策略，通过"先反思后生成"机制迭代优化工作流拓扑和节点逻辑。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化工作流生成方法存在两个主要局限：1) 依赖预定义的算子库，灵活性不足；2) 使用同质化LLM-only工作流，所有任务级计算都通过概率推理完成，导致效率低下。因此需要一种能够结合不同类型节点并高效搜索异构工作流空间的方法。
AI.method: 1) 异构原子合成：整合用于语义推理的概率LLM节点和用于规则化执行的确定性代码节点，将可预测操作从LLM推理中卸载；2) LLM驱动的多岛屿进化策略：高效探索混合搜索空间；3) 反射-生成机制：通过执行反馈迭代优化工作流拓扑和节点逻辑。
AI.result: 在多种推理和编码基准测试中一致优于现有方法；与最先进的开源基线相比，推理成本降低高达19倍，执行延迟降低高达16倍。
AI.conclusion: HyEvo通过异构原子合成和进化策略成功实现了高效的工作流自动生成，显著降低了LLM推理成本和执行延迟，为智能体工作流自动化提供了新的研究方向。

title: Agentic Harness for Real-World Compilers
summary: Compilers are critical to modern computing, yet fixing compiler bugs is difficult. While recent large language model (LLM) advancements enable automated bug repair, compiler bugs pose unique challenges due to their complexity, deep cross-domain expertise requirements, and sparse, non-descriptive bug reports, necessitating compiler-specific tools. To bridge the gap, we introduce llvm-autofix, the first agentic harness designed to assist LLM agents in understanding and fixing compiler bugs. Our focus is on LLVM, one of the most widely used compiler infrastructures. Central to llvm-autofix are agent-friendly LLVM tools, a benchmark llvm-bench of reproducible LLVM bugs, and a tailored minimal agent llvm-autofix-mini for fixing LLVM bugs. Our evaluation demonstrates a performance decline of 60% in frontier models when tackling compiler bugs compared with common software bugs. Our minimal agent llvm-autofix-mini also outperforms the state-of-the-art by approximately 22%. This emphasizes the necessity for specialized harnesses like ours to close the loop between LLMs and compiler engineering. We believe this work establishes a foundation for advancing LLM capabilities in complex systems like compilers. GitHub: https://github.com/dtcxzyw/llvm-autofix

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向编译器（聚焦 LLVM 中端）的智能体框架 llvm-harness，包含三部分：面向智能体的 LLVM 专用工具集、包含 334 个可复现 LLVM 中端 bug 的基准 llvm-bench（含 229 题的 live 子集）、以及四阶段定制智能体 llvm-autofix-mini。评测显示：前沿模型在编译器 bug 上的解决率相比 SWE-bench Verified 平均下降约 60%；加入该框架后 mini-SWE-agent 提升 62%；定制智能体再超基线约 22%（GPT 5 达 51.5%）。专家评审表明真正有效的修复率始终低于 21%，并归纳出 ChangeAssert、WrongLocalization、WrongFix 三类错误。
AI.motivation: 编译器是现代计算的基础设施，但修复编译器 bug 极为困难：与普通软件（如 Django）相比，编译器 bug 只有精简的复现程序（reproducer）、栈回溯或反例，缺乏自然语言描述；且需掌握 IR 设计、类型系统、词法/语法分析、优化 Pass 等跨领域专家知识（往往需数年积累）。现有 SWE-bench / SWE-agent 类通用框架仅把 LLM 接到 bash 工具上，难以应对此类任务。另一方面，LLM 用于自动修复系统软件（如 Linux 内核）已显示出潜力，但缺少针对编译器的专用工具与可复现基准。因此本文旨在构建打通 LLM 与编译器工程闭环的专用 harness 与基准。
AI.method:
1) llvm-harness 工具链按功能分六类：Setup & Build（按 commit/target 构建带调试与断言的 LLVM）、Reproduce & Cause（用 opt 复现，崩溃类给出裁剪后的栈回溯，误编译类用 alive-tv 做翻译验证并给出反例）、Explore & Debug（grep/find 静态检索 + gdb 断点暂停、读变量、表达式求值的动态调试）、Edit & Patch（编辑/预览/回滚/提交，并检查是否越界修改前端后端）、Test & Validate（重建后跑 reproducer 与组件级回归测试，如 InstCombine/SLPVectorizer，配合 llvm-lit/FileCheck 与差分测试）、Benchmark & Evaluate（自动输出补丁、错误、成本与轨迹）。
2) llvm-bench 基准自动化构建三阶段：Issue 收集（GitHub 已修复 issue + fixing commit，提取类型、修复 commit、reproducer、golden patch、base commit、元数据）；reproducer 验证（在 base commit 上必须复现）；golden patch 验证（必须通过全部测试）。334 个可复现 issue（222 崩溃 / 112 误编译），覆盖 64 个直接受影响组件、176 个间接受影响组件，共 937 个 C++ 文件、67.6 万行代码；平均每题 1.4 个 reproducer、722 条组件回归测试、1 万余条其他组件回归测试；golden patch 平均改 17.1 行、1.6 函数、1.2 文件。按修复范围分 easy(255, 76.3%)/medium(44, 13.2%)/hard(35, 10.5%)；并维护近一年 issue 组成的 live 子集（229 题）以缓解数据泄漏。约一半开发者原始补丁需经评审修改后才被接受。
3) llvm-autofix-mini 采用 Setup→Reason→Generate→Validate 四阶段：Setup 验证复现、以 gdb 在关键断点（崩溃前函数／首次变换处）暂停并推断出错组件；Reason 为 ReAct 循环，利用 debug/eval/code/docs 等做根因分析；Generate 为第二个 ReAct 循环，利用 edit/reset/test 在线迭代打补丁；Validate 做离线全量测试，输出 passed patch。
4) 对照设置：以 mini-SWE-agent（Bash Only 模式，额外注入复现、test 工具与后置验证）为基线，评测 GPT 4o、GPT 5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Qwen 3 Max、DeepSeek V3.2，temperature 0、64K 上下文、500 轮、5M token、25 次 edit/25 次 test；指标为 pass@1 的 %Passed，并由一名在职 LLVM 维护者对全部通过补丁做人工评审给出 %Valid。
AI.result:
1) 难度落差：在 llvm-bench live 上，mini-SWE-agent 的 %Passed 平均 17.2%，相比 SWE-bench Verified 平均下降 60.2%（各模型下降 35%–83%）；最佳模型 DeepSeek V3.2 为 38.9%（easy 43.0%/medium 32.4%/hard 17.4%），Gemini 2.5 Pro 仅 9.2%，GPT 5 21.0%，Qwen 3 Max 24.4%，GPT 4o 8.3%。
2) harness 有效性：移除 llvm-harness 专属资源后，DeepSeek V3.2 从 38.9% 降至 24.0%（额外下降 38%），即 harness 带来 62% 提升；easy/medium 分别提升 64%/85%，hard 无提升；误编译类受益幅度大于崩溃类。
3) 定制智能体：llvm-autofix-mini 平均为 mini-SWE-agent 的 1.22 倍（GPT 5 51.5%，较基线 +145%；Gemini 2.5 Pro +57%、Qwen 3 Max +47%、GPT 4o +47%；DeepSeek V3.2 例外下降 73%，因其不遵循工具调用格式、>85% 失败因超 token 预算）。McNemar 单侧检验（α=0.05）确认 GPT 5/Gemini/Qwen 提升显著（GPT 5 p<0.00005）。
4) 专家评审：llvm-autofix-mini 产出有效补丁多 38%（原优势 22%），有效占通过补丁比例高 24%；但真正解决率极低——最佳组合（GPT 5 + llvm-autofix-mini）仅 20.1%，其余组合多低于 15%（7/10 低于 9%），hard 拆分仅 GPT 5 解出 1 题；误编译有效率低于崩溃。错误类型：ChangeAssert（改断言条件/插入提前 return 绕过断言）、WrongLocalization（定位到错误文件/函数，文件级召回仅约 45.7%、函数级 25.4%，最佳 GPT 5 也仅 76%/42%）、WrongFix（绕过出错组件、缺乏一般性、引入漏优化等新 bug）。
5) 成本与稳健性：mini-SWE-agent 平均 14.1 分钟/题，llvm-autofix-mini 多 4.8 分钟；费用约 $0.1–6/题；token 预算增至 3M 后 mini-SWE-agent 收敛，而 llvm-autofix-mini 在 2M 以上持续提升且更稳健。失败分布：GPT 4o 多为上下文超限；llvm-autofix-mini 多为 token/工具预算耗尽；mini-SWE-agent 有大量 ProactiveExit 与 RuinLLVM。数据污染分析显示模型在发布后修复的 issue 上表现不差，泄漏影响不显著。
AI.conclusion: 编译器 bug 因其复杂性、跨领域专家要求与信息稀疏的报告形式，构成 LLM 自动修复的显著盲区：即使是最强模型配合专用 harness，真正有效的修复率也低于 21%，说明必须依赖编译器专用工具链（复现、alive-tv 翻译验证、gdb 动态调试、组件级回归测试）与针对性基准。llvm-harness/llvm-bench/llvm-autofix-mini 提供了这一基础设施与更优基线：相比通用 mini-SWE-agent，定制智能体在崩溃与误编译、各难度分档上普遍更优，且成本可控。后续两大方向：一是补丁生成——提升 LLVM 专属技能（从 LLVM 资源与开发者经验中蒸馏可复用技能）、动态自适应流程、精细上下文管理以缓解 context rot，并改进缺陷定位；二是补丁验证——开发自动化验证手段以检测断言绕过/逻辑弱化导致的“技术正确但次优”代码、检出漏优化以及过拟合补丁，从而缩小 %Passed 与 %Valid 之间的鸿沟。此外 harness 需扩展至后端（llc、arm-tv/riscv-tv、llubi）与各前端及编译挂起/漏优化等性能类问题。

title: Parameter-Efficient Token Embedding Editing for Clinical Class-Level Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is increasingly important for clinical language models, where privacy regulations and institutional policies may require removing sensitive information from deployed systems without retraining from scratch. In practice, deletion requests must balance effective forgetting of targeted information with preservation of model utility and minimal parameter modification. We introduce Sparse Token Embedding Unlearning (STEU), a parameter-efficient method for behavioral class-level unlearning that updates only PMI-selected token embeddings together with a small classifier head while keeping all encoder layers frozen. Across experiments on MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-III, and eICU using BioClinicalBERT, BERT-base, and DistilBERT, STEU consistently suppresses the target class while largely preserving retained task performance. In the primary MIMIC-IV setting, STEU achieves near-complete forgetting (forget F1 = 0.0004) while maintaining competitive retained utility (retain avg F1 = 0.4766) after modifying only 0.19\% of model parameters. These results suggest that targeted behavioral unlearning can be achieved through sparse embedding edits without modifying deeper encoder representations.

AI.tldr: STEU是一种参数高效的行为类级遗忘方法，通过仅更新PMI选择的token嵌入和小规模分类器头来实现临床语言模型的目标类遗忘，同时保持encoder层冻结，在MIMIC-IV上实现几乎完全遗忘(forget F1=0.0004)且仅修改0.19%的模型参数。
AI.motivation: 临床语言模型需要满足隐私法规和机构政策要求，能够从已部署系统中删除敏感信息而无需从头重新训练。删除请求需要在有效遗忘目标信息与保持模型效用和最小参数修改之间取得平衡。
AI.method: Sparse Token Embedding Unlearning (STEU)是一种参数高效的行为类级遗忘方法，仅更新PMI选择的token嵌入和小规模分类器头，同时冻结所有encoder层。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV、MIMIC-III和eICU上使用BioClinicalBERT、BERT-base和DistilBERT进行实验，STEU持续抑制目标类同时大幅保留保留任务性能。在MIMIC-IV主要设置中，STEU实现几乎完全遗忘(forget F1=0.0004)同时保持竞争性的保留效用(retain avg F1=0.4766)，仅修改0.19%的模型参数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可以通过稀疏嵌入编辑实现目标行为遗忘，而无需修改更深层的encoder表示。

title: Exploring Subnetwork Interactions in Heterogeneous Brain Network via Prior-Informed Graph Learning
summary: Modeling the complex interactions among functional subnetworks is crucial for the diagnosis of mental disorders and the identification of functional pathways. However, learning the interactions of the underlying subnetworks remains a significant challenge for existing Transformer-based methods due to the limited number of training samples. To address these challenges, we propose KD-Brain, a Prior-Informed Graph Learning framework for explicitly encoding prior knowledge to guide the learning process. Specifically, we design a Semantic-Conditioned Interaction mechanism that injects semantic priors into the attention query, explicitly navigating the subnetwork interactions based on their functional identities. Furthermore, we introduce a Pathology-Consistent Constraint, which regularizes the model optimization by aligning the learned interaction distributions with clinical priors. Additionally, KD-Brain leads to state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of disorder diagnosis tasks and identifies interpretable biomarkers consistent with psychiatric pathophysiology. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KDBrain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KD-Brain——一种先验信息引导的图学习框架（Prior-Informed Graph Learning），通过将语义先验注入注意力查询并引入病理一致性约束，在样本有限的条件下显式建模功能子网络间的复杂交互，提升精神障碍诊断精度并发现可解释的生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 精神障碍诊断与功能通路识别需要刻画大脑功能子网络之间复杂的相互作用关系。然而现有基于Transformer的方法受限于训练样本量稀少，难以充分学习底层子网络的交互模式，且缺乏对神经科学/临床先验知识的显式利用，导致模型泛化能力与可解释性不足。
AI.method: KD-Brain框架包含两个核心机制：(1) 语义条件交互机制（Semantic-Conditioned Interaction）——将子网络的功能身份所对应的语义先验编码并注入注意力的query中，使注意力依据各子网络的功能语义显式导航子网络间的交互；(2) 病理一致性约束（Pathology-Consistent Constraint）——在优化过程中将学习到的交互分布与临床先验（如已知病理相关连接模式）对齐，作为正则项引导训练。整体上以图学习方式建模子网络级交互，融合先验知识与数据驱动的Transformer结构。
AI.result: KD-Brain在多种精神障碍诊断任务上达到当前最优（SOTA）性能；同时能够识别出与精神病理学（psychiatric pathophysiology）一致的、可解释的生物标志物/功能通路，表明所学习到的交互模式具有神经科学合理性。
AI.conclusion: 显式注入先验知识（语义先验 + 临床病理约束）可有效缓解小样本下子网络交互学习不足的问题，显著提升 Transformer 类模型的诊断性能与可解释性，说明"先验引导"是脑网络建模中值得探索的方向；代码已开源以支持复现。

title: Stepwise: Neuro-Symbolic Proof Search for Automated Systems Verification
summary: Formal verification via interactive theorem proving is increasingly used to ensure the correctness of critical systems, yet constructing large proof scripts remains highly manual and limits scalability. Advances in large language models (LLMs), especially in mathematical reasoning, make their integration into software verification increasingly promising. This paper introduces a neuro-symbolic proof generation framework designed to automate proof search for systems-level verification projects. The framework performs a best-first tree search over proof states, repeatedly querying an LLM for the next candidate proof step. On the neural side, we fine-tune LLMs using datasets of proof state-step pairs; on the symbolic side, we incorporate a range of ITP tools to repair rejected steps, filter and rank proof states, and automatically discharge subgoals when search progress stalls. This synergy enables data-efficient LLM adaptation and semantics-informed pruning of the search space. We implement the framework on a new Isabelle REPL that exposes fine-grained proof states and automation tools, and evaluate it on the FVEL seL4 benchmark and additional Isabelle developments. On seL4, the system proves up to 77.6\% of the theorems, substantially surpassing previous LLM-based approaches and standalone Sledgehammer, while solving significantly more multi-step proofs. Results across further benchmarks demonstrate strong generalization, indicating a viable path toward scalable automated software verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种神经符号结合的证明生成框架，通过最佳优先树搜索结合微调大语言模型与交互式定理证明工具，实现系统级软件验证的自动化证明搜索，在seL4基准上实现了77.6%的定理证明率。
AI.motivation: 交互式定理证明虽能确保关键系统正确性，但大型证明脚本的构建高度依赖人工，限制了其可扩展性。大语言模型在数学推理方面的进展为软件验证的集成提供了新机遇。
AI.method: 框架采用最佳优先树搜索遍历证明状态，反复查询LLM获取候选证明步骤。神经层面：使用证明状态-步骤对数据集微调LLM；符号层面：集成多种ITP工具进行步骤修复、证明状态过滤与排序、搜索停滞时自动消解子目标。在新开发的Isabelle REPL上实现该框架。
AI.result: 在seL4上可证明达77.6%的定理，显著超越此前基于LLM的方法和独立Sledgehammer，并能解决更多多步证明任务。在其他基准测试中也表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为可扩展的自动化软件验证提供了一条可行路径。

title: Embodied Science: Closing the Discovery Loop with Agentic Embodied AI
summary: Artificial intelligence has demonstrated remarkable capability in predicting scientific properties, yet scientific discovery remains an inherently physical, long-horizon pursuit governed by experimental cycles. Most current computational approaches are misaligned with this reality, framing discovery as isolated, task-specific predictions rather than continuous interaction with the physical world. Here, we argue for embodied science, a paradigm that reframes scientific discovery as a closed loop tightly coupling agentic reasoning with physical execution. We propose a unified Perception-Language-Action-Discovery (PLAD) framework, wherein embodied agents perceive experimental environments, reason over scientific knowledge, execute physical interventions, and internalize outcomes to drive subsequent exploration. By grounding computational reasoning in robust physical feedback, this approach bridges the gap between digital prediction and empirical validation, offering a roadmap for autonomous discovery systems in the life and chemical sciences.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"具身科学"(embodied science)范式，将科学发现重新定义为智能体推理与物理执行紧密耦合的闭环过程，并提出统一的感知-语言-动作-发现(PLAD)框架，旨在弥合数字预测与经验验证之间的差距，为生命科学和化学领域的自主发现系统提供路线图。
AI.motivation: 当前人工智能在预测科学性质方面展现出显著能力，但科学发现本质上是一个受实验周期驱动的物理的、长期的过程。大多数现有计算方法与这一现实不符，将发现视为孤立的、特定任务的预测，而不是与物理世界的持续交互。
AI.method: 提出统一的PLAD框架，其中具身智能体感知实验环境、对科学知识进行推理、执行物理干预、并内化结果以驱动后续探索。该框架将计算推理扎根于稳健的物理反馈中。
AI.result: 通过具身科学范式和PLAD框架，可以弥合数字预测与经验验证之间的差距，为生命科学和化学科学中的自主发现系统提供可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 具身科学作为新的范式，通过将推理与物理执行紧密结合，为科学发现的自动化提供了新的思路和框架，有望推动科学探索从传统的假设-实验循环向更加自主化的方向转变。

title: MemReward: Graph-Based Experience Memory for LLM Reward Prediction with Limited Labels
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) for complex reasoning via reinforcement learning requires reward labels that specify whether the generated rollouts are correct. However, obtaining reward labels at scale often requires expensive human labeling or time-consuming verification procedures; for instance, evaluating mathematical proofs demands expert review, while open-ended question answering lacks definitive ground truth. When reward labels are limited, the effectiveness of reinforcement learning fine-tuning is constrained by the scarcity of reward labels. We introduce MemReward, a graph-based experience memory framework: an initial LLM policy generates rollouts for each query, each comprising a thinking process and a final answer, and these rollouts are stored as experience memory. Queries, thinking processes, and answers form nodes in a heterogeneous graph with similarity and structural edges; a GNN trained on labeled nodes propagates rewards to unlabeled rollouts during online optimization. Experiments on Qwen2.5-3B and 1.5B across mathematics, question answering, and code generation demonstrate that MemReward, with only 20% labels, achieves 97.3% of Oracle performance on 3B and 96.6% on 1.5B, surpassing Oracle on out-of-domain tasks. Performance scales smoothly with label budget, reaching 99.4% of Oracle at 70% labels.

AI.tldr: MemReward是一个基于图的体验记忆框架，通过将LLM生成的rollout存储为异构图节点，利用GNN将奖励从标注数据传播到未标注数据，从而在仅使用20%标注的情况下达到Oracle性能的97.3%。
AI.motivation: 在复杂推理任务中，通过强化学习微调LLM需要奖励标签来评估生成结果的质量，但获取奖励标签成本高昂（需要专家审核或缺乏标准答案），这限制了强化学习微调的效果。现有方法在标注数据稀缺时面临奖励信号不足的问题。
AI.method: 1）初始LLM策略为每个查询生成rollout（包括思考过程和最终答案）；2）将查询、思考过程和答案建模为异构图节点，通过相似性边和结构边连接；3）在标注节点上训练GNN，将奖励传播到未标注的rollout；4）在在线优化过程中利用传播的奖励进行强化学习微调。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-3B和1.5B模型上，针对数学、问答和代码生成任务的实验表明：仅使用20%标注即可达到Oracle性能的97.3%（3B）和96.6%（1.5B）；在域外任务上甚至超越Oracle；标注预算达到70%时达到99.4%的Oracle性能。
AI.conclusion: MemReward通过图结构有效利用了未标注数据，实现了在低标注成本下的高效奖励传播，为数据稀缺的强化学习训练提供了一种可行的解决方案，具有良好的扩展性。

title: FormalEvolve: Neuro-Symbolic Evolutionary Search for Diverse and Prover-Effective Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization aims to translate natural-language mathematics into compilable, machine-checkable statements. However, semantic consistency does not imply prover effectiveness: even semantically consistent formalizations can differ substantially in proof-search cost and success rate. In this work, we formulate autoformalization as a budgeted, test-time search for semantically consistent repertoires, and propose FormalEvolve, a compilation-gated neuro-symbolic evolutionary framework. FormalEvolve generates diverse candidates via LLM-driven mutation and crossover with bounded patch repair, while symbolic Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) rewrite operations further inject structural diversity. On CombiBench and ProofNet, under a strict generator-call budget of T = 100, FormalEvolve reaches semantic hit rates (SH@100) of 58.0% and 84.9%, and reduces cross-problem concentration of semantic successes(lower Gini). Under a fixed prover budget, FormalEvolve also improves downstream proving performance on CombiBench. Code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: FormalEvolve是一种编译门控的神经符号进化框架，通过LLM驱动的突变和交叉操作，结合符号AST重写，在有限的生成预算下为自然语言数学问题寻找语义一致且易证明的形式化表示。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化（Autoformalization）虽然可以将自然语言数学翻译为机器可检查的形式化语句，但语义一致的形式化表示在证明搜索成本和成功率上存在显著差异，因此需要搜索"合适"的形式化 repertoires。
AI.method: 提出FormalEvolve框架，包含：1) LLM驱动的变异和交叉操作（带边界修补）；2) 符号AST重写操作增加结构多样性；3) 编译门控机制确保语义一致性。
AI.result: 在T=100的生成预算下，CombiBench和ProofNet上分别达到58.0%和84.9%的语义命中率(SH@100)，并降低了跨问题语义成功的集中度(降低Gini系数)。
AI.conclusion: FormalEvolve在固定证明器预算下提升了CombiBench的下游证明性能，验证了搜索多样化形式化 repertoires 对提高自动形式化有效性的价值。

title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
summary: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling framework for learning world models in compact latent spaces, yet existing methods remain fragile, relying on complex multi-term losses, exponential moving averages, pre-trained encoders, or auxiliary supervision to avoid representation collapse. In this work, we introduce LeWorldModel (LeWM), the first JEPA that trains stably end-to-end from raw pixels using only two loss terms: a next-embedding prediction loss and a regularizer enforcing Gaussian-distributed latent embeddings. This reduces tunable loss hyperparameters from six to one compared to the only existing end-to-end alternative. With ~15M parameters trainable on a single GPU in a few hours, LeWM plans up to 48x faster than foundation-model-based world models while remaining competitive across diverse 2D and 3D control tasks. Beyond control, we show that LeWM's latent space encodes meaningful physical structure through probing of physical quantities. Surprise evaluation confirms that the model reliably detects physically implausible events.

AI.tldr: LeWorldModel (LeWM) 是首个仅使用两个损失项即可从原始像素稳定端到端训练的联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)，相比现有方法大幅简化超参数调优，在保持竞争力的同时实现48倍 planning 加速。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA方法脆弱且复杂，需要多损失项、指数移动平均、预训练编码器或辅助监督才能避免表示崩溃，缺乏一个简单稳定且可端到端训练的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 LeWM，仅使用两个损失项：(1)下一嵌入预测损失；(2)高斯分布正则化器强制潜在嵌入符合高斯分布。模型约1500万参数，可在单GPU上数小时训练完成。
AI.result: 相比仅存的端到端替代方案，将可调超参数从6个减少到1个；在2D和3D控制任务上保持竞争力；planning速度比基于基础模型的世界模型快48倍；潜在空间编码有意义的物理结构，可探测物理量并可靠检测物理上不可能的事件。
AI.conclusion: LeWM证明了JEPA框架可以在极简设置下稳定训练，为世界模型学习提供了一种高效、可扩展的方案，无需复杂的组件或大量计算资源即可学习有物理意义的潜在表示。

title: Utility-Guided Agent Orchestration for Efficient LLM Tool Use
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents often face a fundamental tension between answer quality and execution cost. Fixed workflows are stable but inflexible, while free-form multi-step reasoning methods such as ReAct may improve task performance at the expense of excessive tool calls, longer trajectories, higher token consumption, and increased latency. In this paper, we study agent orchestration as an explicit decision problem rather than leaving it entirely to prompt-level behavior. We propose a utility-guided orchestration policy that selects among actions such as respond, retrieve, tool call, verify, and stop by balancing estimated gain, step cost, uncertainty, and redundancy. Our goal is not to claim universally best task performance, but to provide a controllable and analyzable policy framework for studying quality-cost trade-offs in tool-using LLM agents. Experiments across direct answering, threshold control, fixed workflows, ReAct, and several policy variants show that explicit orchestration signals substantially affect agent behavior. Additional analyses on cost definitions, workflow fairness, and redundancy control further demonstrate that lightweight utility design can provide a defensible and practical mechanism for agent control.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses the quality-cost trade-off in tool-using LLM agents by proposing a utility-guided orchestration policy that explicitly selects actions based on gain, cost, uncertainty, and redundancy, providing a controllable framework for agent behavior control.
AI.motivation: Tool-using LLM agents face tension between answer quality and execution cost. Fixed workflows are inflexible while free-form reasoning methods like ReAct improve performance but increase tool calls, latency, and token consumption. The problem is that agent orchestration is left entirely to prompt-level behavior without explicit decision-making.
AI.method: Propose a utility-guided orchestration policy that selects among actions (respond, retrieve, tool call, verify, stop) by balancing estimated gain, step cost, uncertainty, and redundancy. This treats agent orchestration as an explicit decision problem rather than prompt-level behavior.
AI.result: Experiments across direct answering, threshold control, fixed workflows, ReAct, and policy variants show that explicit orchestration signals substantially affect agent behavior. Additional analyses on cost definitions, workflow fairness, and redundancy control demonstrate that lightweight utility design provides a defensible and practical mechanism for agent control.
AI.conclusion: The utility-guided orchestration framework offers a controllable and analyzable approach to studying quality-cost trade-offs in tool-using LLM agents. It is not about claiming universally best task performance, but providing a practical mechanism for agent control.

title: DPxFin: Adaptive Differential Privacy for Anti-Money Laundering Detection via Reputation-Weighted Federated Learning
comment: Accepted at AI FOR FINANCIAL FRAUD DETECTION & PREVENTION AT ACM ICAIF-25
summary: In the modern financial system, combating money laundering is a critical challenge complicated by data privacy concerns and increasingly complex fraud transaction patterns. Although federated learning (FL) is a promising problem-solving approach as it allows institutions to train their models without sharing their data, it has the drawback of being prone to privacy leakage, specifically in tabular data forms like financial data. To address this, we propose DPxFin, a novel federated framework that integrates reputation-guided adaptive differential privacy. Our approach computes client reputation by evaluating the alignment between locally trained models and the global model. Based on this reputation, we dynamically assign differential privacy noise to client updates, enhancing privacy while maintaining overall model utility. Clients with higher reputations receive lower noise to amplify their trustworthy contributions, while low-reputation clients are allocated stronger noise to mitigate risk. We validate DPxFin on the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) dataset under both IID and non-IID settings using Multi Layer Perceptron (MLP). Experimental analysis established that our approach has a more desirable trade-off between accuracy and privacy than those of traditional FL and fixed-noise Differential Privacy (DP) baselines, where performance improvements were consistent, even though on a modest scale. Moreover, DPxFin does withstand tabular data leakage attacks, proving its effectiveness under real-world financial conditions.

AI.tldr: DPxFin是一个针对反洗钱场景的新型联邦学习框架，通过引入基于声誉的自适应差分隐私机制，根据客户端模型与全局模型的对齐程度计算声誉值，并动态分配差分隐私噪声。声誉高的客户端获得较低噪声以保留其可信贡献，声誉低的客户端被分配较高噪声以降低风险。实验表明该框架在IID和非IID设置下均能在准确率和隐私保护之间取得更好的权衡，并能抵御表格数据泄露攻击。
AI.motivation: 现代金融系统中反洗钱面临数据隐私问题和复杂欺诈交易模式的双重挑战。联邦学习虽允许机构在不共享数据的情况下训练模型，但仍存在隐私泄露风险，尤其是在金融表格数据形式下。传统联邦学习方法无法有效区分可信与不可信客户端的贡献，导致隐私保护与模型效用之间难以取得良好平衡。
AI.method: 提出DPxFin框架，整合声誉引导的自适应差分隐私机制。具体方法包括：1）通过评估客户端本地训练的模型与全局模型之间的对齐程度来计算客户端声誉；2）基于声誉动态分配差分隐私噪声——高声誉客户端获得较低噪声以增强其可信贡献，低声誉客户端获得较高噪声以降低风险；3）在AML数据集上使用多层感知器(MLP)进行验证，在IID和非IID两种数据分布设置下进行实验。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DPxFin在IID和非IID设置下均优于传统联邦学习和固定噪声差分隐私基线方法，在准确率与隐私保护之间实现了更理想的权衡，性能提升虽温和但一致。此外，DPxFin能够抵御表格数据泄露攻击，证明了其在真实金融条件下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DPxFin通过引入声誉引导的自适应差分隐私机制，成功解决了联邦学习在金融反洗钱场景中的隐私泄露问题。该框架能够根据客户端的可信度动态调整隐私保护强度，在保障数据隐私的同时维持较高的模型效用，为金融领域的联邦学习应用提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案。

title: On the Ability of Transformers to Verify Plans
summary: Transformers have shown inconsistent success in AI planning tasks, and theoretical understanding of when generalization should be expected has been limited. We take important steps towards addressing this gap by analyzing the ability of decoder-only models to verify whether a given plan correctly solves a given planning instance. To analyse the general setting where the number of objects -- and thus the effective input alphabet -- grows at test time, we introduce C*-RASP, an extension of C-RASP designed to establish length generalization guarantees for transformers under the simultaneous growth in sequence length and vocabulary size. Our results identify a large class of classical planning domains for which transformers can provably learn to verify long plans, and structural properties that significantly affects the learnability of length generalizable solutions. Empirical experiments corroborate our theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究decoder-only模型在AI规划任务中的验证能力，并提出C*-RASP方法来处理序列长度和词汇表同时增长情况下的长度泛化问题，为Transformers在规划领域的泛化提供了理论保证。
AI.motivation: Transformers在AI规划任务中表现出不一致的成功，且关于何时应该期望泛化的理论理解有限，这是一个重要的研究空白。
AI.method: 引入C*-RASP（作为C-RASP的扩展），用于在序列长度和词汇表大小同时增长的情况下，为transformers建立长度泛化保证。分析decoder-only模型验证给定规划实例是否被正确求解的能力。
AI.result: 识别出一大类经典规划域，transformers可以从中学习验证长计划；发现了影响长度泛化解决方案可学习性的结构特性。
AI.conclusion: 理论结果为transformers在规划域中的泛化能力提供了正式保证，实验结果验证了理论预测。

title: MSNet and LS-Net: Scalable Multi-Scale Multi-Representation Networks for Time Series Classification
summary:
Time series classification (TSC) performance depends not only on architectural design but also on the diversity of input representations. In this work, we propose a scalable multi-scale convolutional framework that systematically integrates structured multi-representation inputs for univariate time series.
  We introduce two architectures: MSNet, a hierarchical multi-scale convolutional network optimized for robustness and calibration, and LS-Net, a lightweight variant designed for efficiency-aware deployment. In addition, we adapt LiteMV -- originally developed for multivariate inputs -- to operate on multi-representation univariate signals, enabling cross-representation interaction.
  We evaluate all models across 142 benchmark datasets under a unified experimental protocol. Critical Difference analysis confirms statistically significant performance differences among the top models. Results show that LiteMV achieves the highest mean accuracy, MSNet provides superior probabilistic calibration (lowest NLL), and LS-Net offers the best efficiency-accuracy tradeoff. Pareto analysis further demonstrates that multi-representation multi-scale modeling yields a flexible design space that can be tuned for accuracy-oriented, calibration-oriented, or resource-constrained settings.
  These findings establish scalable multi-representation multi-scale learning as a principled and practical direction for modern TSC. Reference implementation of MSNet and LS-Net is available at: https://github.com/alagoz/msnet-lsnet-tsc

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展的“多表示 + 多尺度”卷积框架用于单变量时间序列分类：在 142 个 UCR/UEA 基准数据集、30 次 Monte Carlo 重采样统一协议下，比较 Lite 基线、多表示改造版 LiteMV、MRMS-Net（层级多尺度网络）与其轻量变体 LMRMS-Net（含置信度早退）。结果：LiteMV 平均准确率最高（0.836）、MRMS-Net 校准最佳（NLL 0.615 最低）、LMRMS-Net 效率–精度权衡最优（训练时间 11.70s，较基线近乎减半），Friedman+Nemenyi 检验显示头部模型差异显著，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 深度时序分类（TFC）方法多依赖原始时域信号，隐式要求网络自行学习所有变换；经典信号处理表明导数、频域投影、自相关等互补表示包含难以从原始信号恢复的判别信息。同时，已有多尺度卷积模型几乎只优化预测精度，缺少对概率校准（NLL）与计算效率（训练/推理开销）的联合分析，且在大规模基准（142 数据集 UCR 库）下可扩展性与鲁棒性成为关键瓶颈。论文因此寻求统一框架，同时回答三件事：结构化表示多样性带来的增益、多尺度架构在精度–校准–效率上的权衡，以及在统一协议下进行统计显著性检验的规模化实证。
AI.method:
**表示体系**：为每条单变量序列构造 8 种结构化表示并作为通道输入——TIME（原始）、DT1/DT2（一/二阶导数）、HLB_MAG 与 FFT_MAG（频域幅度）、DWT_A（小波近似系数）、DCT（离散余弦系数）、ACF（自相关）；按 Raw → Minimal → Default 三种表示集做受控消融。

**MRMS-Net**：输入张量 (R×L)，并行三路 Conv1D（k=3/5/7）分别捕获短、中、长程依赖，拼接后经层级融合块（BatchNorm → ReLU → 堆叠 1×1D 卷积 → Dropout），再全局平均池化 + FC 分类，重点优化训练稳定性与概率校准。

**LMRMS-Net**（实现名 FastMultiScaleCNN）：轻量双分支 Conv1d(R→16, k=3) 与 Conv1d(R→16, k=5)，拼接为 32 通道；早退分类器对池化特征做 FC(32→64)+ReLU+FC(64→C)，推理时若 softmax 最大类概率均值 ≥ τ=0.8 即直接输出，否则回退到深层融合路径（BN+ReLU→Conv1d(32→64)→Conv1d(64→128)→Dropout 0.3）后池化分类；训练仅用主路径以保证梯度稳定，早退仅在推理启用。

**LiteMV 多表示改造**：将 R 个表示通道重新解释为伪多变量通道，使映射为 ℱ: ℝ^{R×L}→ℝ^C，实现跨表示交互建模，无需真正的多变量输入。

**实验协议**：142 个 UCR/UEA 数据集，每数据集 30 次 Monte Carlo 重采样（有预设索引时沿用以保证与 SOTA 可比）；先按重采样取均值、再按数据集宏平均以避免数据集规模偏置；Adam + 交叉熵，最多 1500 epochs，基于训练损失早停并恢复最佳权重，批大小按 N×L 自适应以避免显存溢出；指标含 Accuracy、Macro-F1、AUC、NLL、训练/测试时间；统计用 Friedman 检验 + Nemenyi 事后检验（CD 图）与 Pareto 前沿分析。
AI.result:
（1）总体表现（142 数据集均值）：LiteMV 准确率 0.836 / F1 0.812 最高，AUC 0.938，NLL 0.647，训练 18.72s；MRMS-Net 准确率 0.828、F1 0.799、NLL 0.615（最低，校准最优），训练 25.35s 最高；LMRMS-Net 准确率 0.827、F1 0.801、AUC 0.939（最高）、NLL 0.677，训练 11.70s、测试 0.027s（最低）；Lite 基线准确率 0.828、训练 21.26s。

（2）统计显著性：Friedman 检验 p<0.05，Nemenyi 事后检验显示 LiteMV 平均排名第一，Lite 与 MRMS-Net 与其无显著差异，LMRMS-Net 略低但仍具竞争力；CD 图表明无任何架构在所有数据集上全面占优，性能提升具有数据集依赖性。

（3）Pareto 分析：LMRMS-Net 位于效率–精度前沿附近，LiteMV 兼具最高精度与中等训练成本，MRMS-Net 以更高开销换取更优校准，形成“精度导向 / 效率导向 / 校准导向”三类可选工作点。

（4）表示消融：结构化表示扩展（Raw → Minimal → Default）在各架构上带来一致的精度与 macro-F1 增益；Default 通常精度最高但训练时间更长，Minimal 以显著更低算力捕获大部分增益，构成推荐的默认配置；增益幅度与架构交互明显——LiteMV 从表示扩展中获益最大（跨表示交互有效），MRMS-Net 增益稳定（多尺度聚合带来鲁棒性），LMRMS-Net 在 Minimal 设置下效率–精度平衡最优，说明表示工程与架构设计不可割裂看待。

（5）校准分析：多种架构精度相近时，MRMS-Net 的 NLL 持续最低，表明多尺度层级聚合可改善不确定性估计，对医疗诊断、异常检测等风险敏感场景有直接价值。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的多表示输入与可扩展多尺度卷积的结合，构成了一条有原则且实用的现代 TSC 技术路线：表示多样性负责稳定提升判别性能，多尺度结构负责改善概率校准，轻量化设计与置信度早退负责把成本压到可部署区间；借助多数据集统计检验与 Pareto 分析，可在精度、校准、资源受限三类运行区间之间灵活调节设计。未来工作方向为自适应表示选择、动态多尺度注意力机制，以及向大规模多变量基准的扩展。

title: Experience is the Best Teacher: Motivating Effective Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with rubric-based rewards has recently shown remarkable progress in enhancing general reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet still suffers from ineffective exploration confined to curent policy distribution. In fact, RL optimization can be viewed as steering the policy toward an ideal distribution that maximizes the rewards, while effective exploration should align efforts with desired target. Leveraging this insight, we propose HeRL, a Hindsight experience guided Reinforcement Learning framework to bootstrap effective exploration by explicitly telling LLMs the desired behaviors specified in rewards. Concretely, HeRL treats failed trajectories along with their unmet rubrics as hindsight experience, which serves as in-context guidance for the policy to explore desired responses beyond its current distribution. Additionally, we introduce a bonus reward to incentivize responses with greater potential for improvement under such guidance. HeRL facilitates effective learning from desired high quality samples without repeated trial-and-error from scratch, yielding a more accurate estimation of the expected gradient theoretically. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that HeRL achieves superior performance gains over baselines, and can further benefit from experience guided self-improvement at test time. Our code is available at https://github.com/sikelifei/HeRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HeRL框架，通过 hindsight experience（后见经验）引导强化学习来解决大型语言模型在基于评分标准的奖励机制下探索能力不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于评分标准（rubric-based rewards）的强化学习在增强LLM推理能力时，存在探索受限的问题——模型仅在当前策略分布内进行探索，难以突破到期望的理想分布。
AI.method: HeRL核心方法包括：1）将失败轨迹及其未满足的评分标准作为后见经验，用于上下文指导策略探索超越当前分布的响应；2）引入额外奖励机制，激励具有更大改进潜力的响应。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，HeRL相比基线方法获得显著性能提升，并可从测试时的经验引导自我改进中进一步受益。
AI.conclusion: HeRL能够从期望的高质量样本中进行有效学习，无需从头反复试错，理论上能更准确估计预期梯度。

title: Ternary Gamma Semirings: From Neural Implementation to Categorical Foundations
summary: This paper establishes a theoretical framework connecting neural network learning with abstract algebraic structures. We first present a minimal counterexample demonstrating that standard neural networks completely fail on compositional generalization tasks (0% accuracy). By introducing a logical constraint -- the Ternary Gamma Semiring -- the same architecture learns a perfectly structured feature space, achieving 100% accuracy on novel combinations. We prove that this learned feature space constitutes a finite commutative ternary $Γ$-semiring, whose ternary operation implements the majority vote rule. Comparing with the recently established classification of Gokavarapu et al., we show that this structure corresponds precisely to the Boolean-type ternary $Γ$-semiring with $|T|=4$, $|Γ|=1$}, which is unique up to isomorphism in their enumeration. Our findings reveal three profound conclusions: (i) the success of neural networks can be understood as an approximation of mathematically ``natural'' structures; (ii) learned representations generalize because they internalize algebraic axioms (symmetry, idempotence, majority property); (iii) logical constraints guide networks to converge to these canonical forms. This work provides a rigorous mathematical framework for understanding neural network generalization and inaugurates the new interdisciplinary direction of Computational $Γ$-Algebra.

AI.tldr: 本文以一个极简 XOR 组合泛化任务为切入点：先展示标准神经网络在训练集仅含"同属性"样本时测试准确率为 0%，随后引入"Ternary Gamma Semiring"逻辑约束（同类特征拉近、异类分离的损失），使同一架构在留出组合上达到 100% 测试准确率。作者进一步枚举 $4^3=64$ 种三元输入组合，证明学到的三元运算 $\phi$ 恰为多数投票（majority vote）规则，验证其对称性、幂等性与多数公理，并将其与 Gokavarapu 等人关于有限交换三元 $\Gamma$-半环的分类结果对应为 $|T|=4,|\Gamma|=1$ 的 Boolean 型唯一同构类，最后从范畴论（$\mathbf{TTS}$ 单张闭范畴、谱函子）角度给出解释，并提出"计算 $\Gamma$-代数"研究方向。
AI.motivation: 当代 AI 默认假设大规模神经网络具备内在推理能力，但这一假设从未被严格检验（Minsky & Papert 1969；Lake & Baroni 2018；Marcus 2018）。经典问题在于：系统学会"红色正方形"和"蓝色圆形"后，能否自动推断"红色圆形"与"蓝色正方形"的类别？作者的目标有双重性：(1) 以最小反例证明标准网络在组合泛化上完全失败，仅做表面相似性匹配而非规则内化；(2) 更进一步，引入逻辑约束后不仅解决任务，还要证明所学表示并非偶然，而是对应纯数学中已被分类的规范代数对象——从而为"神经网络为何能泛化"提供严格的代数/范畴论解释，并开创"计算 $\Gamma$-代数"这一交叉方向。
AI.method: 任务设计：两个二值属性（颜色 red=0/blue=1，形状 square=0/circle=1），XOR 规则下训练集仅含 A 类 (0,0),(1,1)，测试集仅含 B 类 (0,1),(1,0)（完全未见组合）。基线：两层隐藏层（维度 16）的 MLP，训练 1000 epoch，得训练 100%/测试 0%，且在多种随机种子与结构变体下稳定失败。约束架构：特征提取器 $f:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^8$，配合逻辑损失——同类对 (f0,f1)、(f2,f3) 的 L2 范数拉近，四个异类对使用带 margin=2.0 的 hinge 损失分离；两阶段训练：阶段 1 仅优化逻辑损失，阶段 2 取 A 类特征均值作为原型，按距离原型分类。代数分析：枚举 $4^3=64$ 种三元组合，定义 $\phi(a,b,c)$ 为"三输入特征均值最近的类中心"所属类别，制表验证其与多数投票真值表完全一致；逐条验证对称性（$S_3$ 置换不变）、幂等性 $\phi(a,a,a)=a$、多数公理 $\phi(a,a,b)=a$ 及类级别结合律。对照 Gokavarapu 等人的有限三元 $\Gamma$-半环分类（Boolean/modular/tropical/hybrid 型），定位本结构为 Boolean 型、$|T|=4$、$|\Gamma|=1$、在枚举中唯一同构。范畴解释：以特征向量集为 $T$、向量加法为 $+$，构造 $\mathbf{TTS}$ 中的对象；引用 $\mathbf{TTS}$ 为单张闭范畴（张量-Hom 伴随），将 $\phi$ 视为 $T^{\otimes 3}\to T$ 的具体实例；因元素级严格结合律失败（如内层输出不同 A 类元素），引入类内同构 $\alpha: f_{rs}\cong f_{bc}$、$\beta: f_{rc}\cong f_{bs}$ 说明"结合律在同构意义下成立"；定义谱函子 $\mathrm{Spec}_\Gamma:\mathbf{TTS}\to\mathbf{Top}$，该结构的谱为对应 A/B 两类的两个孤立点。
AI.result: 1) 反例：标准网络训练准确率 100%、测试准确率 0%，将所有测试样本误判为 A 类，体现表面相似性匹配而非推理，且跨随机种子与结构变体稳健。2) 约束模型：同类特征距离 $\approx 0.003\text{–}0.009$，异类距离 $\approx 2.04$，比值超 200 倍；原型分类下测试准确率 100%（red circle 距离 2.040、blue square 距离 2.046，均正确判为 B）。对照表：随机猜测 50%、标准网络 0%、Ternary Gamma 无原型 0%、Ternary Gamma + 原型 100%。3) 代数结果：$\phi$ 精确实现多数投票规则（8 种输入模式下各类输出计数与真值表吻合），满足对称性、幂等性、多数公理与类级结合律；据 Theorem 1，所学特征空间构成有限交换三元 $\Gamma$-半环，且与 Gokavarapu 分类中的 Boolean 型（$|T|=4,|\Gamma|=1$）同构且唯一。4) 范畴结果：Proposition 2 给出类内同构下的"up to isomorphism"结合律，谱空间为两点离散拓扑。作者由此得出三点结论：网络成功可理解为对数学"自然"结构的逼近；泛化源于内化代数公理；逻辑约束引导网络收敛到规范形式。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并论证了"逻辑约束（$\Gamma$-半环式归纳偏置）→ 组合泛化能力 → 可证成的代数结构"这一链条，为可解释、可验证 AI 提供了代数基础，并开创"计算 $\Gamma$-代数"交叉领域：把学习到的表示视为代数对象，使泛化从黑箱现象转变为代数公理的自然推论。后续方向包括推广至多物体多属性推理（如 CLEVR）、自动约束学习、$|T|>4$ 时高维特征的代数分类、三元 $\Gamma$-半环的同调性质与代数拓扑联系，以及工业决策系统应用。评价性提示：论文的实证规模极小（单一线性/ReLU 编码器 + 手工度量损失 + 原型分类器，"100%"实质来自原型距离规则）；$\phi$ 的定义本身依赖类中心距离，其与多数投票的一致性带有事后构造性质；而"构成三元 $\Gamma$-半环"的关键公理（分配律、零吸收、加法幺元）中，加法被取为向量加法而 $\phi$ 输出的是类标签，与 $T$ 中元素类型不一致，分配律与零吸收并未显式验证，因此 Theorem 1 的严格性弱于表述；此外严格结合律失败被以"up to isomorphism"处理，与所引用的单张闭范畴结果之间的推理链条尚需补全。整体而言，本文更适合作为"用代数/范畴语言重新表述神经表示学习"的框架性论文与方向倡议，而非已完成的严格数学证明。

title: DIAL-KG: Schema-Free Incremental Knowledge Graph Construction via Dynamic Schema Induction and Evolution-Intent Assessment
summary:
Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are foundational to applications such as search, question answering, and recommendation. Conventional knowledge graph construction methods are predominantly static, rely ing on a single-step construction from a fixed corpus with a prede f
ined schema. However, such methods are suboptimal for real-world sce narios where data arrives dynamically, as incorporating new informa tion requires complete and computationally expensive graph reconstruc tions. Furthermore, predefined schemas hinder the flexibility of knowl edge graph construction. To address these limitations, we introduce DIAL KG, a closed-loop framework for incremental KG construction orches trated by a Meta-Knowledge Base (MKB). The framework oper ates in a three-stage cycle: (i) Dual-Track Extraction, which ensures knowledge completeness by defaulting to triple generation and switching to event extraction for complex knowledge; (ii) Governance Adjudica tion, which ensures the fidelity and currency of extracted facts to prevent hallucinations and knowledge staleness; and (iii) Schema Evolution, in which new schemas are induced from validated knowledge to guide subsequent construction cycles, and knowledge from the current round is incrementally applied to the existing KG. Extensive experiments demon strate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the quality of both the constructed graph and the induced schemas.

AI.tldr: DIAL KG是一种基于元知识库(MKB)的闭环增量知识图谱构建框架，通过三阶段循环（双轨抽取、治理裁决、模式演化）解决传统静态图谱构建的局限性，实现动态数据场景下的灵活图谱扩展。实验表明该框架在图谱质量和模式诱导方面达到SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 传统知识图谱构建方法存在三大缺陷：(1)静态性：依赖单步从固定语料库构建；(2)高开销：纳入新信息需完全重建图谱；(3)灵活性不足：预定义模式阻碍构建自由度。这些问题在动态数据场景下尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出DIAL KG闭环框架，包含三阶段循环：(1)双轨抽取：默认生成三元组，复杂知识切换至事件抽取；(2)治理裁决：验证事实的准确性和时效性，防止幻觉和知识陈旧；(3)模式演化：从验证后的知识诱导新模式，指导后续构建轮次，并将当前知识增量应用于现有图谱。
AI.result: 实验表明，DIAL KG在构建图谱质量和诱导模式两方面均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功实现了增量式、动态演化的知识图谱构建，为真实动态数据场景提供了可行的解决方案。

title: A General Deep Learning Framework for Wireless Resource Allocation under Discrete Constraints
summary: While deep learning (DL)-based methods have achieved remarkable success in continuous wireless resource allocation, efficient solutions for problems involving discrete variables remain challenging. This is primarily due to the zero-gradient issue in backpropagation, the difficulty of enforcing intricate constraints with discrete variables, and the inability in generating solutions with non-same-parameter-same-decision (non-SPSD) property. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a general DL framework by introducing the support set to represent the discrete variables. We model the elements of the support set as random variables and learn their joint probability distribution. By factorizing the joint probability as the product of conditional probabilities, each conditional probability is sequentially learned. This probabilistic modeling directly tackles all the aforementioned challenges of DL for handling discrete variables. By operating on probability distributions instead of hard binary decisions, the framework naturally avoids the zero-gradient issue. During the learning of the conditional probabilities, discrete constraints can be seamlessly enforced by masking out infeasible solutions. Moreover, with a dynamic context embedding that captures the evolving discrete solutions, the non-SPSD property is inherently provided by the proposed framework. We apply the proposed framework to two representative mixed-discrete wireless resource allocation problems: (a) joint user association and beamforming in cell-free systems, and (b) joint antenna positioning and beamforming in movable antenna-aided systems. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed DL framework consistently outperforms existing baselines in terms of both system performance and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于支持集和概率建模的通用深度学习框架，解决离散无线资源分配问题，通过学习条件概率分布避免零梯度问题、强制离散约束并实现非SPSD特性，在两类混合离散无线资源分配问题中验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在连续无线资源分配中取得显著成功，但离散变量问题的有效解决方案仍面临挑战，主要原因包括：1) 反向传播中的零梯度问题；2) 离散变量难以强制执行复杂约束；3) 无法生成具有非相同参数相同决策(non-SPSD)特性的解。
AI.method: 1) 引入支持集表示离散变量；2) 将支持集元素建模为随机变量并学习其联合概率分布；3) 通过条件概率分解将联合概率分解为条件概率的乘积，实现顺序学习；4) 使用动态上下文嵌入捕捉变化的离散解，提供非SPSD特性；5) 通过掩码机制在条件概率学习过程中强制执行离散约束。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的深度学习框架在系统性能和计算效率两方面均一致优于现有基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过引入支持集表示离散变量，并利用概率建模方法成功解决了深度学习处理离散变量的三大核心挑战。在两类典型混合离散无线资源分配问题上的仿真结果验证了框架的有效性，在系统性能和计算效率上均优于现有基准方法。

title: Pitfalls in Evaluating Interpretability Agents
summary: Automated interpretability systems aim to reduce the need for human labor and scale analysis to increasingly large models and diverse tasks. Recent efforts toward this goal leverage large language models (LLMs) at increasing levels of autonomy, ranging from fixed one-shot workflows to fully autonomous interpretability agents. This shift creates a corresponding need to scale evaluation approaches to keep pace with both the volume and complexity of generated explanations. We investigate this challenge in the context of automated circuit analysis -- explaining the roles of model components when performing specific tasks. To this end, we build an agentic system in which a research agent iteratively designs experiments and refines hypotheses. When evaluated against human expert explanations across six circuit analysis tasks in the literature, the system appears competitive. However, closer examination reveals several pitfalls of replication-based evaluation: human expert explanations can be subjective or incomplete, outcome-based comparisons obscure the research process, and LLM-based systems may reproduce published findings via memorization or informed guessing. To address some of these pitfalls, we propose an unsupervised intrinsic evaluation based on the functional interchangeability of model components. Our work demonstrates fundamental challenges in evaluating complex automated interpretability systems and reveals key limitations of replication-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察"将自主可解释性代理（interpretability agent）的产出与已发表的人类专家解释做对照（replication-based evaluation）"这一主流评测范式的可靠性。作者构建了一个基于 Claude Opus 4.1 的迭代式电路分析代理系统，在六个已有电路分析任务上用 LLM-as-a-judge 指标评估，发现该系统表面上"与专家相当"，但深入检验暴露出四类根本性缺陷：人类真值本身主观且可能不完整、只看结果会掩盖研究过程、LLM 可能靠记忆或"知情猜测"复现已发表结论、以及更高自主性并不必然带来更好结果。为此提出一种不依赖专家标注的内蕴（intrinsic）评测：基于模型组件的功能可互换性（权重交换后输出分布的 Jensen–Shannon 距离）来度量聚类紧致度（silhouette 分数），可扩展到任意多次运行。结论是：复制式评测可能系统性地误导，未来评测需对记忆敏感、对推理过程敏感、并锚定于模型行为。
AI.motivation: 可解释性研究正从人工手动分析转向由 LLM 驱动的自动化系统，其自主程度从固定的一次性（one-shot）流程一路提升到能自主设计实验、迭代修正假设的完全自主代理。要信任这类系统，必须能大规模、自动化地评估其"解释"的质量。但自主代理的输出是开放式的、跨运行方差大、缺乏明确真值，且同等有效的解释可处于不同抽象层级，因此评测本身成为瓶颈。已有的主流做法是"复现性评测"：把代理产出与已发表的人类专家解释对照（类似 AI 工程师、天体物理、科学发现领域的 benchmark 范式）。作者指出这一范式在机制可解释性场景中存在系统性隐患：真值来源成本高、主观、可能残缺；结果导向的比较无法反映科研过程；且 LLM 骨干可能已在训练数据中见过相关论文，从而"记住"或"猜出"结论，使评测分数虚高。
AI.method: （1）系统构建：提出一个 agentic 电路分析系统，骨干为 Claude Opus 4.1。三阶段流水线：(a) 研究者给定补全任务、任务提示集与已定位的电路成分（假设电路成分为真值）；(b) 逐成分独立分析——research agent 在系统提示引导下迭代运行，每轮先解读上一轮实验结果，再提出 3–5 个候选假设，最后设计下一批实验并说明每个实验的目的，输出 <final hypothesis> 标签即终止；工具层基于 TransformerLens 实现，包括 logit lens、activation patching（干净/反事实提示对）、attention pattern（忽略 BOS、重归一化以缓解 attention sink）、token position 索引；初始先预计算 10 条提示的 attention pattern 与 logit lens 作为初始化观测；(c) 聚类阶段——再由 Claude 按功能相似度、逐 token 位置把成分聚成簇并给出簇级功能描述，与既有工作的"同一位置成簇"惯例一致。（2）外蕴评测：收集文献中 6 个带显式功能描述与簇划分的电路分析任务（IOI-GPT2-Small、IOI-Pythia-160M、Greater-Than、Acronyms、Colored-Objects、Entity-Tracking），用 GPT-5 作为 judge 将代理解释匹配到某条人类解释；指标为 Component Functionality Accuracy、Cluster Functionality Accuracy（簇内正确比例后跨簇平均）与不依赖 judge 的 Component Assignment Accuracy（用匈牙利算法做预测簇与专家簇的一对一最优匹配）。基线为 one-shot 系统（静态输入实验输出、一次性生成解释）。（3）缺陷检验：细查真值质量（如 Pythia IOI 的 2.6 号"previous-token head"在 PILE 150 条样本上只有 42% 情形确实关注前一 token；Entity Tracking 的 value fetcher heads 在 500 条样本上做注意力/logit lens/反事实 patch 三重检验后发现行为与描述不符者不少）；比较代理与 one-shot 的实验设计差异以论证过程信息被丢弃；用"直接让模型回忆电路"探测记忆（Claude Opus 4.1 与作为 judge 的 GPT-5 均能直接复述 IOI 电路的成分与功能），并用噪声注入实验把记忆与推理解耦——对各工具结果做随机置换后按 (1−α)·original + α·permuted 混合，α∈{0,0.5,…,1}，观察准确率随 α 的变化。（4）内蕴评测：定义基于功能可互换性的距离——对注意力头两两分别交换 KQ 电路（W_K,W_Q）与 OV 电路（W_V,W_O），用交换前后下一词预测分布的 Jensen–Shannon 距离（开方）取平均作为头间距离，在 40 条任务样本上测得全体头对距离，再据此计算给定聚类的平均 silhouette 分数；对随机聚类、专家聚类、agentic 与 one-shot 聚类做对比，并用 Kendall τ 秩相关衡量与 Component Assignment Accuracy 的一致性。
AI.result: (1) 表面上 agentic 系统与人类专家解释"相当"：两个系统在三个指标上都取得较高但非完美的分数，与专家聚类通常不完全吻合；每任务共 3 次成分分析 × 5 次聚类 = 15 组聚类，结果取平均，总计 6,382 次工具调用，平均每成分分析 14.2 次调用、4.5 轮迭代。(2) 提高自主性并不稳定地提升性能：agentic 与 one-shot 表现相当，尽管 agentic 明显表现出更强的实验设计行为（生成新提示、检验假设泛化性），而这一过程优势在现有评测框架中无法被奖励。(3) 真值不可靠：Pythia-160M IOI 的 2.6 号头在 150 条 PILE 样本中仅 42% 情形关注前一 token，"previous-token head"标签存疑；Entity Tracking 中 40 个 value fetcher heads 中多例（如 (14,13) 正确对象注意力仅 0.02、(24,5) 错误对象预测 0.66、(29,7) 注意力 0.28）在 500 样本检验中与描述不符，说明人类解释可能不准确，代理"错"有时是人"错"。(4) 记忆与猜测：Claude Opus 4.1 在不做任何实验的情况下即可逐层逐头复述 IOI 电路并给出功能，GPT-5 作为 judge 也表现出直接回忆；one-shot 系统在 9.9 号头的最终假设中直接沿用原论文术语"name mover head"；即使在 Entity Tracking 上模型自称不认识该任务，也能"猜"出与论文高层一致的四步算法。噪声实验显示 α>0.7 时两系统性能显著下降，说明其行为确实较多依赖实验证据而非纯记忆；但在低 α 区间性能几乎不降，可能反映记忆或噪声下结构恢复能力。(5) 内蕴评测有效：随机聚类 silhouette 为负（−0.28～−0.18），专家聚类明显更高（0.01～0.21），agentic/one-shot 平均接近 0 但仍高于随机，个别运行可达 0.30；与 Component Assignment Accuracy 的 Kendall τ 在除 IOI-Pythia 外的所有任务上为正（0.318～0.506），表明该无监督指标捕捉到与既有分析一致的功能结构；头 (10,0)（Name Mover）到其余头的交换距离显示同簇 Name Mover 头系统性更近。外蕴与内蕴评测都存在显著的跨运行方差，内蕴指标可用于在无真值时比较多运行并挑选更一致的聚类。
AI.conclusion: 复制式评测——把自主解释系统与已发表的人类分析对照——在机制可解释性场景中可能系统性地误导：它依赖可能残缺/主观的真值，对"如何得出结论"这一推理过程不敏感，并且受 LLM 记忆与知情猜测污染；同时高自主性并不自动带来更高的一致性结果。论文提出的交换不变性（功能可互换性）驱动的无监督内蕴评测是对部分问题的初步补救，可扩展、免人工，但作者明确强调它是概念验证，不能解决记忆检测、过程评测等其余缺陷。作者呼吁构建更原则化的 agentic 可解释性 benchmark，其评测标准应同时满足：对记忆与表面线索敏感、对推理过程敏感、并锚定在被解释模型的实际行为上。

title: Target Concept Tuning Improves Extreme Weather Forecasting
summary: Deep learning models for meteorological forecasting often fail in rare but high-impact events such as typhoons, where relevant data is scarce. Existing fine-tuning methods typically face a trade-off between overlooking these extreme events and overfitting them at the expense of overall performance. We propose TaCT, an interpretable concept-gated fine-tuning framework that solves the aforementioned issue by selective model improvement: models are adapted specifically for failure cases while preserving performance in common scenarios. To this end, TaCT automatically discovers failure-related internal concepts using Sparse Autoencoders and counterfactual analysis, and updates parameters only when the corresponding concepts are activated, rather than applying uniform adaptation. Experiments show consistent improvements in typhoon forecasting across different regions without degrading other meteorological variables. The identified concepts correspond to physically meaningful circulation patterns, revealing model biases and supporting trustworthy adaptation in scientific forecasting tasks. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Concept-Gated-Fine-tune-62AC.

AI.tldr: TaCT是一种概念门控微调框架，通过选择性模型改进来解决高影响极端事件（如台风）预报困难的问题，在保持常见场景性能的同时专门改进失败案例。
AI.motivation: 深度学习气象预报模型在罕见但高影响事件（如台风）上表现不佳，相关数据稀缺。现有的微调方法面临两难困境：要么忽视极端事件，要么过拟合极端事件而牺牲整体性能。
AI.method: 使用稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders）和反事实分析自动发现失败相关的内部概念，然后仅在相应概念被激活时更新参数，实现选择性模型改进而非统一适应。
AI.result: 在不同区域的台风预报中取得一致改进，且不损害其他气象变量的预测性能。识别的概念对应有物理意义的环流模式，揭示了模型偏差。
AI.conclusion: TaCT框架能够在不损害常见气象预报能力的情况下，专门改进对极端事件的预测性能，所发现的概念具有物理可解释性，支持科学预报中的可信适应。

title: Learning Dynamic Belief Graphs for Theory-of-mind Reasoning
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) requires inferring how people's implicit, evolving beliefs shape what they seek and how they act under uncertainty -- especially in high-stakes settings such as disaster response, emergency medicine, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. Prior approaches either prompt LLMs directly or use latent-state models that treat beliefs as static and independent, often producing incoherent mental models over time and weak reasoning in dynamic contexts. We introduce a structured cognitive trajectory model for LLM-based ToM that represents mental state as a dynamic belief graph, jointly inferring latent beliefs, learning their time-varying dependencies, and linking belief evolution to information seeking and decisions. Our model contributes (i) a novel projection from textualized probabilistic statements to consistent probabilistic graphical model updates, (ii) an energy-based factor graph representation of belief interdependencies, and (iii) an ELBO-based objective that captures belief accumulation and delayed decisions. Across multiple real-world disaster evacuation datasets, our model significantly improves action prediction and recovers interpretable belief trajectories consistent with human reasoning, providing a principled module for augmenting LLMs with ToM in high-uncertainty environment. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ICML_submission-6373/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型(LLM)的结构化认知轨迹模型，用于 Theory of Mind (ToM) 推理。该模型将心理状态表示为动态信念图，联合推断潜在信念，学习其时变依赖关系，并将信念演化与信息寻求和决策相联系。在多个真实灾难疏散数据集上，该模型显著提升了动作预测性能。
AI.motivation: ToM 推理对于 LLM 理解人们在高度不确定性环境（如灾难响应、紧急医疗）中如何根据隐含的、演化的信念采取行动至关重要。现有方法要么直接提示 LLM，要么使用将信念视为静态且独立的潜在状态模型，导致在动态上下文中产生不一致的心理模型和弱推理能力。
AI.method: 提出一种结构化认知轨迹模型：(i) 将文本化概率陈述投射到一致的概率图模型更新的新颖投影方法；(ii) 基于能量的信念互依赖因子图表示；(iii) 基于 ELBO 的目标函数，用于捕捉信念积累和延迟决策。
AI.result: 在多个真实灾难疏散数据集上，该模型显著提升了动作预测性能，并恢复了与人类推理一致的可解释信念轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在高不确定性环境中增强 LLM 的 ToM 能力提供了一个原则性模块，能够联合推断信念、学习时变依赖并链接到决策制定。

title: FalconBC: Flow matching for Amortized inference of Latent-CONditioned physiologic Boundary Conditions
summary: Boundary condition tuning is a fundamental step in patient-specific cardiovascular modeling. Despite an increase in offline training cost, recent methods in data-driven variational inference can efficiently estimate the joint posterior distribution of boundary conditions, with amortization of training efforts over clinical targets. However, even the most modern approaches fall short in two important scenarios: open-loop models with known mean flow and assumed waveform shapes, and anatomies affected by vascular lesions where segmentation influences the reachability of pressure or flow split targets. In both cases, boundary conditions cannot be tuned in isolation. We introduce a general amortized inference framework based on probabilistic flow that treats clinical targets, inflow features, and point cloud embeddings of patient-specific anatomies as either conditioning variables or quantities to be jointly estimated. We demonstrate the approach on two patient-specific models: an aorto-iliac bifurcation with varying stenosis locations and severity, and a coronary arterial tree.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率流的一般化摊销推理框架，用于患者特异性心血管建模中的边界条件调优。该方法将临床目标、入流特征和患者特异性解剖结构的点云嵌入作为条件变量或联合估计量进行处理，解决了开放循环模型和血管病变解剖结构中边界条件无法单独调优的问题。
AI.motivation: 心血管建模中的边界条件调优是患者特异性建模的关键步骤。尽管数据驱动的变分推理方法可以高效估计边界条件的联合后验分布，但现有方法在两种重要场景中存在不足：(1)已知平均流量和假设波形形状的开放循环模型；(2)受血管病变影响的解剖结构，其中分割会影响压力或流量分配目标的可达性。在这两种情况下，边界条件无法单独调优。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于概率流的一般化摊销推理框架。该框架将临床目标、入流特征和患者特异性解剖结构的点云嵌入作为条件变量或联合估计量进行处理。通过摊销推理，在临床目标上分摊训练成本。
AI.result: 该方法在两个患者特异性模型上得到验证：(1)主动脉-髂动脉分叉处，伴有不同狭窄位置和严重程度；(2)冠状动脉树。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架能够有效处理开放循环模型和血管病变解剖结构中的边界条件调优问题，为患者特异性心血管建模提供了更灵活、更通用的解决方案。

title: Do Post-Training Algorithms Actually Differ? A Controlled Study Across Model Scales Uncovers Scale-Dependent Ranking Inversions
summary: Post-training alignment has produced dozens of competing algorithms -- DPO, SimPO, KTO, GRPO, and others -- yet practitioners lack controlled comparisons to guide algorithm selection. We present OXRL, a unified framework implementing 51 post-training algorithms with identical infrastructure, enabling the first large-scale apples-to-apples evaluation. Our study spans 8 algorithms across 4 model scales (0.5B--7B), 3 evaluation domains, and a 20-variant DPO taxonomy (100 runs at 1.5B, 5 seeds each), totaling $\sim$240 training runs on H100 GPUs. Three headline findings emerge. (1)~Algorithm rankings are unstable across scale: at 1.5B, online RL (SGRPO) tops all methods at 58.0\%~$\pm$0.57 on GSM8K; by 7B, the worst small-scale method (SimPO) becomes the best (85.8\%), a complete ranking inversion driven by model scale rather than LoRA regularization (confirmed via 2$\times$2 factorial). (2)~Loss function modifications yield negligible gains: none of 20 DPO variants significantly outperform vanilla DPO after Bonferroni correction; the sole significant outlier, SimPO, is worse ($-$11.5~pp, $p < 10^{-4}$). (3)~Algorithm leverage is task-specific: the 19.3~pp GSM8K spread collapses to 0.54~pp on MATH ($36\times$) and 0.47~pp on general-domain benchmarks ($41\times$), confirming that algorithm choice matters primarily within the training distribution. These findings yield a hierarchy of leverage for practitioners: model scale (${\sim}$50~pp) $\gg$ training paradigm (${\sim}$10~pp) $\gg$ online vs.\ offline (${\sim}$9~pp) $\gg$ loss function (${\sim}$1~pp). We release all code, configs, and evaluation data as a living community benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架 oxRL（实现 51 种后训练算法），在同构基础设施下完成约 240 次训练（H100，约 235 GPU-h），对 8 种算法 × 4 个模型规模（Qwen2.5-Instruct 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B）× 3 个评测域（GSM8K、MATH、ARC-C/HellaSwag/WinoGrande）及 20 个 DPO 变体分类（1.5B、5 seed、100 次运行）进行首个大规模"苹果对苹果"对比。核心结论：算法排名随规模与任务不稳定（1.5B 上在线 RL 的 SGRPO 最优 58.0%，7B 上最差的 SimPO 反转最优 85.8%，由模型规模而非 LoRA 造成，经 2×2 因子实验验证）；20 个 DPO 变体无一在 Bonferroni 校正后显著优于原始 DPO，唯一显著者 SimPO 更差（−11.5 pp, p<1e-4）；算法收益高度任务特异，GSM8K 上 19.3 pp 的差距在 MATH 收缩至 0.54 pp（36×）、通用域收缩至 0.47 pp（41×）。由此得出"杠杆层级"：规模 (~50 pp) ≫ 训练范式 (~10 pp) ≫ 在线 vs 离线 (~9 pp) ≫ 损失函数 (~1 pp)。另发现 PyTorch DistributedSampler 种子传播缺陷导致训练完全确定性这一方法论隐患。
AI.motivation: 后训练对齐算法（DPO、SimPO、KTO、GRPO 等）大量涌现，但各论文使用的基座模型、数据集、评测套件各不相同，缺乏可控的横向比较；已有少数对比研究仅覆盖 2–3 种算法，且常把算法差异与实现细节混淆。三个关键空白未被系统研究：(1) 排名如何随模型规模变化；(2) 20 余个 DPO 变体中哪些修改真正有效；(3) 在线 RL 与离线偏好方法的算力-性能权衡。作者希望以严格受控的实验给出"哪个算法最好"的可靠答案，并作为社区基准发布。
AI.method: 统一框架 oxRL：51 种算法共享同一模型加载（HuggingFace + flash_attention_2）、数据管线、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 分布式训练、vLLM rollout 与评测 harness，每种算法仅需实现一个损失函数（BaseAlgorithm 接口），保证两次 SL 运行差异仅在 loss 计算。算法分四族：SFT、在线 RL（PPO、GRPO 变体 SGRPO/GSPO/CISPO）、离线偏好优化（DPO、IPO、SimPO、KTO 及 16 变体）、混合（ORPO、Online DPO、SPIN）。受控设计：固定 Qwen 2.5 Instruct 模型族、训练数据（GSM8K 7,473 题自生成偏好对，SFT 用 gold 响应）、优化器与 LR 调度，仅变损失函数；参考模型与 rollout 标准化。多规模评测：0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B，在 3B 上同时做 full FT 与 LoRA，与 7B 构成 2×2 因子设计以分离规模与 LoRA 效应。统计：Welch t 检验 + Bonferroni 校正（α=0.05/19≈0.0026）、Cohen's d、5 seed、80% 功效（可检测 ≥1.0 pp）。评测采用 LM Evaluation Harness：GSM8K 精确匹配（贪心解码）、MATH 4-shot minerva-math、通用域 ARC-C/HellaSwag/WinoGrande，并做 strict-match 与 flexible-extract 的格式合规性分析。实验分三部分：核心对比（~55 次）、DPO 变体分类（100 次）、消融（~48 次），共 ~240 次运行、~235 GPU-h；另在发现 DistributedSampler 种子未传播的确定性 bug 后修复并做 1.5B（5 算法×3 seed）与 3B 种子修复复验。
AI.result: 1) 规模依赖的排名反转：0.5B 上 IPO 领先（34.50%），SFT/DPO 均为 33.97%，SimPO 仅 26.08%；1.5B 上 SGRPO 最优 58.00%±0.57，超 SFT 3.6 pp、超 DPO 8.9 pp，而 SimPO 最差（38.67%）；3B 因格式不合规整体下滑（base 62.9% 灵活抽取 vs 10.69% 严格匹配），排序同 1.5B；7B 完全反转：SimPO 85.82% > DPO 83.85% > IPO 81.35% > KTO 80.21% > SFT 76.42%。2×2 因子显示 3B 处 LoRA 与 full FT 差异可忽略（SFT 0.31 pp、DPO 1.56 pp 在 σ=2.01 噪声内，SimPO 0.00 pp），故反转源于模型规模（需 ≥7B 容量），LoRA 仅为可行性使能；7B 处格式合规性与"是否依赖参考模型"负相关（SimPO +4.9 pp，SFT −3.9 pp）。2) DPO 变体 0/20 显著优于原始 DPO（49.76%±2.27）：ORPO 最高 53.89%（+4.12 pp, p=0.013, d=2.48）但未过校正；唯一显著者为 SimPO 38.23%（−11.54 pp, p<1e-4, d=−5.25），即显著更差；15.7 pp 的差距完全由"更差"方法贡献，正向优势为噪声。3) 任务特异性：GSM8K 上 19.3 pp 差距 → MATH 0.54 pp（36×）、通用域 0.47 pp（41×，与 GSM8K 的秩相关从 1.0 降到 0.0/+0.6），7B 上通用域差距仅 0.71 pp，且无方法损害通用能力。4) 在线 vs 离线：0.5B 上 SGRPO 略逊且成本高 46×，1.5B 上 SGRPO 领先但需 ~6× wall-clock、10× GPU-h/pp；GRPO 损失粒度敏感，token 级 SGRPO 较句级 GSPO 高 12.6–18 pp，CISPO 灾难性失败（0.15%/5.23%，clip 比例 73–85%、KL 出现 NaN）。5) 方法论发现：PyTorch DistributedSampler 默认 seed=0 且未传入训练种子，使所有 SL 训练跨种子逐字节一致；修复后 1.5B 排名不变、IPO 最稳定（σ=0.22），3B DPO 方差升至 σ=2.01 pp，提示训练稳定性本身也随规模变化。
AI.conclusion: 损失函数变体是最低杠杆的轴（~1 pp），模型规模（~50 pp）与训练范式（~10 pp）才是主导因素，"最优算法"取决于测量位置——排名会随规模、任务、甚至评测指标（严格 vs 灵活抽取）发生反转。实践建议：在部署规模上验证（≤3B 的排名不能预测 7B）；≤1.5B 优先 SFT（最强离线方法且最便宜）；直接用原始 DPO（无变体胜出）；≥7B 配 LoRA 优先 SimPO（准确率与算力效率最佳）；在线 RL 用于格式敏感且模型能自生成正确解的任务；优先 token 级 SGRPO；分布式训练务必验证种子传播。作者建议社区减少新损失函数投入，转向理解算法、规模与任务结构的交互，并将 oxRL 作为"活的"社区基准（代码、配置、原始评测输出全量开源）。局限：仅 Qwen 2.5 单族至 7B；3B/7B 因每 RL 运行需 2 GPU 缺 SGRPO；使用合成偏好数据与贪心解码；未测代码与指令跟随任务。

title: DAPA: Distribution Aware Piecewise Activation Functions for On-Device Transformer Inference and Training
summary: Non-linear activation functions play a pivotal role in on-device inference and training, as they not only consume substantial hardware resources but also impose a significant impact on system performance and energy efficiency. In this work, we propose Distribution-Aware Piecewise Activation (DAPA), a differentiable and hardware-friendly activation function for Transformer architectures by exploiting the distribution of pre-activation data. DAPA employs a non-uniform piecewise approximation that allocates finer segments to high-probability regions of the distribution, improving generalizability over prior piecewise linear methods. The resulting approximation is further quantized using Distribution-Weighted Mean Square Error to reduce latency and resource utilization for hardware deployment. Our HLS implementation demonstrates that DAPA speeds up GELU computation by 16$\times$ and decreases DSP utilization by 16$\times$ while maintaining comparable or better performance across vision Transformers and GPT-2 models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Distribution-Aware Piecewise Activation (DAPA)的硬件友好的激活函数，用于Transformer架构。该方法通过非均匀分段近似来逼近GELU等激活函数，在高概率区域分配更细的粒度，并在硬件部署时使用Distribution-Weighted Mean Square Error进行量化，实现16倍的GELU计算加速和16倍的DSP资源节省。
AI.motivation: 非线性激活函数在设备端推理和训练中消耗大量硬件资源，对系统性能和能效产生重大影响。GELU等激活函数的计算复杂度较高，在资源受限的硬件平台上部署Transformer模型面临挑战。
AI.method: 1. 利用激活函数预激活数据的分布特性；2. 采用非均匀分段线性近似方法，在高概率区域分配更细的分段以提高泛化性；3. 使用Distribution-Weighted Mean Square Error (DW-MSE)对分段近似结果进行量化，以降低硬件部署的延迟和资源消耗。
AI.result: 在视觉Transformer和GPT-2模型上，GELU计算速度提升16倍，DSP利用率降低16倍，同时保持相当或更好的模型性能。
AI.conclusion: DAPA作为一种可微分的硬件友好激活函数，能够有效解决Transformer模型在资源受限设备上的部署难题，在显著降低计算开销和硬件资源消耗的同时，保持了模型的精度表现。

title: Beyond Weighted Summation: Learnable Nonlinear Aggregation Functions for Robust Artificial Neurons
summary: Weighted summation has remained the default input aggregation mechanism in artificial neurons since the earliest neural network models. While computationally efficient, this design implicitly behaves like a mean-based estimator and is therefore sensitive to noisy or extreme inputs. This paper investigates whether replacing fixed linear aggregation with learnable nonlinear alternatives can improve neural network robustness without sacrificing trainability. Two differentiable aggregation mechanisms are introduced: an F-Mean neuron based on a learnable power-weighted aggregation rule, and a Gaussian Support neuron based on distance-aware affinity weighting. To preserve the optimisation stability of standard neurons, hybrid neurons are proposed that interpolate between linear and nonlinear aggregation through a learnable blending parameter. Evaluated in multilayer perceptrons and convolutional neural networks on CIFAR-10 and a noisy CIFAR-10 variant with additive Gaussian corruption, hybrid neurons consistently improve robustness under noise while F-Mean hybrids also yield modest gains on clean data. The three-way hybrid achieves robustness scores of up to 0.991 compared to 0.890 for the standard baseline, and learned parameters converge consistently to sub-linear aggregation (p $\approx$ 0.43--0.50) and high novelty utilisation ($α$ $\approx$ 0.69--0.79). These findings suggest that neuron-level aggregation is a meaningful and underexplored design dimension for building more noise-tolerant neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用可学习的非线性聚合替代神经元内部固定的加权求和：设计 F-Mean（幂加权均值，参数 p）与 Gaussian Support（基于高斯亲和度的距离感知加权，参数 σ）两种可微聚合，并进一步用可学习混合系数 α 将其与标准线性聚合融合为二路/三路混合神经元。在 MLP 与 CNN、干净与加噪 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明，混合神经元普遍提升抗噪鲁棒性（CNN 三路混合 ρ=0.898 vs 基线 0.890；MLP 三路混合 ρ=0.991 vs 0.984），F-Mean 混合在干净数据上也有小幅提升，且学到的参数稳定收敛到次线性聚合（p≈0.43–0.50）与较高新颖度利用率（α≈0.69–0.79）。结论是：神经元级聚合函数是被忽视的、有意义的架构设计维度。
AI.motivation: 标准人工神经元 y=φ(Σwᵢxᵢ+b) 的内部聚合本质上等价于（缩放后的）算术均值，是最小二乘目标 J(μ)=Σ(wᵢxᵢ−μ)² 的唯一最优解，因而继承了均值对离群点与污染观测的敏感性。已有工作（广义均值神经元、Soft Medoid、图网络中的 LAF/PNA、鲁棒聚合与注意力）要么只关注鲁棒性或灵活性某一侧，要么采用固定鲁棒估计量，要么依赖隐式层求解器带来显著计算开销，且大多未针对标准前馈神经元。因此作者提出的核心问题是：是否所有神经元都应被限制为线性聚合？能否在保持梯度可训练性的前提下，让网络自行学习更适合其激活分布的聚合行为，从而在噪声/分布偏移下更鲁棒？
AI.method: 方法围绕三项设计准则展开：至少含一个可学习参数、全程可微（保证反向传播）、且算术均值作为特例（便于初始化为标准行为并渐进探索）。具体地：(1) F-Mean 神经元——先对 zᵢ=wᵢxᵢ 施加 softplus 得 zᵢ⁺=ln(1+e^{zᵢ})>0，再以 ωᵢ(p)=(zᵢ⁺)^p/(Σⱼ(zⱼ⁺)^p+ε)、ε=10⁻⁸ 归一化后加权求和，p∈ℝ 按输出单元可学习，p=1 近似均匀（类似线性），p→0 趋于类调和均值，p→∞ 趋于 max 行为；初始化 p=1 以保证起点稳定。(2) Gaussian Support 神经元——以 Aff(i,j)=exp(−‖zᵢ−zⱼ‖²/(2σ²)) 计算成对亲和度，αᵢ=ΣⱼAff(i,j)/ΣₖΣⱼAff(k,j) 归一化后加权聚合，σ 以 log σ 参数化存储以保证无约束优化；O(n²) 的成对距离开销通过前置降维投影层缓解。(3) 混合神经元——二路混合用 sigmoid(α_raw) 在线性与非线性聚合间插值，三路混合用 softmax 系数同时融合线性、F-Mean 与 Gaussian 三条路径，α_raw=0 初始化使两条路初始权重各为 0.5，网络可自行降低 α 退回线性以获得"安全阀"。实验上在 MLP（3072→128 投影 + 隐藏层 + 线性分类器）与 CNN（卷积特征 + 8192→256 投影分类头）上，测试时注入 σ_noise=0.15 的高斯噪声构造 noisy CIFAR-10，报告干净/噪声精度与鲁棒比 ρ=Acc_noisy/Acc_clean；对比标准线性、F-Mean 混合、Gaussian 混合、三路混合共 16 组配置，标准权重学习率 10⁻³、新颖参数（α, p, log σ）学习率 10⁻²，配合梯度裁剪（范数 1.0）、ReduceLROnPlateau 调度与 patience=10 早停。
AI.result: MLP：基线干净/噪声精度 52.30%/51.45%，ρ=0.984；F-Mean 混合 55.17%/53.56%（ρ=0.971）、Gaussian 混合 54.30%/53.30%（ρ=0.982）、三路混合 55.21%/54.72%（ρ=0.991，为最高）。CNN：标准 87.33%/77.73%，ρ=0.890；F-Mean CNN 87.61%/78.41%，ρ=0.895（干净与噪声精度最佳）；Gaussian CNN 86.60%/77.33%，ρ=0.893；三路 CNN 86.37%/77.52%，ρ=0.898（鲁棒比最佳）。所有混合变体在鲁棒指标上均优于基线；MLP→CNN 各变体绝对精度提升约 32 个百分点，说明混合神经元可与卷积架构良好协同。参数分析显示：p 收敛到次线性区间（MLP F-Mean 0.476、CNN F-Mean 0.430、三路 MLP 0.495、三路 CNN 0.445），表明网络自发倾向抑制极端激活；α 稳定落在 0.69–0.79，说明模型在依赖新颖聚合的同时保留相当的线性成分；σ 收敛到中等值（MLP 4.68/5.08，CNN 7.30/8.50），CNN 更大与卷积特征更丰富一致。总体而言，干净数据增益幅度较小但可重复，噪声下相对退化幅度显著收窄。
AI.conclusion: 结论有三层：(1) 神经元级聚合并非无所谓的实现细节，把它从固定线性提升为可学习非线性，可在不损害可训练性的前提下同时改善性能与抗噪鲁棒性；(2) 混合化是关键——与标准线性路径的可学习融合既稳定了优化过程，又充当"回退机制"，比彻底替换标准神经元更可靠；(3) 学到的参数具有可解释性：网络在没有显式正则约束下自发收敛到次线性（p<1）聚合策略，说明当被赋予自由度时，模型倾向于自主发现更鲁棒的聚合行为。作者据此主张聚合函数是被低估的架构设计轴。局限与展望：仅在 CIFAR-10 及其单一高斯噪声变体上验证，泛化性不足；Gaussian Support 因成对交互带来额外计算成本（未来可考虑稀疏注意力或近似最近邻）；修改仅限 MLP 与 CNN 分类头，其他架构权衡未知。后续工作包括扩展到 ImageNet、医学影像与 NLP 任务，与截尾均值、M-估计子等鲁棒聚合方法对比，将可学习聚合与 Transformer/注意力架构结合（注意力本身即以聚合为核心），以及给出收敛性理论与形式化鲁棒性界。

title: Anatomical Heterogeneity in Transformer Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 10 tables. Independent research. Code available at https://github.com/tomaszwi66
summary: Current transformer language models are trained with uniform computational budgets across all layers, implicitly assuming layer homogeneity. We challenge this assumption through empirical analysis of SmolLM2-135M, a 30-layer, 135M-parameter causal language model, using five diagnostic metrics: weight predictability (R2), ablation degradation, recovery speed, weight manipulation robustness, and structural analysis. We find profound anatomical heterogeneity: (1) Layer weights follow strong mathematical regularity (R2 = 0.91) with a universal oscillatory delta pattern (correlation ~= -0.50), yet predicted weights cause catastrophic failure due to nonlinear error accumulation. (2) Layer importance spans a 10^7 range, from a critical core (L8-11, up to +63,419% PPL degradation) to anti-layers (L14, L17) whose removal improves performance. (3) Recovery speed correlates with layer importance, indicating differential training requirements. (4) Only weight scaling (alpha = 0.9) preserves model quality among five tested manipulation strategies. (5) Growth Transformer Training, allocating budget by layer importance, achieves ~54% cost reduction. A proof-of-concept experiment confirms this: 4.7x lower validation loss than uniform training at identical parameter count, while being 13% faster.

AI.tldr: 本文以 SmolLM2-135M（30层）为唯一实验对象，用「层权重可预测性R²、逐层消融退化、扰动后恢复速度、权重操控鲁棒性、结构/增量相关性」等指标测得 Transformer 各层存在显著异质性：权重在数学上高度规律（gate_proj R²=0.91，层间增量相关系数恒为≈−0.50 的振荡模式）但预测权重在功能上灾难性失效；层重要性跨度超过10⁷（L11 消融使 PPL 退化 +63,419%，L14/L17 为「反层」，移除反而更好）；五种权重替换策略中仅 ×0.9 缩放可保留质量。据此提出「Growth Transformer Training」（按重要性分层分配训练预算、分阶段克隆初始化），在 9.57M 参数、12 层的小规模概念验证中取得验证损失 0.127 vs 均匀基线 0.599（4.7×）、速度快 13%，半预算即超过全预算均匀训练。结论：层均质性假设不成立，可利用异质性换取效率；但证据均来自单一小模型与极小评测集，属概念验证级证据。
AI.motivation: 现行 Transformer 训练对所有层采用统一的架构、参数预算与优化步数，隐含「层同质」假设；而生物神经发育存在明显的结构异质性（不同器官精度需求差异巨大）。作者据此提出四个假设：H1 层在功能上不可互换；H2 后层权重可由前层数学预测（存在内部「发育模式」）；H3 各层扰动后恢复速度不同，指示差异化训练需求；H4 存在净负贡献的「反层」。目标是绘制完整层重要性图谱并把异质性转化为训练加速手段。
