We find that the conditioning is exact at the level of the sampler's internal representation, but that the decoded sequence phenotype can fall short because the dimensionality reduction used to encode sequences does not always preserve the residue-level variation that defines the functional split. We term this discrepancy the calibration gap and show that it is predicted by a simple geometric measure of how well the encoding separates the functional subset from the rest of the family. Experiments on five Pfam families (Kunitz, SH3, WW, Homeobox, and Forkhead domains) confirm the monotonic relationship between separation and gap across a fourfold range of geometries. Applied to omega-conotoxin peptides targeting a calcium channel involved in pain signaling, curated seeding from 23 characterized binders produces over a thousand candidates that preserve the primary pharmacophore and all experimentally identified binding determinants. These results show that stochastic attention enables practitioners to expand a handful of experimentally characterized sequences into diverse candidate libraries without retraining a generative model.

AI.tldr: 通过在采样器的注意力logits中添加单个标量偏差参数，无需重新训练即可将蛋白质序列生成从全家族连续导向用户指定的功能子集，但存在"校准差距"问题——编码器的降维可能无法保留定义功能分裂的残基级变异。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将所有存储序列同等对待，无法引导生成向特定功能子集（如结合、稳定性、特异性）倾斜，且需要重新训练模型。
AI.method: 在采样器的注意力logits中添加单个标量偏差参数，供给小序列集（如结合筛选的命中）和多重比列（控制生成偏向强度），方法与子集代表内容无关。
AI.result: 条件化在采样器内部表征层面精确，但解码序列表型可能不足；校准差距由编码器分离功能子集与家族其余部分的几何度量预测；在五个Pfam家族和ω-锥形毒素肽上验证了单调关系。
AI.conclusion: 随机注意力使从业者无需重新训练生成模型即可将少量实验表征序列扩展为多样化候选库。

title: Revisiting Gene Ontology Knowledge Discovery with Hierarchical Feature Selection and Virtual Study Group of AI Agents
summary: Large language models have achieved great success in multiple challenging tasks, and their capacity can be further boosted by the emerging agentic AI techniques. This new computing paradigm has already started revolutionising the traditional scientific discovery pipelines. In this work, we propose a novel agentic AI-based knowledge discovery-oriented virtual study group that aims to extract meaningful ageing-related biological knowledge considering highly ageing-related Gene Ontology terms that are selected by hierarchical feature selection methods. We investigate the performance of the proposed agentic AI framework by considering four different model organisms' ageing-related Gene Ontology terms and validate the biological findings by reviewing existing research articles. It is found that the majority of the AI agent-generated scientific claims can be supported by existing literatures and the proposed internal mechanisms of the virtual study group also play an important role in the designed agentic AI-based knowledge discovery framework.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于智能体AI的知识发现虚拟学习小组框架，用于从衰老相关的基因本体论(GO)术语中提取有意义的生物学知识。该框架结合层次特征选择方法，在四种模式生物的衰老相关GO术语上进行验证。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在多项挑战性任务中取得成功，智能体AI技术可进一步提升其能力。这一新计算范式已开始革新传统科学发现流程，因此需要探索其在生物知识发现中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 提出基于智能体AI的知识发现虚拟学习小组框架，采用层次特征选择方法筛选高度相关的衰老相关GO术语，并在四种不同模式生物的衰老相关GO术语上评估性能，通过回顾现有研究文章验证生物学发现。
AI.result: 大多数AI智能体生成的科学主张得到现有文献支持，虚拟学习小组的内部机制在设计的智能体AI知识发现框架中发挥重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 基于智能体AI的虚拟学习小组框架能够有效提取衰老相关的生物学知识，具有应用于生物知识发现的潜力。

title: Beyond Single Tokens: Distilling Discrete Diffusion Models via Discrete MMD
summary:
It is currently difficult to distill discrete diffusion models. In contrast, continuous diffusion literature has many distillation approaches methods that can reduce sampling steps to a handful.
  Our method, Discrete Moment Matching Distillation (D-MMD), leverages ideas that have been highly successful in the continuous domain. Whereas previous discrete distillation methods collapse, D-MMD maintains high quality and diversity (given sufficient sampling steps). This is demonstrated on both text and image datasets. Moreover, the newly distilled generators can outperform their teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了离散矩匹配蒸馏(D-MMD)方法，用于解决离散扩散模型难以蒸馏的问题。该方法借鉴了连续扩散领域中成功的蒸馏技术，能够将采样步骤减少到仅几步，同时保持高质量和多样性。
AI.motivation: 当前离散扩散模型的蒸馏存在困难，而连续扩散文献中有多种蒸馏方法可以将采样步骤减少到少数几步。现有的离散蒸馏方法会导致模型崩溃，因此需要一种新的方法来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 离散矩匹配Distillation (D-MMD)借鉴了连续域中高度成功的蒸馏思想，通过矩匹配技术实现离散扩散模型的蒸馏。
AI.result: 在文本和图像数据集上的实验表明，D-MMD能够保持高质量和多样性(在足够的采样步骤下)。此外，新蒸馏的生成器可以超越其教师模型。
AI.conclusion: D-MMD成功解决了离散扩散模型蒸馏的难题，蒸馏后的生成器不仅能保持质量与多样性，还能超越教师模型的表现。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold causal generative models
summary: Causal generative models provide a principled framework for answering observational, interventional, and counterfactual queries from observational data. However, many deep causal models rely on highly expressive architectures with opaque mechanisms, limiting auditability in high-stakes domains. We propose KaCGM, a causal generative model for mixed-type tabular data where each structural equation is parameterized by a Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN). This decomposition enables direct inspection of learned causal mechanisms, including symbolic approximations and visualization of parent--child relationships, while preserving query-agnostic generative semantics. We introduce a validation pipeline based on distributional matching and independence diagnostics of inferred exogenous variables, allowing assessment using observational data alone. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic benchmarks show competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods. A real-world cardiovascular case study further demonstrates the extraction of simplified structural equations and interpretable causal effects. These results suggest that expressive causal generative modeling and functional transparency can be achieved jointly, supporting trustworthy deployment in tabular decision-making settings. Code: https://github.com/aalmodovares/kacgm

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KaCGM（Kolmogorov-Arnold 因果生成模型）：在加性噪声结构因果模型框架下，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）参数化每一条结构方程，从而在保持查询无关（query-agnostic）的观测/干预/反事实推断能力的同时，使因果机制可被直接审计——可提取闭式表达式、做边剪枝与符号近似、并可视化父子变量贡献。该方法还配套了一套仅依赖观测数据的模型校验流程（分布匹配 MMD/C2ST + 外生噪声独立性检验 HSIC/dHSIC）。在合成、半合成基准与心血管真实案例上与 SOTA 方法（如 causal flows、DBCM）相比性能具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 深度因果生成模型（CGM）虽能回答观测、干预、反事实三类因果查询，但其结构方程通常由不透明的高表达力网络（流、扩散、变分网络）参数化，函数形式难以审计、简化与传达；在医疗、公共政策等高风险领域，GDPR 第22条、欧盟《人工智能法案》、FDA 对 AI 医疗器械的指引等均强调透明度与可解释性，实践者不仅要看相关，更要理解干预如何在机制中传播。KAN 以可学习的一元函数替代标量权重，天然支持函数分解、剪枝与符号逼近，故本文试图在"表达力"与"函数可解释性"之间取得统一，并解决真实数据中无法获得干预/反事实真值时如何判断加性噪声模型（ANM）是否设定正确的问题。
AI.method: 1）模型形式：KaCGM 采用加性噪声 SCM，即 x_j = g_j(pa(j)) + u_j，父节点效应 g_j 由 KAN 逼近，外生噪声独立（因果充分性假设）。2）混合类型扩展 KaCGM_mix：以 KAAM（无隐藏层的 KAN）、Logistic-KAN（离散变量用 sigmoid/softmax）等作为各节点子网络。命题 IV.1 证明离散变量的分类条件分布等价于一个带隐式外生项的 SCM 机制（通过 CDF 逆变换），干预分布一致；命题 IV.2 指出当干预的后代全为连续变量时可给出点值反事实。3）校验流程：HSIC 检验 u_j ⊥ pa(j)、dHSIC 检验外生变量联合独立；MMD（高斯核）与随机森林 C2ST 检验观测分布匹配，并与更灵活的模型（如 causal flows）对比以发现设定误差。4）可解释性流水线：优先选更浅的 KAN → 提取闭式函数 → 按重要性剪枝边 → 符号替代（多项式/三角/指数等原子函数）拟合 → 输出闭式方程、特征重要性、概率雷达图（PRP）与部分依赖图（PDP）。5）实验：在 Geffner 等 11 个合成因果图（连续与混合两种设置，样本量 1000/100/10）、Sachs 半合成数据集（加性与非加性噪声）、Kyriacou 等心血管数据集上评估；指标包括 RF 精度、MMD、干预分布 MMD、反事实 MAE，统计检验用 Friedman 与 Wilcoxon 检验。
AI.result: 1）连续合成实验（1000 样本）：ANM 总体最佳，但 KAN/KAAM 与其在 α=0.05 下差异不显著（p 分别为 0.061、0.055）；CFlow 与 DBCM 因样本量小略差（真 DGP 本身属 ANM 类）。2）混合类型实验：KaCGM_mix（KAN_mix、KAAM_mix）在所有指标上为最佳方法。3）半合成 Sachs 数据集：加性设定下 ANM 最优、KaCGM 与 CFlow（CausalMAF 亦为加性模型）相当，DBCM 不具竞争力；非加性设定下 KaCGM 明显退化，而更灵活的 causal flows（CausalNSF）与 DBCM 占优，验证了加性假设的可检验性。4）敏感性分析：通过参数 α 控制噪声非加性程度，可仅凭观测数据指标识别出 KaCGM 的设定偏差并拒绝使用该模型。5）心血管案例：KaCGM_mix 在观测拟合上取得最佳 RF 精度与 MMD，但独立性诊断相对不利；剪枝基本不损害观测拟合，符号替换略微牺牲指标（可解释性与保真度的权衡）；最终得到缺血（ischemia）机制的闭式 logit 表达式（含年龄、BMI、收缩压的二次与线性项及糖尿病项），与临床直觉一致，并借助 PDP 估得 BMI 由 35 降至 20 的 logit 尺度 ATE≈-0.42、收缩压由 180 降至 120 的 ATE≈-0.59。
AI.conclusion: KaCGM 说明表达力较强的因果生成建模与函数透明度可以兼得：把 KAN 嵌入加性噪声 SCM，既保留了 do-算子语义与查询无关的推断能力，又能直接审计、剪枝、符号化结构方程，并从显式机制中读取可解释的因果效应（如 ATE）。其提供的"仅用观测数据"的校验管线使实践者能在真实场景中先检验设定正确性、再决定是否接受简化。局限与未来方向：加性噪声假设在非加性 DGP 下会显著退化（KAAM/KAN 相对更灵活的流模型差距明显），且需要针对 KAN 深度的网格搜索与结构化剪枝；离散变量只能给出干预分布与部分反事实（点值反事实不可识别）；理论层面尚缺 KaCGM 的可识别性保证与 KAN 类对结构机制的条件充分性刻画。总体上，该工作为高风险表格决策场景中的可审计因果模型提供了可行的工程化路径。

title: Survey of Various Fuzzy and Uncertain Decision-Making Methods
comment: Book. Publisher: Neutrosophic Science International Association (NSIA) Publishing House. ISBN: 978-1-59973-883-3. 446 pages
summary: Decision-making in real applications is often affected by vagueness, incomplete information, heterogeneous data, and conflicting expert opinions. This survey reviews uncertainty-aware multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) and organizes the field into a concise, task-oriented taxonomy. We summarize problem-level settings (discrete, group/consensus, dynamic, multi-stage, multi-level, multiagent, and multi-scenario), weight elicitation (subjective and objective schemes under fuzzy/linguistic inputs), and inter-criteria structure and causality modelling. For solution procedures, we contrast compensatory scoring methods, distance-to-reference and compromise approaches, and non-compensatory outranking frameworks for ranking or sorting. We also outline rule/evidence-based and sequential decision models that produce interpretable rules or policies. The survey highlights typical inputs, core computational steps, and primary outputs, and provides guidance on choosing methods according to robustness, interpretability, and data availability. It concludes with open directions on explainable uncertainty integration, stability, and scalability in large-scale and dynamic decision environments.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于不确定性感知多准则决策制定(MCDM)的综述论文，将该领域组织为面向任务的分类体系，涵盖问题设置、权重获取、准则结构建模及求解方法等核心内容。/
AI.motivation: 实际应用中的决策常常受到模糊性、信息不完整、异构数据和专家意见冲突的影响，需要系统性地梳理不确定性感知MCDM方法。/
AI.method: 采用综述方法，对问题级设置（离散/群体/共识/动态/多阶段/多层次/多智能体/多场景）、权重获取方案（主观/客观，模糊/语言输入）、准则间结构与因果关系建模进行分类总结；对比补偿性评分法、距离-参考/折衷方法、非补偿性优势框架、基于规则/证据的序贯决策模型等求解程序。/
AI.result: 构建了面向任务的简洁分类体系，概括了典型输入、核心计算步骤和主要输出，提供了依据鲁棒性、可解释性和数据可用性选择方法的指导。/
AI.conclusion: 未来开放方向包括可解释不确定性集成、大规模动态决策环境中的稳定性与可扩展性研究。/
